# [FW102-ANNOT] BOOTSTRAP/CODE ID [REPRODUCIBILITY] | original line 15 | function fw96_is_code
# [FW102-ANNOT] يبدأ الكشف عن المصدر بفحص علامة ASCII في أول 256 بايت من الملف.
# [FW102-ANNOT] لاحظ أن التعليقات التفسيرية أُدرجت بعد الأسطر الأصلية الأولى لتبقى علامة التعرف الأصلية موجودة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] البصمة MD5 تختلف حتمًا بعد إضافة أي تعليق؛ لا تستأنف التشغيل الموقّع بهذه النسخة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw96_is_code <- function(path) {
  if(!is.character(path)||length(path)!=1L||is.na(path)||!nzchar(path)||
     !file.exists(path)||dir.exists(path)||
     !grepl("\\.(txt|r)$",path,ignore.case=TRUE))return(FALSE)
  tag<-as.integer(charToRaw("FWKC_V102_TWO_PHASE_FORECAST_GATE_REPAIR"))
  tryCatch({f<-file(path,"rb");on.exit(close(f),add=TRUE)
    bytes<-as.integer(readBin(f,"raw",n=256L))
    if(length(bytes)<length(tag))return(FALSE)
    any(vapply(seq_len(length(bytes)-length(tag)+1L),function(i)
      identical(bytes[i:(i+length(tag)-1L)],tag),logical(1L)))
  },error=function(e)FALSE)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE LAUNCHER / fw96_find_self | original line 27 | function fw96_find_self
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw96_find_self <- function() {
  # Preferred: R's source() frame. The file may be renamed by the browser.
  frames<-sys.frames()
  if(length(frames))for(i in rev(seq_along(frames))){
    fr<-frames[[i]]
    if(exists("ofile",envir=fr,inherits=FALSE)){
      z<-get("ofile",envir=fr,inherits=FALSE)
      if(fw96_is_code(z))return(normalizePath(z,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE))
    }
  }
  # Explicit path (may be set by the user); discard stale old-version paths.
  z<-Sys.getenv("FW96_CODEFILE",unset="")
  if(fw96_is_code(z))return(normalizePath(z,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE))
  # Supports running from RStudio Run/pasted code: search for downloaded v96 TXT.
  roots<-unique(c(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE",unset=""),
     Sys.getenv("HOME",unset=""),path.expand("~")))
  roots<-roots[nzchar(roots)]
  wd<-tryCatch(getwd(),error=function(e)"")
  folders<-unique(c(wd,dirname(wd),roots,
     file.path(roots,"Downloads"),file.path(roots,"Desktop"),
     file.path(roots,"Documents"),file.path(roots,"OneDrive","Downloads")))
  hits<-character()
  for(dir in folders){
    if(!nzchar(dir)||!dir.exists(dir))next
    z<-tryCatch(list.files(dir,pattern="^FWKC_v102_.*\\.(txt|r)$",
      full.names=TRUE,ignore.case=TRUE),error=function(e)character())
    if(length(z))hits<-c(hits,z)
  }
  hits<-unique(hits)
  hits<-hits[vapply(hits,fw96_is_code,logical(1L))]
  if(length(hits)){
    # Multiple downloads of this exact version are identical or reviewed locally.
    ages<-file.info(hits)$mtime
    pick<-hits[order(ages,decreasing=TRUE,na.last=TRUE)[1L]]
    message("FWKC v102 located code automatically: ",pick)
    return(normalizePath(pick,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE))
  }
  # Only ONE emergency chooser. Never loop if user accidentally selects XLSX.
  if(interactive()){
    message("SELECT THE FWKC v102 TXT FILE ONCE (not XLSX).")
    z<-file.choose()
    if(fw96_is_code(z))return(normalizePath(z,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE))
    stop("Selected file is not FWKC v102 TXT code. Restart R and source the TXT file.",call.=FALSE)
  }
  stop("FWKC v102 TXT not found; source the FWKC_v102_COMPLETE_FULL_GRID_TIME_GATE_FIXED.txt file",call.=FALSE)
}
.fw95_code<-fw96_find_self()

# P = prevalence, C = weighting index, B = bootstrap resamples.

# Fail before source errors trigger debug/recover; restore by restarting RStudio session if desired.
options(error=NULL)
fw91_source_path <- function() {
  # First and safest: launcher registers the exact engine path before source().
  p <- Sys.getenv("FW91_CODEFILE", unset="")
  if (nzchar(p) && file.exists(p) && !dir.exists(p))
    return(normalizePath(p, winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE))
  # Direct source(file.choose()) is supported; source() supplies an ofile frame.
  frames <- sys.frames()
  paths <- character()
  for (fr in frames) {
    if (!exists("ofile", envir=fr, inherits=FALSE)) next
    x <- get("ofile", envir=fr, inherits=FALSE)
    if (is.character(x) && length(x)==1L && !is.na(x) && file.exists(x))
      paths <- c(paths,x)
  }
  if (length(paths)) return(normalizePath(tail(paths,1L), winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE))
  # If pasted into console, prompt ONCE to select the correct full engine.
  if (interactive()) {
    message("Choose the full FWKC v91 TXT file; do not paste its contents into Console.")
    p <- file.choose()
    return(normalizePath(p, winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE))
  }
  stop("FWKC engine path missing: run FWKC_v91_LAUNCHER.R or set FW91_CODEFILE",call.=FALSE)
}
.fw91_file <- fw91_source_path()
Sys.setenv(FW91_CODEFILE=.fw91_file, FW77_CODEFILE=.fw91_file,
  FW79_CODEFILE=.fw91_file, FW80_CODEFILE=.fw91_file,
  FW81_CODEFILE=.fw91_file, FW90_AUTORUN="0")
fw91_has_marker <- function(path){
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path)!=1L || !file.exists(path)) return(FALSE)
  con <- file(path, open="rb")
  on.exit(close(con),add=TRUE)
  x <- readBin(con, what="raw", n=120L)
  # UTF-8 text is NEVER decoded: compare raw bytes of the ASCII header only.
  h <- as.integer(x); needle <- as.integer(charToRaw("FWKC_V77_SINGLE_FILE"))
  if(length(h)<length(needle)) return(FALSE)
  any(vapply(seq_len(length(h)-length(needle)+1L), function(i)
    identical(h[i:(i+length(needle)-1L)],needle),logical(1L)))
}

fw78_active_source <- function() {
  frames <- sys.frames(); paths <- character()
  for (fr in frames) if (exists("ofile", envir=fr, inherits=FALSE)) {
    z <- get("ofile", envir=fr, inherits=FALSE)
    if (is.character(z) && length(z)==1L && file.exists(z)) paths <- c(paths,z)
  }
  if (length(paths)) normalizePath(tail(paths,1L),winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE) else ""
}

fw77_detect_file <- function() {
  from_env <- Sys.getenv("FW77_CODEFILE", "")
  if(nzchar(from_env) && file.exists(from_env))
    return(normalizePath(from_env, winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE))
  frames <- sys.frames()
  paths <- character()
  for(fr in frames) if(exists("ofile", envir=fr, inherits=FALSE)) {
    x <- get("ofile", envir=fr, inherits=FALSE)
    if(is.character(x) && length(x)==1L && file.exists(x)) paths <- c(paths, x)
  }
  if(length(paths))return(normalizePath(tail(paths,1L),winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE))
  ""
}

fw69_source_hash <- function() {
  fr<-sys.frames();found<-character()
  for(f in fr)if(exists("ofile",f,inherits=FALSE)) {
    path<-get("ofile",f,inherits=FALSE)
    if(is.character(path)&&length(path)==1&&file.exists(path))found<-c(found,path)
  }
  if(length(found))return(unname(tools::md5sum(tail(found,1))))
  if(exists("FW69_CODEFILE",.GlobalEnv,inherits=FALSE)) {
    path<-get("FW69_CODEFILE",.GlobalEnv)
    if(is.character(path)&&length(path)==1L&&file.exists(path))
      return(unname(tools::md5sum(path)))
  }
  fw69_env("FW69_CODE_HASH","FW69_STANDALONE_VERSION_SIGNATURE")
}

fw69_cfg <- function(mode="PILOT") {
 mode<-toupper(mode);full<-identical(mode,"FULL")
 list(mode=mode,cores=fw69_int("FW69_CORES",4,1,4),
  M=fw69_int("FW69_MC_REPS",if(full)1000 else 30,1,100000),
  B=fw69_int("FW69_BOOT_B",if(full)399 else 49,19,2000),
  V=fw69_int("FW69_BOOT_DATASETS",if(full)150 else 4,0,100000),

  reference_n=fw69_int("FW69_REFERENCE_N",if(full)300000 else 100000,20000,2000000),
  min_boot_frac=fw69_num("FW69_MIN_BOOT_SUCCESS",.8,.5,1),
  seed=fw69_int("FW69_SEED",20261106,1,100000000),
  regularization=fw69_num("FW69_RIDGE_LAMBDA",1,0.001,100),
  batch_gc=fw69_int("FW69_GC_EVERY",5,1,500),
  maxhours=fw69_num("FW69_MAX_HOURS",if(full)120 else 12,.1,10000),
  n=c(30L,50L,100L,200L,500L,1000L),P=seq(.1,.9,by=.1),C=seq(.1,.9,by=.1),
  dgms=c("BASE","IID","HIGH_CLUSTER","STRONG_PAIR","LOW_RETEST"),
  boot_n=as.numeric(strsplit(fw69_env("FW69_BOOT_N","30,100,500"),",",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]),
  boot_p=as.numeric(strsplit(fw69_env("FW69_BOOT_P","0.1,0.5,0.9"),",",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]),
  all_boot=fw69_flag("FW69_BOOT_ALL",FALSE),
  skip_rf=fw69_flag("FW69_SKIP_RF",FALSE))
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] إعداد المحاكاة: dgms=5؛ n={30,50,100,200,500,1000}؛ P=0.1..0.9؛ C=0.1..0.9.
# [FW102-ANNOT] عدد التصميمات 5*6*9=270؛ وعدد خلايا وزن C = 2430؛ والطرائق=13؛ والمستهدفات=3.
# [FW102-ANNOT] إعداد MF_FULL يفرض M=1000 وB=199 وV=200 من fw83_config_full، وليس قيم
# [FW102-ANNOT] FW69 العامة غير المعدلة. C ليس sample size ولا weighting of observations.

# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_cfg <- function(mode="PILOT") {
  if(toupper(mode)!="SMOKE")return(fw69_cfg_core(mode))
  cfg<-fw69_cfg_core("PILOT")
  cfg$mode<-"SMOKE"
  cfg$M<-fw69_int("FW69_MC_REPS",2,1,10000)
  cfg$B<-fw69_int("FW69_BOOT_B",19,19,2000)
  cfg$V<-fw69_int("FW69_BOOT_DATASETS",1,0,10000)
  cfg$n<-c(30L,100L)
  cfg$P<-c(.1,.5,.9)
  cfg$C<-seq(.1,.9,by=.1)
  cfg$dgms<-c("BASE","STRONG_PAIR")
  cfg$boot_n<-cfg$n;cfg$boot_p<-cfg$P
  cfg$reference_n<-20000L
  cfg$rf_trees<-40L;cfg$bayes_draws<-64L
  cfg
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] RESEARCH DESIGN VALIDATION | original line 285 | function fw69_validate_cfg
# [FW102-ANNOT] القيود تمنع قيمًا غير قابلة للتنفيذ مثل V > M، وتنبه إلى ضعف دقة Monte Carlo.
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه اختبارات اتساق الإدخال لا براهين صلاحية إحصائية للمقدّرات.

fw69_validate_cfg <- function(cfg) {

 if(cfg$V>cfg$M)stop("FW69_BOOT_DATASETS must be <= FW69_MC_REPS")
 if(cfg$mode=="FULL" && cfg$M<500)warning("FULL mode with <500 Monte Carlo datasets: power/MC precision may be insufficient")
 invisible(TRUE)
}
# --- METHODS AND ESTIMAND -------------------------------------------------------
# D=reference truth, T1=initial binary test, T2=paired second binary reading.
# Retest policy: T_all = T1 + (1-T1)*T2, with T2 observed selectively among T1=0.
# p=E(D), q1=E(T1), r1=E(D*T1), qa=E(T_all), ra=E(D*T_all).
# kappa(c)=(r-pq)/(c*p+(1-c)*q-p*q), C in [0.1,0.9].
# NA is returned only when denominator is nonpositive or margins infeasible.
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MATH-01 [ESTABLISHED] LOSS-WEIGHTED KAPPA | original line 297 | function fw69_kappa
# [FW102-ANNOT] معلمة الدراسة المركزية: k(c)=(r-p*q)/A؛ A=c*p+(1-c)*q-p*q.
# [FW102-ANNOT] اختزال من صيغة 1-L_obs/L_ind: L_obs=c*(p-r)+(1-c)*(q-r)،
# [FW102-ANNOT] L_ind=c*p*(1-q)+(1-c)*(1-p)*q؛ الفرق L_ind-L_obs=r-p*q.
# [FW102-ANNOT] العملية اللاحقة: تحويل الهوامش من IPW/AIPW/Bayes إلى K1,KA,DELTA.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تحقق مجال 2x2 عبر 0<=r<=min(p,q) وr>=p+q-1؛ وإلا NA.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_kappa <- function(p,q,r,c,check=TRUE) {
 de<-c*p+(1-c)*q-p*q
 if(!all(is.finite(c(p,q,r,c,de))) || de<=1e-12)return(NA_real_)
 if(check && (min(p,q,r)< -1e-8||max(p,q)>1+1e-8||
      r>min(p,q)+1e-8||r<p+q-1-1e-8))return(NA_real_)
 (r-p*q)/de
}
fw69_kvec <- function(z,C,check=TRUE) vapply(C,function(c)fw69_kappa(z[1],z[2],z[3],c,check),numeric(1))
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MATH-02 [ADAPTATION] FEASIBILITY CLIPPING | original line 305 | function fw69_project_moments
# [FW102-ANNOT] تحفظ p=mean(D)، وتحصر r في [0,p] وf=q-r في [0,1-p]، ثم تعيد q=r+f.
# [FW102-ANNOT] المقصود ضمان وجود جدول 2x2 صالح بعد أوزان AIPW التي قد تتجاوز [0,1].
# [FW102-ANNOT] الخطوة السابقة: raw moments؛ الخطوة التالية: kappa والحسابات الزوجية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] هذا clipping مكوّني، لا يضمن أدنى انحياز/أدنى RMSE؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] ولا تتوفر له analytical working SE صالحة آليًا في محرك v102.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_project_moments <- function(z) {
 # Project conditional means onto the feasible 2x2 simplex, with observed p fixed.
 # This is a DIFFERENT ESTIMATOR; do not call it RAW or numerically equivalent.
 p<-z[1];if(!is.finite(p)||p<0||p>1||any(!is.finite(z)))return(rep(NA_real_,3))
 rr<-min(max(z[3],0),p);fp<-min(max(z[2]-z[3],0),1-p)
 c(p,rr+fp,rr)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MATH-03 [ESTABLISHED] DELTA DERIVATIVES | original line 312 | function fw69_gradient_hessian
# [FW102-ANNOT] ضع N=r-p*q وA=c*p+(1-c)*q-p*q وk=N/A؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] grad(N)=(-q,-p,1)، grad(A)=(c-q,1-c-p,0).
# [FW102-ANNOT] g=[grad(N)-k*grad(A)]/A؛ ومشتقة Hessian مصححة من مشتقة النسبة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تدخل g وH في Var1, Bias2, Var2 لمقدرات K1 وKA وDELTA.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] دقة Taylor المحلي قد تتدهور قرب حدود الهوامش والتفرد A≈0.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_gradient_hessian <- function(z,c) {
 p<-z[1];q<-z[2];r<-z[3];D<-c*p+(1-c)*q-p*q
 if(!is.finite(D)||D<=1e-12)return(NULL)
 N<-r-p*q;k<-N/D
 n<-c(-q,-p,1);dd<-c(c-q,1-c-p,0)
 g<-(n-k*dd)/D
 HN<-matrix(0,3,3);HN[1,2]<-HN[2,1]<- -1
 HD<-HN
 H<-(HN-k*HD-outer(g,dd)-outer(dd,g))/D
 list(kappa=k,gradient=g,hessian=H)
}
fw69_moments <- function(d,y) {
 if(is.null(y)||any(!is.finite(y)))return(rep(NA_real_,5))
 c(mean(d$d),mean(d$t1),mean(d$d*d$t1),mean(y),mean(d$d*y))
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MATH-04 [ESTABLISHED] CLUSTER SANDWICH | original line 327 | function fw69_gram
# [FW102-ANNOT] إذا تعددت الوحدات داخل الموقع، يجمع مجموعات Z_i-Zbar داخل كل site،
# [FW102-ANNOT] Vhat=G/(G-1)/n^2 * sum_g S_g S_g'؛ وهذا تباين mean العنقودي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] لا يصح تفسير حجم n باعتباره عدد مجموعات مستقلة في وجود cluster correlation.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تُمرَّر مصفوفة V إلى paired-delta، لا تُجمع أخطاء K1/KA وكأنهما مستقلتان.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_gram <- function(z,site) {
 z<-as.matrix(z);n<-nrow(z);G<-length(unique(site))
 if(G==n){if(n<3)return(NULL);return(list(V=stats::cov(z)/n,df=n-1L,clusters=G))}
 if(G<3)return(NULL)
 g<-rowsum(sweep(z,2,colMeans(z),"-"),site,reorder=FALSE)
 list(V=crossprod(g)*G/((G-1)*n*n),df=G-1L,clusters=G)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MATH-05 [ADAPTATION] PAIRED DELTA WITH CLUSTER COVARIANCE | original line 334 | function fw69_paired_delta
# [FW102-ANNOT] theta=(p,q1,r1,qA,rA)، g1=(dk1/dp,dk1/dq1,dk1/dr1,0,0)،
# [FW102-ANNOT] gA=(dkA/dp,0,0,dkA/dqA,dkA/drA)، gd=gA-g1.
# [FW102-ANNOT] Var1(DELTA)=gd'Vhat*gd، وفيه -2*Cov(KA,K1) ضمنيًا.
# [FW102-ANNOT] Bias2≈0.5 tr(Hd*Vhat)، Var2≈Var1+0.5 tr(Hd*Vhat*Hd*Vhat).
# [FW102-ANNOT] الخطوة السابقة: Z المرتبط داخل المريض/الموقع؛ اللاحقة: working SE/CI وQA.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] هذه الصيغة تستخدم Vhat للـZ المرصود/المعوَّض وتحتاج تحققا
# [FW102-ANNOT] مستقلا عند nuisance fit وprojection؛ bootstrap الكامل هو المرجع المقترح.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_paired_delta <- function(d,y,C) {
 out<-array(NA_real_,c(length(C),3,5),
  dimnames=list(NULL,fw69_targets,c("estimate","se1","bias2","se2","df")))
 if(is.null(y)||any(!is.finite(y)))return(out)
 Z<-cbind(d$d,d$t1,d$d*d$t1,y,d$d*y);theta<-colMeans(Z)
 S<-fw69_gram(Z,d$site);V<-if(is.null(S))NULL else S$V
 for(i in seq_along(C)) {
  c<-C[i];u1<-fw69_gradient_hessian(theta[c(1,2,3)],c)
  ua<-fw69_gradient_hessian(theta[c(1,4,5)],c)
  if(is.null(u1)||is.null(ua))next
  g1<-c(u1$gradient,0,0);ga<-c(ua$gradient[1],0,0,ua$gradient[2:3])
  H1<-matrix(0,5,5);H1[c(1,2,3),c(1,2,3)]<-u1$hessian
  HA<-matrix(0,5,5);HA[c(1,4,5),c(1,4,5)]<-ua$hessian
  gs<-list(g1,ga,ga-g1);hs<-list(H1,HA,HA-H1)
  ks<-c(u1$kappa,ua$kappa,ua$kappa-u1$kappa)
  for(j in 1:3) {
   out[i,j,"estimate"]<-ks[j]
   if(!is.null(V)) {
    v1<-as.numeric(crossprod(gs[[j]],V%*%gs[[j]]))
    bias2<-sum(diag(hs[[j]]%*%V))/2
    v2<-v1+sum(diag(hs[[j]]%*%V%*%hs[[j]]%*%V))/2
    out[i,j,"se1"]<-if(v1>=-1e-12)sqrt(max(0,v1)) else NA_real_
    out[i,j,"bias2"]<-bias2
    out[i,j,"se2"]<-if(v2>=-1e-12)sqrt(max(0,v2)) else NA_real_
    out[i,j,"df"]<-S$df
   }
  }
 }
 out
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] DESIGN-01 [ADAPTATION] STRESS DATA-GENERATING MECHANISMS | original line 365 | function fw69_dgm_par
# [FW102-ANNOT] آليات BASE,IID,HIGH_CLUSTER,STRONG_PAIR,LOW_RETEST تفصل مصادر الصعوبة:
# [FW102-ANNOT] ارتباط داخل الموقع، ارتباط الاختبارين، وانخفاض احتمالات إعادة الاختبار.
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذا توصيف بنية الحساسية؛ لا يثبت تعميم النتائج خارج الآليات الخمس المختارة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_dgm_par <- function(k) switch(k,
 BASE=c(.35,.7,0),IID=c(0,0,0),HIGH_CLUSTER=c(.8,.7,0),
 STRONG_PAIR=c(.35,1.2,0),LOW_RETEST=c(.35,.7,-1.5),stop("Unknown DGM"))
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] DESIGN-02 PREVALENCE CALIBRATION | original line 368 | function fw69_alpha
# [FW102-ANNOT] تحل دالة uniroot معادلة E[expit(alpha+0.2*X+0.35*site)]=P تقريبياً
# [FW102-ANNOT] عبر نقاط quantile حتمية؛ فتربط prevalence الاسمية مع DGM المولد.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_alpha <- function(p,sdsite) {
 s<-sqrt(.2^2+(.35*sdsite)^2)
 g<-stats::qnorm(((1:2048)-.5)/2048)
 stats::uniroot(function(a)mean(stats::plogis(a+s*g))-p,c(-30,30),tol=1e-10)$root
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] DESIGN-03 SELECTIVE NEGATIVE RETEST | original line 373 | function fw69_dgm
# [FW102-ANNOT] D: حالة مرجعية؛ T1 وT2full اختبارات ثنائية ذات اعتماد فردي/عنقودي؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] لا يُؤهل لإعادة الاختبار إلا T1=0؛ اختيار R من Bernoulli(pi_i).
# [FW102-ANNOT] pi_i=clip(expit(logit(.5)+shift_dgm+.35*X_i),.05,.95) للسلبيين.
# [FW102-ANNOT] T2 الملاحظ=NA لمن لم يجر الاختبار الثاني؛ T2_full يبقى لأغراض التوليد فقط.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] هذه بيانات محاكاة مع propensity معروفة؛ لا تدعي وجود RCT.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_dgm <- function(n,p,dgm,alpha,seed) {
 set.seed(seed);g<-if(n<500L)10L else 25L
 site<-rep(seq_len(g),length.out=n);s<-fw69_dgm_par(dgm)
 sr<-rnorm(g,sd=s[1])[site];u<-rnorm(n,sd=s[2]);x<-rnorm(n)
 d<-rbinom(n,1,plogis(alpha+.2*x+.35*sr))
 a<-plogis(ifelse(d==1,qlogis(.75),qlogis(.14))+.4*x+.4*sr+u)
 b<-plogis(ifelse(d==1,qlogis(.83),qlogis(.12))+.3*x+.45*sr+u)
 t1<-rbinom(n,1,a);t2full<-rbinom(n,1,b)
 pi<-ifelse(t1==0,pmax(.05,pmin(.95,plogis(qlogis(.5)+s[3]+.35*x))),NA_real_)
 R<-ifelse(t1==0,rbinom(n,1,ifelse(is.na(pi),0,pi)),0L)
 data.frame(d=d,t1=t1,t2=ifelse(R==1,t2full,NA_real_),r=R,
            pi=pi,x=x,site=site,t2_full=t2full)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] DESIGN-04 POPULATION REFERENCE TRUTH | original line 386 | function fw69_truth
# [FW102-ANNOT] تحسب مرجع K1, KA, DELTA باستخدام متوسطات احتمال مولّدة من N مرجعي كبير
# [FW102-ANNOT] (300000 في MF_FULL)، على 5 DGM * 9 P * 9 C * 3 targets=1215 مرجعًا.
# [FW102-ANNOT] قسمة مجموعات المرجع إلى 20 بلوكًا تقدّر reference_MCSE، لا عينة مرضى فعلية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] استخدم reference_MCSE عند تفسير فروق bias الصغيرة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_truth <- function(dgm,P,cfg,key) {
 set.seed(fw69_seed(cfg,100L+match(dgm,cfg$dgms),as.integer(P*10),999L))
 N<-cfg$reference_n;s<-fw69_dgm_par(dgm)
 x<-rnorm(N);site<-rnorm(N,sd=s[1]);u<-rnorm(N,sd=s[2]);a<-fw69_alpha(P,s[1])
 pd<-plogis(a+.2*x+.35*site)
 a0<-plogis(qlogis(.14)+.4*x+.4*site+u);a1<-plogis(qlogis(.75)+.4*x+.4*site+u)
 b0<-plogis(qlogis(.12)+.3*x+.45*site+u);b1<-plogis(qlogis(.83)+.3*x+.45*site+u)
 m<-cbind(pd,pd*a1+(1-pd)*a0,pd*a1,
   pd*(a1+(1-a1)*b1)+(1-pd)*(a0+(1-a0)*b0),
   pd*(a1+(1-a1)*b1))
 z<-colMeans(m)
 f<-function(zz) cbind(K1=fw69_kvec(zz[c(1,2,3)],cfg$C),
                          KA=fw69_kvec(zz[c(1,4,5)],cfg$C),
                          DELTA=fw69_kvec(zz[c(1,4,5)],cfg$C)-fw69_kvec(zz[c(1,2,3)],cfg$C))
 # Reference MCSE: disjoint blocks with same marginal mean; NOT sampling SE of cluster DGM.
 splits<-split(seq_len(N),rep(seq_len(20),length.out=N))
 parts<-array(NA_real_,c(length(cfg$C),3,length(splits)))
 for(i in seq_along(splits))parts[,,i]<-f(colMeans(m[splits[[i]],,drop=FALSE]))
 se<-apply(parts,c(1,2),stats::sd)/sqrt(length(splits))
 values<-f(z)
 data.frame(DGM=dgm,P=P,C=rep(cfg$C,3),estimand=rep(fw69_targets,each=length(cfg$C)),
            truth=as.vector(values),reference_mcse=as.vector(se),alpha=a,
            reference_N=N,reference_key=key,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] REPRODUCIBILITY [DETERMINISTIC RNG] | original line 410 | function fw69_seed
# [FW102-ANNOT] تسمية البذور تعتمد على design، replication، وstage لتفصل streams
# [FW102-ANNOT] قدر الإمكان عن جدول تنفيذ parallel PSOCK وتسهّل إعادة التشغيل الموقّع.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] استقلال البذور العددي يحتاج فحوص QA؛ لا يُضمن بالنمط وحده.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_seed <- function(cfg,design,rep,stage=0L) {
 # Bounded task seed, independent of PSOCK scheduling. Leave headroom for inner offsets.
 as.integer(1+(as.double(cfg$seed)+1009*as.double(design)+
       104729*as.double(rep)+15485863*as.double(stage))%%2000000000)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] DESIGN INPUT CONTRACT | original line 415 | function fw69_check_data
# [FW102-ANNOT] تتحقق هذه الوظيفة من D/T1 ثنائيين، وsite، وتحقق propensity (0,1].
# [FW102-ANNOT] فشل شرط positivity يجعل IPW/AIPW غير معرف؛ لا ينبغي تعويضه بقيمة مختلقة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_check_data <- function(d) {
 need<-c("d","t1","t2","r","pi","x","site")
 if(!all(need%in%names(d)))stop("Missing columns: ",paste(setdiff(need,names(d)),collapse=","))
 if(anyNA(d$d)||anyNA(d$t1)||any(!d$d%in%0:1)||any(!d$t1%in%0:1))stop("D and T1 must be binary")
 ix<-which(d$t1==0);sel<-ix[d$r[ix]==1]
 if(any(!is.finite(d$pi[ix])|d$pi[ix]<=0|d$pi[ix]>1))stop("Positivity: pi must be in (0,1] for ALL eligible patients")
 if(length(sel)&&any(is.na(d$t2[sel])|!d$t2[sel]%in%0:1))stop("T2 must be binary for retested patients")
 if(any(is.na(d$site)))stop("Missing site identifiers")
 TRUE
}
# --- ESTIMATORS: original RAW vs explicitly changed STABILIZED variants --------
fw69_eligible <- function(d) which(d$t1==0)
fw69_weighted_mean <- function(y,w) if(length(y)&&sum(w)>0)sum(w*y)/sum(w) else NA_real_
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-01 [ESTABLISHED] DIRECT IPW BASELINE | original line 428 | function fw69_y_ipw
# [FW102-ANNOT] للمؤهلين T1=0: U_i=R_i*T2_i/pi_i؛ ولـT1=1 تُستخدم Y_A=1.
# [FW102-ANNOT] نحسب qA=mean(Y_A), rA=mean(D*Y_A)، ثم kappa عبر fw69_kappa.
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه المقارنة ضرورية لإثبات أن إضافة AIPW/guard/projection ذات فائدة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_y_ipw <- function(d) {
 y<-as.numeric(d$t1);ix<-fw69_eligible(d);sel<-ix[d$r[ix]==1]
 y[sel]<-d$t2[sel]/d$pi[sel];y
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-02 [ESTABLISHED] STRATIFIED HAJEK | original line 432 | function fw69_y_strata
# [FW102-ANNOT] ضمن كل حالة D=d: b_d=sum_{obs}(w*T2)/sum_{obs}(w)، w=1/pi.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تعويض المفقود بمتوسط طبقي موزون؛ ترتبط جبريا بـAIPW_STRATA_RAW
# [FW102-ANNOT] في هذا التنفيذ، فلا تعدهما تجربتين مستقلتين بالكامل.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_y_strata <- function(d) {
 ix<-fw69_eligible(d);y<-as.numeric(d$t1)
 for(k in 0:1) {
  all<-ix[d$d[ix]==k];obs<-all[d$r[all]==1]
  if(length(all)&&!length(obs))return(NULL)
  if(length(all))y[all]<-fw69_weighted_mean(d$t2[obs],1/d$pi[obs])
 }
 y
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-03 [ADAPTATION] AIPW PSEUDO-OUTCOME | original line 441 | function fw69_y_aipw
# [FW102-ANNOT] للمؤهلين T1=0: U_i=m_i+(R_i/pi_i)*(T2_i-m_i).
# [FW102-ANNOT] لغير المؤهلين T1=1: Y_A=1؛ إذن Y_A=T1+(1-T1)*U.
# [FW102-ANNOT] E_R[U_i|full data]=T2_i إذا كانت pi صحيحة وR يتبع الآلية المقترحة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] AIPW=IPW+(1-R/pi)*mhat؛ اختلاف mhat يحدد ridge/RF.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] جودة nuisance والتغاير وMAR/positivity تؤثر في الخصائص الفعلية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_y_aipw <- function(d,m) {
 ix<-fw69_eligible(d);if(is.null(m)||any(!is.finite(m[ix])))return(NULL)
 y<-as.numeric(d$t1);y[ix]<-m[ix]
 sel<-ix[d$r[ix]==1];y[sel]<-m[sel]+(d$t2[sel]-m[sel])/d$pi[sel]
 y
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-04 [ESTABLISHED] PENALIZED LOGISTIC RIDGE | original line 447 | function fw69_ridge_fit
# [FW102-ANNOT] m=expit(beta0+betaD*D+betaX*X)؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] beta_hat minimizes -sum_{retested}(w*Bernoulli log-likelihood)
# [FW102-ANNOT]   +0.5*[0.001 beta0^2+lambda*(betaD^2+betaX^2)], w=1/pi.
# [FW102-ANNOT] Newton/IRLS مع ضبط خطوات يحد من عدم الاستقرار والانفصال في العينات الصغيرة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] regularization قد يغير الانحياز، ولا يضمن convergence لكل عينة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_ridge_fit <- function(d,train,lambda) {
 # True ridge logistic (no silent GLM separation), stable Newton/IRLS.
 if(!length(train))return(NULL)
 X<-cbind(1,as.numeric(d$d[train]),as.numeric(d$x[train]));
 y<-as.numeric(d$t2[train]);w<-1/d$pi[train]
 if(any(!is.finite(X))||any(!is.finite(w))||any(w<=0))return(NULL)
 beta<-c(stats::qlogis((sum(w*y)+.5)/(sum(w)+1)),0,0)
 pen<-diag(c(.001,lambda,lambda),3)
 converged<-FALSE
 for(it in 1:50) {
  pred<-pmax(1e-7,pmin(1-1e-7,plogis(drop(X%*%beta))))
  score<-drop(crossprod(X,w*(y-pred)))-drop(pen%*%beta)
  hess<-crossprod(X,X*as.numeric(w*pred*(1-pred)))+pen
  step<-tryCatch(as.vector(solve(hess,score)),error=function(e)NULL)
  if(is.null(step)||any(!is.finite(step)))return(NULL)
  step<-pmax(-2,pmin(2,step));beta<-beta+step
  if(max(abs(step))<1e-8){converged<-TRUE;break}
 }
 list(beta=beta,converged=converged)
}
fw69_ridge_predict <- function(fit,d,test) {
 if(is.null(fit))return(NULL)
 plogis(drop(cbind(1,as.numeric(d$d[test]),as.numeric(d$x[test]))%*%fit$beta))
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-05 [ADAPTATION] SITE-DISJOINT CROSS-FITTING | original line 471 | function fw69_cf_folds
# [FW102-ANNOT] يُقسم المؤهلون إلى طيتين بحسب site وليس صفوف المرضى بصورة عشوائية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تدريب m_hat(-fold) على مواقع أخرى يقلل تسرب معلومات الموقع إلى التنبؤ.
# [FW102-ANNOT] إذا لا توجد مواقع كافية تعيد الدالة حالة فشل معللة؛ هذا مصدر لفشل التقدير.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_cf_folds <- function(d,k=2) {
 ix<-fw69_eligible(d);s<-unique(as.character(d$site[ix]));G<-length(s)
 if(!length(ix))return(NULL)
 if(G>=k) {
  # Site-disjoint folds, greedy balance by number of retested subjects per site.
  # Sorting by observed counts avoids unnecessary empty training folds.
  eligible_counts<-vapply(s,function(site)sum(as.character(d$site[ix])==site & d$r[ix]==1),numeric(1))
  site_order<-order(-eligible_counts,s)
  part<-integer(G);fold_n<-rep(0,k)
  for(pos in site_order) {
    fmin<-which.min(fold_n)
    part[pos]<-fmin;fold_n[fmin]<-fold_n[fmin]+eligible_counts[pos]+.001
  }
  f<-part[match(as.character(d$site[ix]),s)]
  return(list(ix=ix,fold=f,site_disjoint=TRUE))
 }
 # NEVER silently call patient-disjoint folds site-disjoint.
 list(ix=ix,fold=rep(1L,length(ix)),site_disjoint=FALSE)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-06 [INTEGRATION] RF / RIDGE / GUARDED FALLBACK | original line 490 | function fw69_nuisance
# [FW102-ANNOT] RF probability forest تتنبأ P(T2=1|D,X,T1=0)، ranger::ranger،
# [FW102-ANNOT] num.trees=300 في MF_FULL، min.node.size=3، case.weights=1/pi، threads=1.
# [FW102-ANNOT] إذا نقص حجم تدريب RF أو غابت فئة، ينتقل Guarded إلى weighted ridge؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] إذا لم تتقارب ridge ينتقل إلى weighted smoothed constant:
# [FW102-ANNOT]   mconst=(sum_i w_i*T2_i+0.5)/(sum_i w_i+1).
# [FW102-ANNOT] CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED يعتمد ridge أساسا لكنه قد يستخدم constant احتياطيًا.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] انخفاض الفشل في RF_GUARDED لا يعني أن RF تفوقت بنفسها؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] يجب نشر نسب استخدام RF الفعلي/Ridge fallback/constant fallback لكل DGM/n/P.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_nuisance <- function(d,cfg,seed,learner=c("RIDGE","RF"),guarded=TRUE) {
 learner<-match.arg(learner);ix<-fw69_eligible(d)
 if(!length(ix))return(list(m=as.numeric(d$t1),status="NO_ELIGIBLE",fallbacks=0L))
 obs<-ix[d$r[ix]==1]
 if(!length(obs))return(list(m=NULL,status="NO_RETEST_OBSERVED",fallbacks=0L))
 ff<-fw69_cf_folds(d,2L);if(!ff$site_disjoint)
  return(list(m=NULL,status="INSUFFICIENT_SITES_FOR_DISJOINT_CF",fallbacks=0L))
 m<-rep(NA_real_,nrow(d));fallbacks<-0L
 for(k in sort(unique(ff$fold))) {
  test<-ix[ff$fold==k];tr<-obs[!(as.character(d$site[obs])%in%as.character(unique(d$site[test])))]
  if(!length(test))next
  use_ridge<-identical(learner,"RIDGE")
  if(learner=="RF") {
   use_ridge<-length(tr)<8L||length(unique(d$t2[tr]))<2L||
     !requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE)||cfg$skip_rf
   if(use_ridge && !guarded)
    return(list(m=NULL,status="RF_TRAINING_SUPPORT_FAILURE",fallbacks=fallbacks))
  }
  pred<-NULL
  if(!use_ridge) {
   pred<-tryCatch({
      set.seed(seed+101L+k)
      train<-data.frame(Y=factor(d$t2[tr],levels=c(0,1)),D=d$d[tr],X=d$x[tr]);
      model<-ranger::ranger(Y~D+X,data=train,probability=TRUE,
        num.trees=cfg$rf_trees,min.node.size=3,case.weights=1/d$pi[tr],
        num.threads=1,seed=seed+301L+k,write.forest=TRUE)
      pr<-predict(model,data=data.frame(D=d$d[test],X=d$x[test]),num.threads=1)$predictions
      if(!"1"%in%colnames(pr))stop("RF omitted class 1")
      as.numeric(pr[,"1"])
    },error=function(e)NULL)
   if(is.null(pred)||length(pred)!=length(test)||any(!is.finite(pred))) {
    if(!guarded)return(list(m=NULL,status="RF_FIT_ERROR",fallbacks=fallbacks))
    use_ridge<-TRUE
   }
  }
  if(use_ridge) {
   if(learner=="RF")fallbacks<-fallbacks+1L
   fit<-fw69_ridge_fit(d,tr,cfg$regularization)
   pred<-if(!is.null(fit)&&isTRUE(fit$converged))
       fw69_ridge_predict(fit,d,test) else NULL
   if(is.null(pred)||any(!is.finite(pred))) {
    # Empirical Bayes constant from *training fold only*; not a strict RF fit.
    if(!length(tr))return(list(m=NULL,status="EMPTY_TRAINING_FOLD",fallbacks=fallbacks))
    w<-1/d$pi[tr];p<-(sum(w*d$t2[tr])+.5)/(sum(w)+1)
    pred<-rep(p,length(test));fallbacks<-fallbacks+1L
   }
  }
  m[test]<-pmax(1e-6,pmin(1-1e-6,pred))
 }
 if(any(!is.finite(m[ix])))return(list(m=NULL,status="UNPREDICTED_ELIGIBLE",fallbacks=fallbacks))
 list(m=m,status=if(fallbacks)"FALLBACK_RIDGE_OR_CONSTANT" else "OK",fallbacks=fallbacks)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-07 [ADAPTATION] WEIGHTED PSEUDO-BETA BAYES | original line 542 | function fw69_pseudo_bayes
# [FW102-ANNOT] a_d=P(T1=1|D=d) يُسحب من Beta مع prior Jeffreys (1/2,1/2).
# [FW102-ANNOT] b_d=P(T2=1|T1=0,D=d) يُسحب من Beta بــ n_eff=(sum w)^2/sum w^2.
# [FW102-ANNOT] P(T_A=1|D=d)=a_d+(1-a_d)*b_d؛ ثم تُحسب K1,KA,DELTA.
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذا pseudo-posterior بوزن معادل وليس نموذج Bayes crossed hierarchical
# [FW102-ANNOT] المعتمد على pseudo-raters في ورقة FWKC المنشورة؛ لا تدعِ التطابق العددي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_pseudo_bayes <- function(d,C,K,seed,regularized=FALSE) {
 # v67-compatible posterior functional with explicit prior-only flag.
 set.seed(seed);p<-mean(d$d);a<-b<-matrix(NA_real_,K,2)
 prior_only<-FALSE
 for(k in 0:1) {
  di<-which(d$d==k);neg<-di[d$t1[di]==0];sel<-neg[d$r[neg]==1]
  if(!regularized && (!length(di)||!length(neg)||!length(sel)||p<=0||p>=1))return(NULL)
  a[,k+1]<-rbeta(K,sum(d$t1[di]==1)+.5,sum(d$t1[di]==0)+.5)
  if(!length(sel)) {
   if(!regularized)return(NULL)
   b[,k+1]<-rbeta(K,.5,.5);prior_only<-TRUE
  } else {
   w<-1/d$pi[sel];eff<-sum(w)^2/sum(w*w)
   v<-fw69_weighted_mean(d$t2[sel],w)
   b[,k+1]<-rbeta(K,.5+eff*v,.5+eff*(1-v))
  }
 }
 f0<-a[,1];f1<-a[,2];q0<-f0+(1-f0)*b[,1];q1<-f1+(1-f1)*b[,2]
 pp<-rep(p,K)
 kappam<-function(q,r) {
  den<-outer(q,C,function(qq,cc)cc*p+(1-cc)*qq-p*qq)
  num<-matrix(r-p*q,length(q),length(C))
  a<-num/den;a[!is.finite(a)|den<=1e-12]<-NA_real_;a
 }
 k1<-kappam(p*f1+(1-p)*f0,p*f1)
 ka<-kappam(p*q1+(1-p)*q0,p*q1)
 z<-array(NA_real_,c(length(C),3,2),dimnames=list(NULL,fw69_targets,c("point","se")))
 for(j in 1:3) {
  x<-switch(j,k1,ka,ka-k1)
  z[,j,"point"]<-colMeans(x,na.rm=FALSE)
  z[,j,"se"]<-apply(x,2,stats::sd,na.rm=FALSE)
 }
 list(values=z,prior_only=prior_only)
}
fw69_init_array <- function(C) {
 array(NA_real_,c(length(C),3,length(fw69_methods)),
       dimnames=list(NULL,fw69_targets,fw69_methods))
}
# V73 REFERENCE: executable untouched v72 estimator for exact parity tests
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] PARITY REFERENCE [RESEARCH-SAFETY] | original line 581 | function fw73_estimate_reference
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه النسخة مرجع تنفيذ قديم لاختبارات التكافؤ البرمجي لبعض المكونات.
# [FW102-ANNOT] الاحتفاظ بها يساعد كشف انحرافات غير مقصودة بعد تحسينات الأداء.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست دليلًا بأن كل الأساليب متكافئة مع FWKC المنشور.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_estimate_reference <- function(d,cfg,seed) {
 C<-cfg$C;A<-fw69_init_array(C);SE<-A;SE2<-A
 status<-setNames(rep("NOT_RUN",length(fw69_methods)),fw69_methods)
 delta2<-array(NA_real_,dim(A),dimnames=dimnames(A))
 fw69_check_data(d)
 helper<-function(y,label,project=FALSE) {
  if(is.null(y))return(NULL)
  if(!project) {
   z<-fw69_moments(d,y)
   vals<-cbind(fw69_kvec(z[c(1,2,3)],C),fw69_kvec(z[c(1,4,5)],C))
   vals<-cbind(vals,vals[,2]-vals[,1]);colnames(vals)<-fw69_targets
   ok<-rowSums(is.finite(vals))==3
   del<-fw69_paired_delta(d,y,C)
   se_raw<-del[, ,"se1"];bias_raw<-del[, ,"bias2"];se2_raw<-del[, ,"se2"]
   bad<-!is.finite(vals);se_raw[bad]<-NA_real_;bias_raw[bad]<-NA_real_;se2_raw[bad]<-NA_real_
   return(list(value=vals,SE=se_raw,
     bias2=bias_raw,se2=se2_raw,
     status=if(all(ok))"OK" else "RAW_MOMENTS_OUTSIDE_SIMPLEX_OR_DEGENERATE"))
  }
  z<-fw69_moments(d,y);z1<-fw69_project_moments(z[c(1,2,3)]);
  z2<-fw69_project_moments(z[c(1,4,5)])
  vals<-cbind(fw69_kvec(z1,C),fw69_kvec(z2,C));vals<-cbind(vals,vals[,2]-vals[,1]);colnames(vals)<-fw69_targets
  # Gradient/sandwich from RAW estimating equation is not a valid projection SE.
  # FULL REFIT bootstrap is the primary CI for projected methods.
  list(value=vals,SE=matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3),bias2=matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3),
       se2=matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3),
       status=if(all(is.finite(vals)))"PROJECTED_DIFFERENT_ESTIMATOR" else "PROJECTED_DEGENERATE")
 }
 add <- function(name,o) {
  if(is.null(o)) {status[name]<<-"NO_ESTIMATE";return()}
  A[,,name]<<-o$value;SE[,,name]<<-o$SE;SE2[,,name]<<-o$se2;
  delta2[,,name]<<-o$bias2;status[name]<<-o$status
 }
 yi<-fw69_y_ipw(d);add("IPW_RAW",helper(yi,"IPW_RAW"))
 ys<-fw69_y_strata(d)
 add("HAJEK",helper(ys,"HAJEK"))
 # Compute AIPW independently: its weighted residuals cancel within each D stratum.
 mstr<-rep(NA_real_,nrow(d));ix<-fw69_eligible(d)
 for(k in 0:1) {
   all<-ix[d$d[ix]==k];obs<-all[d$r[all]==1]
   if(length(all)&&length(obs))mstr[all]<-fw69_weighted_mean(d$t2[obs],1/d$pi[obs])
 }
 ystr<-if(length(ix)&&any(!is.finite(mstr[ix])))NULL else fw69_y_aipw(d,mstr)
 add("AIPW_STRATA_RAW",helper(ystr,"AIPW_STRATA_RAW"))
 nr<-fw69_nuisance(d,cfg,seed+100L,"RIDGE")
 yr<-fw69_y_aipw(d,nr$m)
 add("CF_RIDGE_RAW",helper(yr,"CF_RIDGE_RAW"))
 add("CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED",helper(yr,"CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED",TRUE))
 # Complete-case nuisance ridge: distinct non-cross-fitted sensitivity estimator.
 ixf<-fw69_eligible(d);sel<-ixf[d$r[ixf]==1]
 fitfull<-fw69_ridge_fit(d,sel,cfg$regularization)
 mfull<-rep(NA_real_,nrow(d))
 if(length(ixf)&&!is.null(fitfull)&&isTRUE(fitfull$converged))
    mfull[ixf]<-fw69_ridge_predict(fitfull,d,ixf)
 yfull<-fw69_y_aipw(d,if(length(ixf)&&all(is.finite(mfull[ixf])))mfull else NULL)
 add("RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED",helper(yfull,"RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED",TRUE))
 if(!is.null(yfull))status["RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED"]<-"NON_CROSSFITTED_MODEL_DEPENDENT"
 nrf<-fw69_nuisance(d,cfg,seed+200L,"RF",FALSE)
 yf<-fw69_y_aipw(d,nrf$m)
 add("RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT",helper(yf,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"))
 ng<-if(!is.null(nrf$m))nrf else fw69_nuisance(d,cfg,seed+200L,"RF",TRUE)
 yg<-fw69_y_aipw(d,ng$m)
 add("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW",helper(yg,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW"))
 add("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED",helper(yg,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED",TRUE))
 if(is.null(yr))status[c("CF_RIDGE_RAW","CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED")]<-nr$status
 if(is.null(yf))status["RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]<-nrf$status
 if(is.null(yg))status[c("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED")]<-ng$status
 # The source of nuisance fallback is recorded separately and does not overwrite
 # RAW_MOMENTS_OUTSIDE_SIMPLEX_OR_DEGENERATE or PROJECTED_DEGENERATE.
 raw_feasibility_reason<-status
 fallback_reason<-setNames(rep("NONE",length(fw69_methods)),fw69_methods)
 if(!is.null(yg)&&ng$fallbacks>0L)
   fallback_reason[c("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED")]<-paste0("RF_TO_RIDGE_OR_CONSTANT_FOLDS_",ng$fallbacks)
 bb<-fw69_pseudo_bayes(d,C,cfg$bayes_draws,seed+400L,FALSE)
 br<-fw69_pseudo_bayes(d,C,cfg$bayes_draws,seed+400L,TRUE)
 if(!is.null(bb)){A[, ,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-bb$values[, ,"point"];SE[, ,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-bb$values[, ,"se"];status["BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-"OK"}
 else status["BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-"MISSING_RETEST_STRATUM_OR_PREVALENCE_BOUNDARY"
 if(!is.null(br)){A[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-br$values[, ,"point"];SE[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-br$values[, ,"se"];
   status["BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-if(br$prior_only)"PRIOR_ONLY_SOME_STRATA" else "OK"
   if(br$prior_only) { # Do not disguise unidentifiable data as successful estimation.
     A[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_;SE[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_
   }
  }
 # v67 inverse-SE fusion only if strict components valid and positive SE.
 for(i in seq_along(C))for(j in 1:3) {
  a<-A[i,j,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"];b<-A[i,j,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]
  sa<-SE[i,j,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"];sb<-SE[i,j,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]
  if(all(is.finite(c(a,b,sa,sb)))&&sa>0&&sb>0) {
   w<-sb/(sa+sb);A[i,j,"FUSION_SITE_STRICT"]<-w*a+(1-w)*b
  }
  # EXPLORATORY 50/50 fusion: no invalid SE borrowing from unprojected RF.
  # When RF projected fails, use separately labelled non-crossfitted Ridge projection.
  # This changes the estimator; full-refit bootstrap (not delta/proxy SE) is mandatory.
  # Compute only the two kappa quantities here. The exploratory paired DELTA
  # will be derived from their difference, rather than independently using
  # another target-specific fallback.
  if(j<=2L) {
   ar<-A[i,j,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]
   bg<-A[i,j,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED"]
   if(!is.finite(bg))bg<-A[i,j,"RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED"]
   if(is.finite(ar)&&is.finite(bg))
      A[i,j,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-0.5*ar+0.5*bg
  }
 }
 # FUSION_SITE_STRICT remains v67 target-by-target inverse-SE fusion.
 # Its independently fused DELTA need not equal fused KA minus fused K1.
 # FUSION_REGULARIZED is instead explicitly a coherent paired difference.
 for(i in seq_along(C)) {
   one<-A[i,1,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]
   all<-A[i,2,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]
   if(is.finite(one)&&is.finite(all))
      A[i,3,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-all-one
 }
 status["FUSION_SITE_STRICT"]<-if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"FUSION_SITE_STRICT"])))"OK" else "STRICT_COMPONENT_FAILURE"
 status["FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"])))"EXPLORATORY_EQUAL_50_50_NOT_V67" else "REGULARIZED_COMPONENT_FAILURE"
 if(!is.null(br)&&br$prior_only)status["FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-"PRIOR_ONLY_COMPONENT_DO_NOT_VALIDATE"
 # Record if full-fit ridge replaces RF for the fusion; it is a new method.
 fusion_component<-if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED"])))
    "RF_GUARDED_PROJECTED" else if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED"])))
    "RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED" else "MIXED_OR_UNAVAILABLE_BY_CELL"
 fallback_reason["FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-if(fusion_component=="RF_GUARDED_PROJECTED")
    "NONE_OR_RF_GUARDED_INTERNAL" else paste0("FUSION_COMPONENT_",fusion_component)
 # The bootstrap provides the SE of an estimated/projection/fusion method;
 # no analytic working SE is attached to the fixed-weight fused estimator.
 SE[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_
 SE2[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_
 list(point=A,se1=SE,se2=SE2,bias2=delta2,status=status,
      diagnostics=data.frame(method=fw69_methods,
         reason=unname(status),raw_feasibility_reason=unname(raw_feasibility_reason),
         fallback_reason=unname(fallback_reason),stringsAsFactors=FALSE),
      training=list(ridge=nr$status,rf_strict=nrf$status,rf_guarded=ng$status,
                    rf_fallbacks=ng$fallbacks,fusion_component=fusion_component))
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] EST-08 [INTEGRATION] 13 ESTIMATORS AND PAIRED COHERENCE | original line 715 | function fw69_estimate
# [FW102-ANNOT] المسار الجامع: IPW,HAJEK,AIPW_STRATA,CF_RIDGE,RF_AIPW,BAYES,FUSION.
# [FW102-ANNOT] estimands=(K1,KA,DELTA)، C=0.1..0.9؛ DELTA عادة KA-K1.
# [FW102-ANNOT] FUSION_SITE_STRICT استثناء تاريخي: يمزج كل estimand على حدة،
# [FW102-ANNOT] لذا قد لا تحقق DELTA_fused = KA_fused - K1_fused بدقة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] FUSION_REGULARIZED=0.5 BayesReg+0.5 RF_guarded_projected
# [FW102-ANNOT] وقد تستبدل Ridge_Full_Projected بالمكون RF؛ ثم DELTA=KA-K1.
# [FW102-ANNOT] STRICT w_B=SE_RF/(SE_B+SE_RF) = (1/SE_B)/[(1/SE_B)+(1/SE_RF)].
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذا inverse-standard-error، وليس inverse-variance أو GLS الأمثل.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] صفة «13 طريقة» لا تعني 13 نموذجاً مستقلًا بالتقديرات.
# [FW102-ANNOT] projected/fusion methods: لا تعيد استعمال working delta SE غير صالح لها.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_estimate <- function(d,cfg,seed) {
 C<-cfg$C;A<-fw69_init_array(C);SE<-A;SE2<-A
 status<-setNames(rep("NOT_RUN",length(fw69_methods)),fw69_methods)
 delta2<-array(NA_real_,dim(A),dimnames=dimnames(A))
 fw69_check_data(d)
 helper<-function(y,label,project=FALSE) {
  if(is.null(y))return(NULL)
  if(!project) {
   z<-fw69_moments(d,y)
   vals<-cbind(fw69_kvec(z[c(1,2,3)],C),fw69_kvec(z[c(1,4,5)],C))
   vals<-cbind(vals,vals[,2]-vals[,1]);colnames(vals)<-fw69_targets
   ok<-rowSums(is.finite(vals))==3
   del<-fw69_paired_delta(d,y,C)
   se_raw<-del[, ,"se1"];bias_raw<-del[, ,"bias2"];se2_raw<-del[, ,"se2"]
   bad<-!is.finite(vals);se_raw[bad]<-NA_real_;bias_raw[bad]<-NA_real_;se2_raw[bad]<-NA_real_
   return(list(value=vals,SE=se_raw,
     bias2=bias_raw,se2=se2_raw,
     status=if(all(ok))"OK" else "RAW_MOMENTS_OUTSIDE_SIMPLEX_OR_DEGENERATE"))
  }
  z<-fw69_moments(d,y);z1<-fw69_project_moments(z[c(1,2,3)]);
  z2<-fw69_project_moments(z[c(1,4,5)])
  vals<-cbind(fw69_kvec(z1,C),fw69_kvec(z2,C));vals<-cbind(vals,vals[,2]-vals[,1]);colnames(vals)<-fw69_targets
  # Gradient/sandwich from RAW estimating equation is not a valid projection SE.
  # FULL REFIT bootstrap is the primary CI for projected methods.
  list(value=vals,SE=matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3),bias2=matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3),
       se2=matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3),
       status=if(all(is.finite(vals)))"PROJECTED_DIFFERENT_ESTIMATOR" else "PROJECTED_DEGENERATE")
 }
 add <- function(name,o) {
  if(is.null(o)) {status[name]<<-"NO_ESTIMATE";return()}
  A[,,name]<<-o$value;SE[,,name]<<-o$SE;SE2[,,name]<<-o$se2;
  delta2[,,name]<<-o$bias2;status[name]<<-o$status
 }
 yi<-fw69_y_ipw(d);add("IPW_RAW",helper(yi,"IPW_RAW"))
 ys<-fw69_y_strata(d)
 add("HAJEK",helper(ys,"HAJEK"))
 # Compute AIPW independently: its weighted residuals cancel within each D stratum.
 mstr<-rep(NA_real_,nrow(d));ix<-fw69_eligible(d)
 for(k in 0:1) {
   all<-ix[d$d[ix]==k];obs<-all[d$r[all]==1]
   if(length(all)&&length(obs))mstr[all]<-fw69_weighted_mean(d$t2[obs],1/d$pi[obs])
 }
 ystr<-if(length(ix)&&any(!is.finite(mstr[ix])))NULL else fw69_y_aipw(d,mstr)
 add("AIPW_STRATA_RAW",helper(ystr,"AIPW_STRATA_RAW"))
 nr<-fw69_nuisance(d,cfg,seed+100L,"RIDGE")
 yr<-fw69_y_aipw(d,nr$m)
 add("CF_RIDGE_RAW",helper(yr,"CF_RIDGE_RAW"))
 add("CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED",helper(yr,"CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED",TRUE))
 # Complete-case nuisance ridge: distinct non-cross-fitted sensitivity estimator.
 ixf<-fw69_eligible(d);sel<-ixf[d$r[ixf]==1]
 fitfull<-fw69_ridge_fit(d,sel,cfg$regularization)
 mfull<-rep(NA_real_,nrow(d))
 if(length(ixf)&&!is.null(fitfull)&&isTRUE(fitfull$converged))
    mfull[ixf]<-fw69_ridge_predict(fitfull,d,ixf)
 yfull<-fw69_y_aipw(d,if(length(ixf)&&all(is.finite(mfull[ixf])))mfull else NULL)
 add("RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED",helper(yfull,"RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED",TRUE))
 if(!is.null(yfull))status["RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED"]<-"NON_CROSSFITTED_MODEL_DEPENDENT"
 nrf<-fw69_nuisance(d,cfg,seed+200L,"RF",FALSE)
 yf<-fw69_y_aipw(d,nrf$m)
 add("RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT",helper(yf,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"))
 ng<-if(!is.null(nrf$m))nrf else fw69_nuisance(d,cfg,seed+200L,"RF",TRUE)
 yg<-fw69_y_aipw(d,ng$m)
 add("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW",helper(yg,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW"))
 add("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED",helper(yg,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED",TRUE))
 if(is.null(yr))status[c("CF_RIDGE_RAW","CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED")]<-nr$status
 if(is.null(yf))status["RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]<-nrf$status
 if(is.null(yg))status[c("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED")]<-ng$status
 # The source of nuisance fallback is recorded separately and does not overwrite
 # RAW_MOMENTS_OUTSIDE_SIMPLEX_OR_DEGENERATE or PROJECTED_DEGENERATE.
 raw_feasibility_reason<-status
 fallback_reason<-setNames(rep("NONE",length(fw69_methods)),fw69_methods)
 if(!is.null(yg)&&ng$fallbacks>0L)
   fallback_reason[c("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_RAW","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED")]<-paste0("RF_TO_RIDGE_OR_CONSTANT_FOLDS_",ng$fallbacks)
 bb<-fw69_pseudo_bayes(d,C,cfg$bayes_draws,seed+400L,FALSE)
 br<-if(!is.null(bb)) bb else fw69_pseudo_bayes(d,C,cfg$bayes_draws,seed+400L,TRUE)
 if(!is.null(bb)){A[, ,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-bb$values[, ,"point"];SE[, ,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-bb$values[, ,"se"];status["BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-"OK"}
 else status["BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]<-"MISSING_RETEST_STRATUM_OR_PREVALENCE_BOUNDARY"
 if(!is.null(br)){A[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-br$values[, ,"point"];SE[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-br$values[, ,"se"];
   status["BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-if(br$prior_only)"PRIOR_ONLY_SOME_STRATA" else "OK"
   if(br$prior_only) { # Do not disguise unidentifiable data as successful estimation.
     A[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_;SE[, ,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_
   }
  }
 # v67 inverse-SE fusion only if strict components valid and positive SE.
 for(i in seq_along(C))for(j in 1:3) {
  a<-A[i,j,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"];b<-A[i,j,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]
  sa<-SE[i,j,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"];sb<-SE[i,j,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]
  if(all(is.finite(c(a,b,sa,sb)))&&sa>0&&sb>0) {
   w<-sb/(sa+sb);A[i,j,"FUSION_SITE_STRICT"]<-w*a+(1-w)*b
  }
  # EXPLORATORY 50/50 fusion: no invalid SE borrowing from unprojected RF.
  # When RF projected fails, use separately labelled non-crossfitted Ridge projection.
  # This changes the estimator; full-refit bootstrap (not delta/proxy SE) is mandatory.
  # Compute only the two kappa quantities here. The exploratory paired DELTA
  # will be derived from their difference, rather than independently using
  # another target-specific fallback.
  if(j<=2L) {
   ar<-A[i,j,"BAYES_REGULARIZED"]
   bg<-A[i,j,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED"]
   if(!is.finite(bg))bg<-A[i,j,"RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED"]
   if(is.finite(ar)&&is.finite(bg))
      A[i,j,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-0.5*ar+0.5*bg
  }
 }
 # FUSION_SITE_STRICT remains v67 target-by-target inverse-SE fusion.
 # Its independently fused DELTA need not equal fused KA minus fused K1.
 # FUSION_REGULARIZED is instead explicitly a coherent paired difference.
 for(i in seq_along(C)) {
   one<-A[i,1,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]
   all<-A[i,2,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]
   if(is.finite(one)&&is.finite(all))
      A[i,3,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-all-one
 }
 status["FUSION_SITE_STRICT"]<-if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"FUSION_SITE_STRICT"])))"OK" else "STRICT_COMPONENT_FAILURE"
 status["FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"])))"EXPLORATORY_EQUAL_50_50_NOT_V67" else "REGULARIZED_COMPONENT_FAILURE"
 if(!is.null(br)&&br$prior_only)status["FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-"PRIOR_ONLY_COMPONENT_DO_NOT_VALIDATE"
 # Record if full-fit ridge replaces RF for the fusion; it is a new method.
 fusion_component<-if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED"])))
    "RF_GUARDED_PROJECTED" else if(all(is.finite(A[, ,"RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED"])))
    "RIDGE_FULL_PROJECTED" else "MIXED_OR_UNAVAILABLE_BY_CELL"
 fallback_reason["FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-if(fusion_component=="RF_GUARDED_PROJECTED")
    "NONE_OR_RF_GUARDED_INTERNAL" else paste0("FUSION_COMPONENT_",fusion_component)
 # The bootstrap provides the SE of an estimated/projection/fusion method;
 # no analytic working SE is attached to the fixed-weight fused estimator.
 SE[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_
 SE2[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"]<-NA_real_
 list(point=A,se1=SE,se2=SE2,bias2=delta2,status=status,
      diagnostics=data.frame(method=fw69_methods,
         reason=unname(status),raw_feasibility_reason=unname(raw_feasibility_reason),
         fallback_reason=unname(fallback_reason),stringsAsFactors=FALSE),
      training=list(ridge=nr$status,rf_strict=nrf$status,rf_guarded=ng$status,
                    rf_fallbacks=ng$fallbacks,fusion_component=fusion_component))
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] شبكة DGM*n*P=270 تصميمًا؛ C يحسب داخل المقدّر لكل تصميم.

# [FW102-ANNOT] لا تعتبر مستويات C مستقلة لأن المحاكاة تعيد استخدام بيانات المريض نفسها.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_design <- function(cfg) {
 z<-expand.grid(DGM=cfg$dgms,n=cfg$n,P=cfg$P,
                KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 z$design_id<-seq_len(nrow(z));z
}
fw69_ref_mat <- function(ref,C) {
 z<-matrix(NA_real_,length(C),3,dimnames=list(NULL,fw69_targets))
 for(j in seq_along(fw69_targets)) {
  a<-ref[ref$estimand==fw69_targets[j],,drop=FALSE]
  z[,j]<-a$truth[match(C,a$C)]
 };z
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MC-02 SUFFICIENT STATISTICS ACCUMULATOR | original line 861 | function fw69_new_acc
# [FW102-ANNOT] يجمع عدادات success,sum_error,squared_error,fourth_moment,
# [FW102-ANNOT] CI availability/coverage؛ لتوليد RMSE/MCSE دون حفظ كل فرد لكل C.
# [FW102-ANNOT] عدم توفر SE للطرق المسقطة موثق؛ لا يعني coverage=0 بل undefined working CI.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_new_acc <- function(cfg) {
 d<-c(length(cfg$C),3,length(fw69_methods));dn<-list(C=cfg$C,target=fw69_targets,method=fw69_methods)
 init<-function()array(0,d,dimnames=dn)
 list(valid=init(),sumerr=init(),sse=init(),sumerr4=init(),
      sumest=init(),n_se1=init(),sum_se1=init(),n_bias2=init(),sum_bias2=init(),
      n_se2=init(),sum_se2=init(),
      workingCI_valid=init(),workingCI_covered=init(),
      fisherCI_valid=init(),fisherCI_covered=init(),nsim=0L)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MC-03 FAILURE-AWARE PERFORMANCE ACCOUNTING | original line 870 | function fw69_accumulate
# [FW102-ANNOT] valid_r=1{finite(theta_hat)}؛ الفشل=1-v/M؛ تحسب bias وRMSE بين v الناجحين فقط.
# [FW102-ANNOT] CI working: theta_hat +/- 1.96*SE1 (ولا يشمل nuisance uncertainty كاملة).
# [FW102-ANNOT] Fisher-z: atanh(kappa) مع derivative 1/(1-kappa^2) لـK1/KA فقط.
# [FW102-ANNOT] لا تخلط معدلات عدم صلاحية point estimate مع فشل R/worker or CI validity.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_accumulate <- function(acc,fit,truth) {
 e<-sweep(fit$point,c(1,2),truth,"-")
 ok<-is.finite(e)
 z<-e;z[!ok]<-0
 zz<-fit$point;zz[!ok]<-0
 acc$valid<-acc$valid+ok;acc$sumerr<-acc$sumerr+z
 acc$sse<-acc$sse+z*z;acc$sumerr4<-acc$sumerr4+z^4
 acc$sumest<-acc$sumest+zz
 for(kind in c("se1","bias2","se2")) {
  values<-fit[[kind]];good<-is.finite(values)
  acc[[paste0("n_",kind)]]<-acc[[paste0("n_",kind)]]+good
  acc[[paste0("sum_",kind)]]<-acc[[paste0("sum_",kind)]]+ifelse(good,values,0)
 }
 # Zero-extra-refit pointwise working intervals on ALL simulated datasets.
 # WARNING: nuisance-model estimation is not fully propagated by working SEs.
 se <- fit$se1
 wgood <- is.finite(e) & is.finite(se) & se>=0
 wcover <- wgood & abs(e)<=stats::qnorm(.975)*se
 acc$workingCI_valid<-acc$workingCI_valid+wgood
 acc$workingCI_covered<-acc$workingCI_covered+wcover
 for(j in 1:2) {
   point<-fit$point[,j,]; sese<-fit$se1[,j,]
   true<-matrix(rep(truth[,j],length(fw69_methods)),nrow=nrow(truth))
   fg<-is.finite(point)&abs(point)<1-1e-8&is.finite(true)&abs(true)<1-1e-8&
       is.finite(sese)&sese>=0
   tp<-atanh(pmin(pmax(point,-1+1e-8),1-1e-8))
   tt<-atanh(pmin(pmax(true,-1+1e-8),1-1e-8))
   fc<-fg & abs(tp-tt)<=stats::qnorm(.975)*sese/(1-point*point)
   acc$fisherCI_valid[,j,]<-acc$fisherCI_valid[,j,]+fg
   acc$fisherCI_covered[,j,]<-acc$fisherCI_covered[,j,]+fc
 }
 acc$nsim<-acc$nsim+1L
 acc
}
