# [FW102-ANNOT] MC-04 PREDEFINED PAIRED COMPARISONS | original line 904 | function fw69_pairs
# [FW102-ANNOT] قائمة أزواج ثابتة تقارن FUSION_REGULARIZED ببدائل مرجعية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تسهّل تحليل الخسارة على مجموعات البيانات نفسها دون pseudo-independent comparisons.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_pairs <- function(cfg) {
 lapply(c("IPW_RAW","HAJEK","BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67","RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT","FUSION_SITE_STRICT","CF_RIDGE_RAW","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED"),
        function(x)c("FUSION_REGULARIZED",x))
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MC-05 SAME-DATASET PAIRED SQUARED-LOSS DIFFERENCE | original line 908 | function fw69_mc_task
# [FW102-ANNOT] لأزواج A,B: d_r=(theta_A,r-truth)^2-(theta_B,r-truth)^2.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تقارن فقط عندما تكون الطريقتان صالحتين على المحاولة نفسها.
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه المقارنة أشد عدالة من مقارنة RMSE المشروط بنجاح مختلف لكل طريقة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تحفظ checkpoint مع source signature، وتحفظ تشخيصات أسباب NA/fallback.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_mc_task <- function(job) {
 cfg<-get("FW69_CFG",.GlobalEnv);ref<-get("FW69_REFS",.GlobalEnv)
 f<-file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS",sprintf("%07d.rds",job$id))
 old<-if(file.exists(f))tryCatch(readRDS(f),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
 if(is.list(old)&&identical(old$signature,cfg$signature)&&identical(old$from,job$from)
    &&identical(old$N,job$N)&&is.list(old$acc))return(list(id=job$id,ok=TRUE,resumed=TRUE,seconds=0))
 t<-proc.time()[3]
 tryCatch({
  rr<-ref[ref$DGM==job$DGM&abs(ref$P-job$P)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(rr))stop("Reference not found for design")
  alpha<-rr$alpha[1];truth<-fw69_ref_mat(rr,cfg$C)
  acc<-fw69_new_acc(cfg);status_tally<-list();pair_sum<-list()
  # Exact computational reuse only: same DGM, replicate, seed, source signature.
  keep_original <- cfg$V>0L && (isTRUE(cfg$all_boot) ||
    (job$n %in% cfg$boot_n && round(job$P,7) %in% round(cfg$boot_p,7)))
  original_point_cache <- list()
  for(ii in seq_len(job$N)) {
   rep<-job$from+ii-1L;seed<-fw69_seed(cfg,job$design,rep)
   d<-fw69_dgm(job$n,job$P,job$DGM,alpha,seed)
   fit<-fw69_estimate(d,cfg,seed+12345L)
   if(keep_original && rep<=cfg$V)
     original_point_cache[[as.character(rep)]] <-
       list(point=fit$point,se1=fit$se1,bias2=fit$bias2,
            status=fit$status,diagnostics=fit$diagnostics)
   acc<-fw69_accumulate(acc,fit,truth)
   z<-fit$diagnostics
   z$design<-job$design;z$rep<-rep
   status_tally[[ii]]<-z
   for(pair in fw69_pairs(cfg)) {
    a<-fit$point[,"DELTA",pair[1]];b<-fit$point[,"DELTA",pair[2]]
    good<-is.finite(a)&is.finite(b)
    # Paired risk difference computed only over identical successful datasets.
    loss<-(a-truth[,"DELTA"])^2-(b-truth[,"DELTA"])^2
    loss[!good]<-NA_real_
    label<-paste(pair,collapse="_vs_")
    if(is.null(pair_sum[[label]]))pair_sum[[label]]<-matrix(0,length(cfg$C),4,
      dimnames=list(NULL,c("N_both","sum_diff","sum_sq_diff","sum_abs_diff")))
    u<-pair_sum[[label]];v<-ifelse(good,loss,0)
    u[,1]<-u[,1]+good;u[,2]<-u[,2]+v
    u[,3]<-u[,3]+v*v;u[,4]<-u[,4]+abs(v);pair_sum[[label]]<-u
   }
  }
  state<-list(signature=cfg$signature,from=job$from,N=job$N,design=job$design,
     DGM=job$DGM,n=job$n,P=job$P,acc=acc,pairederr=pair_sum,
     status=do.call(rbind,status_tally),boot_point_cache=original_point_cache)
  fw69_atomic(state,f)
  list(id=job$id,ok=TRUE,resumed=FALSE,seconds=proc.time()[3]-t)
 },error=function(e){
  msg<-conditionMessage(e)
  fw69_atomic(list(signature=cfg$signature,job=job,error=msg,
                 call=as.character(conditionCall(e)),time=as.character(Sys.time())),paste0(f,".error.rds"))
  list(id=job$id,ok=FALSE,resumed=FALSE,error=msg,seconds=proc.time()[3]-t)
 })
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MC-06 JOB PARTITION | original line 962 | function fw69_mc_jobs
# [FW102-ANNOT] تقسيم M تكرارًا لكل تصميم إلى حزم MC_chunk يتيح استئنافًا غير مكرر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] العدد الإجمالي للمهام يعتمد على MC_chunk، وليس مؤشر الجودة الإحصائية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_mc_jobs <- function(des,cfg) {
 result<-vector("list",nrow(des)*ceiling(cfg$M/cfg$MC_chunk));i<-0L
 for(k in seq_len(nrow(des)))for(from in seq(1L,cfg$M,by=cfg$MC_chunk)) {
  i<-i+1L;result[[i]]<-c(list(id=i,design=k,from=from,
   N=min(cfg$MC_chunk,cfg$M-from+1L)),as.list(des[k,c("DGM","n","P")]))
 };result
}
fw69_progress <- function(cfg,phase,done,total,start,failed=0L) {
 seconds<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),start,units="secs"))
 pct<-100*done/max(1,total)
 eta<-if(done)seconds*(total-done)/done/3600 else NA_real_
 row<-data.frame(timestamp=format(Sys.time(),"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
     phase=phase,completed=done,total=total,progress_pct=round(pct,2),
     elapsed_hours=round(seconds/3600,3),eta_hours=round(eta,3),failed=failed)
 fw69_csv(row,file.path(cfg$out,"LIVE_STATUS.csv"))
 writeLines(paste(unlist(row),collapse=" | "),file.path(cfg$out,"LIVE_STATUS.txt"))
 log<-file.path(cfg$out,"PROGRESS_HISTORY.csv")
 utils::write.table(row,log,sep=",",quote=TRUE,row.names=FALSE,
                    col.names=!file.exists(log),append=file.exists(log))
 fw69_msg(sprintf("%s: %d/%d | %.2f%% | ETA %.2f h | failed %d",phase,done,total,pct,eta,failed))
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] ENGINEERING-01 SIGNED PARALLEL CHECKPOINTS | original line 983 | function fw69_pool
# [FW102-ANNOT] PSOCK workers مع حدود threading تمنع oversubscription؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] الصلاحية مرتبطة بالتوقيع الذي يشمل code/source hash وإعدادات التشغيل.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [CRITICAL] تغيير التعليقات في هذه النسخة يغيّر hash ومجلد RUN والتوقيعات؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] لا تنقل checkpoints من تشغيل النسخة الأصلية إليها.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_pool <- function(jobs,fun,cfg,phase,prefix) {
 fdir<-file.path(cfg$out,prefix);dir.create(fdir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
 exists_good<-function(j) {
  p<-file.path(fdir,sprintf("%07d.rds",j$id))
  v<-if(file.exists(p))tryCatch(readRDS(p),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
  is.list(v)&&identical(v$signature,cfg$signature)&&
   (if(phase=="MC")identical(v$from,j$from)&&identical(v$N,j$N)&&
     identical(v$design,j$design)&&is.list(v$acc)&&identical(v$acc$nsim,j$N)
    else identical(v$B,cfg$B)&&identical(v$rep,j$rep)&&
       identical(v$design,j$design)&&is.matrix(v$samples)&&
       nrow(v$samples)==cfg$B&&ncol(v$samples)==
       length(cfg$C)*length(fw69_targets)*length(fw69_methods))
 }
 completed<-vapply(jobs,exists_good,logical(1));start<-Sys.time();fails<-0L
 fw69_progress(cfg,phase,sum(completed),length(jobs),start)
 pending<-which(!completed);if(!length(pending))return(TRUE)
 workers<-min(cfg$cores,parallel::detectCores(logical=FALSE),length(pending))
 if(!is.finite(workers)||workers<1L)workers<-1L
 # Prevent oversubscription: 4 PSOCK processes x 1 BLAS/RF thread each.
 Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
            BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1",RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS="1")
 cl<-parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers,outfile="")
 on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl),add=TRUE)
 fnames<-ls(envir=.GlobalEnv,pattern="^fw69_")
 fnames<-fnames[vapply(fnames,function(x)is.function(get(x,envir=.GlobalEnv)),logical(1))]
 parallel::clusterExport(cl,c(fnames,"fw69_methods","fw69_targets","FW69_CFG","FW69_REFS"),envir=.GlobalEnv)
 parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl,{Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                   MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1",RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS="1");NULL})
 # In waves workers write their own checkpoint; master writes LIVE_STATUS each wave.
 for(group in split(pending,ceiling(seq_along(pending)/(workers*3L)))) {
  result<-parallel::parLapplyLB(cl,jobs[group],fun)
  ok<-vapply(result,function(x)isTRUE(x$ok),logical(1));completed[group]<-ok
  fails<-fails+sum(!ok)
  if(any(!ok)) {
   z<-do.call(rbind,lapply(result[!ok],function(x)
     data.frame(time=as.character(Sys.time()),phase=phase,job=x$id,
                error=if(is.null(x$error))"UNKNOWN" else x$error)))
   log<-file.path(cfg$out,"ERROR_LOG.csv")
   utils::write.table(z,log,sep=",",quote=TRUE,row.names=FALSE,
                      col.names=!file.exists(log),append=file.exists(log))
  }
  fw69_progress(cfg,phase,sum(completed),length(jobs),start,fails)
  if((sum(completed)%%cfg$batch_gc)==0)gc(verbose=FALSE)
  if(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),start,units="hours"))>cfg$maxhours) {
    fw69_msg("STAGE TIME CAP: checkpoints saved; resume by re-running same code/settings")
    return(FALSE)
  }
 }
 if(any(!completed))fw69_msg("INCOMPLETE TASKS: see ERROR_LOG.csv and .error.rds. Rerun with unchanged configuration.")
 all(completed)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MC-07 EXACT REPORTED PERFORMANCE DEFINITIONS | original line 1034 | function fw69_mc_tables
# [FW102-ANNOT] failure_pct=100*(1-N_valid/M), bias=sum(e)/N_valid,
# [FW102-ANNOT] rmse=sqrt(sum(e^2)/N_valid), MCSE_bias=sqrt((mean(e^2)-bias^2)/N_valid).
# [FW102-ANNOT] MCSE_RMSE via delta approximation on e^2 using fourth moment.
# [FW102-ANNOT] 95% working coverage conditional on valid working CIs; غير التغطية الشاملة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تقرير التغطية مشروط بنجاح التقدير؛ حقق النجاح وفشل CI منفصلين.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_mc_tables <- function(des,cfg) {
 final<-list();failrows<-list();compare<-list();fi<-0L;fail_i<-0L;pc<-0L
 alljobs<-fw69_mc_jobs(des,cfg)
 grouped<-split(alljobs,vapply(alljobs,function(x)as.integer(x$design),integer(1)))
 for(group in grouped) {
  d<-group[[1]];a<-fw69_new_acc(cfg);statuses<-list();pairs<-list();nrows<-0L
  for(job in group) {
   f<-file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS",sprintf("%07d.rds",job$id))
   if(!file.exists(f))next
   q<-tryCatch(readRDS(f),error=function(e)NULL)
   if(is.null(q)||!identical(q$signature,cfg$signature)||is.null(q$acc))next
   for(k in c("valid","sumerr","sse","sumerr4","sumest",
    "n_se1","sum_se1","n_bias2","sum_bias2","n_se2","sum_se2",
    "workingCI_valid","workingCI_covered","fisherCI_valid","fisherCI_covered"))a[[k]]<-a[[k]]+q$acc[[k]]
   a$nsim<-a$nsim+q$acc$nsim
   nrows<-nrows+1L;statuses[[nrows]]<-q$status
   for(key in names(q$pairederr)) {
    if(is.null(pairs[[key]]))pairs[[key]]<-q$pairederr[[key]]
    else pairs[[key]]<-pairs[[key]]+q$pairederr[[key]]
   }
  }
  if(a$nsim==0)next
  grid<-expand.grid(C=cfg$C,estimand=fw69_targets,method=fw69_methods,
                    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  v<-as.vector(a$valid);s<-as.vector(a$sumerr);ss<-as.vector(a$sse)
  ss4<-as.vector(a$sumerr4)
  grid$DGM<-d$DGM;grid$n<-d$n;grid$P<-d$P;grid$attempts<-a$nsim
  grid$N_valid<-v;grid$failure_pct<-100*(1-v/a$nsim)
  grid$bias<-ifelse(v>0,s/pmax(v,1),NA_real_)
  grid$rmse<-ifelse(v>0,sqrt(ss/pmax(v,1)),NA_real_)
  err_var<-pmax(0,ss/pmax(v,1)-grid$bias^2)
  grid$MCSE_bias<-ifelse(v>1,sqrt(err_var/pmax(v,1)),NA_real_)
  grid$MCSE_RMSE<-ifelse(v>1&grid$rmse>0,
      sqrt(pmax(0,ss4/pmax(v,1)-(ss/pmax(v,1))^2)/pmax(v,1))/(2*grid$rmse),NA_real_)
  grid$mean_paired_se1<-ifelse(as.vector(a$n_se1)>0,
   as.vector(a$sum_se1)/pmax(1,as.vector(a$n_se1)),NA_real_)
  grid$mean_second_order_bias_approx<-ifelse(as.vector(a$n_bias2)>0,
   as.vector(a$sum_bias2)/pmax(1,as.vector(a$n_bias2)),NA_real_)
  grid$mean_second_order_se_sensitivity<-ifelse(as.vector(a$n_se2)>0,
   as.vector(a$sum_se2)/pmax(1,as.vector(a$n_se2)),NA_real_)
  wv<-as.vector(a$workingCI_valid); wc<-as.vector(a$workingCI_covered)
  fv<-as.vector(a$fisherCI_valid); fisher_covered<-as.vector(a$fisherCI_covered)
  grid$working_CI_N_valid<-wv
  grid$working_CI_coverage_conditional<-ifelse(wv>0,wc/pmax(1,wv),NA_real_)
  grid$working_CI_MCSE<-ifelse(wv>1,sqrt(pmax(0,grid$working_CI_coverage_conditional*
      (1-grid$working_CI_coverage_conditional)/wv)),NA_real_)
  grid$fisher_z_CI_N_valid<-fv
  grid$fisher_z_CI_coverage_conditional<-ifelse(fv>0,fisher_covered/pmax(1,fv),NA_real_)
  grid$working_CI_scope<-"NORMAL_WORKING_OR_PSEUDO_SE_NOT_FULL_REFIT_BOOTSTRAP"
  grid$analysis_status<-ifelse(a$nsim<cfg$M,"INCOMPLETE",
     ifelse(a$nsim<100,"EXPLORATORY_FEW_REPS","MONTE_CARLO_ESTIMATE"))
  grid$methodology_note<-ifelse(grid$method%in%
      c("IPW_RAW","HAJEK","AIPW_STRATA_RAW","BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"),
      "MATCHED_FORMULA_NOT_FULL_V67_NUMERIC_PARITY",
      "CHANGED_ESTIMATOR_OR_LEARNER_NOT_V67_PARITY")
  fi<-fi+1L;final[[fi]]<-grid[,c("DGM","n","P","C","estimand","method","attempts","N_valid",
    "failure_pct","bias","rmse","MCSE_bias","MCSE_RMSE",
    "mean_paired_se1","mean_second_order_bias_approx",
    "mean_second_order_se_sensitivity",
    "working_CI_N_valid","working_CI_coverage_conditional","working_CI_MCSE",
    "fisher_z_CI_N_valid","fisher_z_CI_coverage_conditional","working_CI_scope",
    "analysis_status","methodology_note")]
  if(length(statuses)) {
   ssr<-do.call(rbind,statuses)
   fq<-stats::aggregate(rep(1L,nrow(ssr)),
     by=ssr[c("method","reason","raw_feasibility_reason","fallback_reason")],
     FUN=sum)
   names(fq)[ncol(fq)]<-"count"
   fq$DGM<-d$DGM;fq$n<-d$n;fq$P<-d$P
   fail_i<-fail_i+1L;failrows[[fail_i]]<-fq
  }
  for(key in names(pairs)) {
   z<-pairs[[key]];nv<-z[,1];mu<-ifelse(nv>0,z[,2]/pmax(nv,1),NA_real_)
   mcse<-ifelse(nv>1,sqrt(pmax(0,z[,3]/pmax(nv,1)-mu^2)/pmax(nv,1)),NA_real_)
   pc<-pc+1L;compare[[pc]]<-data.frame(DGM=d$DGM,n=d$n,P=d$P,C=cfg$C,
     pair=key,N_common=nv,mean_paired_MSE_difference=mu,MCSE_difference=mcse,
     comparison_note="ONLY_COMMON_VALID_REPLICATIONS; FAILURE_RATES_REPORTED_SEPARATELY")
  }
 }
 list(mc=if(length(final))do.call(rbind,final) else data.frame(),
      failures=if(length(failrows))do.call(rbind,failrows) else data.frame(),
      compare=if(length(compare))do.call(rbind,compare) else data.frame())
}
# --- FULL REFIT CLUSTER BOOTSTRAP ----------------------------------------------
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] BOOT-01 [ESTABLISHED] SITE-CLUSTER RESAMPLING | original line 1118 | function fw69_bootsample
# [FW102-ANNOT] يعيد سحب المواقع G مع الإرجاع ويحافظ على جميع المرضى داخل كل موقع مسحوب.
# [FW102-ANNOT] يعيد تعيين site IDs حتى لا يُخلط بين نسختين من الموقع الأصلي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] في حالة site فردي لكل مريض يعود إلى patient-level bootstrap.
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه آلية لا تحفظ احتمالات التصميم الحقيقي إلا تحت افتراضات العينة الملائمة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_bootsample <- function(d,seed) {
 set.seed(seed);s<-unique(as.character(d$site))
 if(length(s)==nrow(d)) {
  ix<-sample.int(nrow(d),nrow(d),TRUE);b<-d[ix,,drop=FALSE]
  b$site<-seq_len(nrow(b));return(b)
 }
 picks<-sample(s,length(s),replace=TRUE)
 chunks<-lapply(seq_along(picks),function(i){x<-d[as.character(d$site)==picks[i],,drop=FALSE];x$site<-i;x})
 do.call(rbind,chunks)
}
fw69_boot_jobs <- function(des,cfg) {
 if(cfg$V==0)return(list())
 target<-if(cfg$all_boot)des else
       des[des$n%in%cfg$boot_n & round(des$P,7)%in%round(cfg$boot_p,7),,drop=FALSE]
 z<-vector("list",nrow(target)*cfg$V);i<-0L
 for(k in seq_len(nrow(target)))for(rep in seq_len(cfg$V)) {
  i<-i+1L;z[[i]]<-c(list(id=i,design=target$design_id[k],rep=rep),
                  as.list(target[k,c("DGM","n","P")]))
 };z
}
# When enabled, use an identical point estimator already computed for this
# SAME Monte Carlo dataset. The full bootstrap remains full-refit and unchanged.
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] BOOT-02 EXACT REUSE OF POINT FIT | original line 1140 | function fw69_cached_fit
# [FW102-ANNOT] إذا كانت مجموعة Monte Carlo نفسها ومصدرها نفسه، يُعاد استعمال point fit
# [FW102-ANNOT] بدلا من إعادة حسابه؛ لا تُستبدل الـB إعادة ملاءمة داخل bootstrap.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_cached_fit <- function(cfg, job) {
  if(!isTRUE(getOption("FW72.reuse_mc_point",TRUE)))return(NULL)
  nper<-ceiling(cfg$M/cfg$MC_chunk)
  mid<-as.integer((as.double(job$design)-1)*nper +
                   floor((as.double(job$rep)-1)/cfg$MC_chunk)+1)
  f<-file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS",sprintf("%07d.rds",mid))
  if(!file.exists(f))return(NULL)
  x<-tryCatch(readRDS(f),error=function(e)NULL)
  if(!is.list(x)||!identical(x$signature,cfg$signature)||
     !identical(as.integer(x$design),as.integer(job$design)))return(NULL)
  key<-as.character(job$rep)
  v<-x$boot_point_cache[[key]]
  if(!is.list(v)||!all(c("point","se1","bias2","status","diagnostics")%in%names(v)))return(NULL)
  target_dim<-c(length(cfg$C),length(fw69_targets),length(fw69_methods))
  if(!identical(as.integer(dim(v$point)),as.integer(target_dim)) ||
     !identical(dim(v$se1),dim(v$point)) ||
     !identical(dim(v$bias2),dim(v$point)))return(NULL)
  # An array with NA is a legitimate estimator failure; do not impute it.
  v
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] BOOT-03 FULL-REFIT INCLUDING NUISANCE | original line 1160 | function fw69_boot_task
# [FW102-ANNOT] لكل dataset مختارة تنشئ B=199 إعادة سحب في MF_FULL،
# [FW102-ANNOT] وتعيد تطبيق fw69_estimate بكل nuisance learners والـprojection وfusion.
# [FW102-ANNOT] يحفظ partial B rows ثم checkpoint نهائيًا؛ الفشل الإحصائي يبقى NA.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] نسبة B الناجح المطلوبة min_boot_frac=0.8،
# [FW102-ANNOT] وعدم الاستقرار عند n صغير/low retest قد يؤثر في coverage.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_boot_task <- function(job) {
 cfg<-get("FW69_CFG",.GlobalEnv);ref<-get("FW69_REFS",.GlobalEnv)
 file<-file.path(cfg$out,"BOOT_CHECKPOINTS",sprintf("%07d.rds",job$id))
 start<-proc.time()[3]
 tryCatch({
  old<-if(file.exists(file))tryCatch(readRDS(file),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
  if(is.list(old)&&identical(old$signature,cfg$signature)&&identical(old$B,cfg$B)&&
       identical(old$rep,job$rep)&&identical(old$design,job$design)&&
       is.matrix(old$samples)&&nrow(old$samples)==cfg$B)
    return(list(id=job$id,ok=TRUE,resumed=TRUE,seconds=0))
  rr<-ref[ref$DGM==job$DGM&abs(ref$P-job$P)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(rr))stop("Reference missing")
  s<-fw69_seed(cfg,job$design,job$rep)
  d<-fw69_dgm(job$n,job$P,job$DGM,rr$alpha[1],s)
  original<-fw69_cached_fit(cfg,job)
  if(is.null(original))original<-fw69_estimate(d,cfg,s+12345L)
  K<-length(original$point)
  saved<-matrix(NA_real_,cfg$B,K)
  done<-rep(FALSE,cfg$B)
  if(is.list(old)&&identical(old$signature,cfg$signature)&&
       identical(old$rep,job$rep)&&identical(old$design,job$design)&&
       is.matrix(old$partial)&&identical(dim(old$partial),dim(saved))) {
      saved<-old$partial
      if(length(old$completed_rows)) {
       idx<-as.integer(old$completed_rows)
       idx<-idx[is.finite(idx)&idx>=1L&idx<=cfg$B]
       done[idx]<-TRUE
      }
  }
  progressfile<-file.path(cfg$out,"BOOT_JOB_PROGRESS",sprintf("%07d.csv",job$id))
  # V73: one cluster-index precomputation per dataset, not per bootstrap draw.
  # Identical sampling calls/ordering/RNG to fw69_bootsample; checked preflight.
  sampler<-fw73_make_sampler(d)
  for(b in which(!done)) {
   bs<-sampler(fw69_seed(cfg,job$design,job$rep,200000L+b))
   fit<-fw69_estimate(bs,cfg,fw69_seed(cfg,job$design,job$rep,500000L+b))
   saved[b,]<-as.vector(fit$point)
   done[b]<-TRUE
   if(sum(done)%%cfg$bootstrap_chunk==0||all(done)) {
     fw69_atomic(list(signature=cfg$signature,design=job$design,rep=job$rep,
        B=NA_integer_,completed_rows=which(done),partial=saved),file)
     fw69_csv(data.frame(job=job$id,bootstrap_done=sum(done),B_total=cfg$B,
       pct=round(100*mean(done),2),time=as.character(Sys.time())),progressfile)
     fw69_msg("BOOT worker PID ",Sys.getpid()," job ",job$id," ",sum(done),"/",cfg$B)
   }
  }
  fw69_atomic(list(signature=cfg$signature,rep=job$rep,B=cfg$B,
    design=job$design,completed_rows=seq_len(cfg$B),point=original$point,
    se1=original$se1,bias2=original$bias2,samples=saved,status=original$status,
    diagnostics=original$diagnostics,
    DGM=job$DGM,n=job$n,P=job$P),file)
  list(id=job$id,ok=TRUE,resumed=FALSE,seconds=proc.time()[3]-start)
 },error=function(e){
  msg<-conditionMessage(e)
  fw69_atomic(list(signature=cfg$signature,job=job,error=msg,
    call=paste(deparse(conditionCall(e)),collapse=" "),
    time=as.character(Sys.time())),paste0(file,".error.rds"))
  list(id=job$id,ok=FALSE,error=msg,resumed=FALSE,seconds=proc.time()[3]-start)
 })
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CI-01 THREE EXPLICIT INTERVAL FAMILIES | original line 1220 | function fw69_ci
# [FW102-ANNOT] 1) PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT = empirical quantiles 0.025/0.975 من bootstrap refits.
# [FW102-ANNOT] 2) DELTA1_WORKING = point +/- z_{0.975}*SE1.
# [FW102-ANNOT] 3) FISHER_Z_KAPPA_ONLY = tanh(atanh(kappa) +/- z*SE/(1-kappa^2)).
# [FW102-ANNOT] Fisher transformation لا تُطبَّق على DELTA لأنها قد تقع خارج [-1,1].
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] نجاح الـCI مشروط بنسبة bootstrap valid > 80% تقريباً؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] التغطية الشرطية لا تساوي التغطية غير المشروطة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_ci <- function(point,boots,truth,C,cfg) {
 # Three inference strategies. Delta is a working sandwich for estimated nuisance.
 pvec<-as.vector(point$point);ref<-rep(as.vector(truth),times=length(fw69_methods))
 sevec<-as.vector(point$se1);bmat<-boots
 cov_ci<-function(lo,hi)ifelse(is.finite(lo)&is.finite(hi),
                             as.integer(lo<=ref&ref<=hi),NA_integer_)
 validb<-colSums(is.finite(bmat));minB<-ceiling(cfg$min_boot_frac*cfg$B)
 low<-high<-rep(NA_real_,length(pvec))
 for(j in seq_along(pvec)) {
  z<-bmat[is.finite(bmat[,j]),j]
  if(is.finite(pvec[j])&&length(z)>=minB) {
   q<-as.numeric(stats::quantile(z,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE,type=7))
   low[j]<-q[1];high[j]<-q[2]
  }
 }
 zstat<-stats::qnorm(.975)
 dlo<-ifelse(is.finite(pvec)&is.finite(sevec),pvec-zstat*sevec,NA_real_)
 dhi<-ifelse(is.finite(pvec)&is.finite(sevec),pvec+zstat*sevec,NA_real_)
 # Fisher-z is for bounded kappa K1/KA, never for DELTA with range [-2,2].
 is_k<-rep(rep(c(TRUE,TRUE,FALSE),each=length(C)),times=length(fw69_methods))
 flo<-fhi<-rep(NA_real_,length(pvec))
 okay<-is_k&is.finite(pvec)&abs(pvec)<1-1e-8&is.finite(sevec)&sevec>=0
 flo[okay]<-tanh(atanh(pvec[okay])-zstat*sevec[okay]/(1-pvec[okay]^2))
 fhi[okay]<-tanh(atanh(pvec[okay])+zstat*sevec[okay]/(1-pvec[okay]^2))
 base<-expand.grid(C=C,estimand=fw69_targets,method=fw69_methods,
             KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 base$estimate<-pvec;base$truth<-ref;base$B_success<-validb;base$B_requested<-cfg$B
 z<-list()
 for(method in c("PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT","DELTA1_WORKING","FISHER_Z_KAPPA_ONLY")) {
  left<-switch(method,PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT=low,DELTA1_WORKING=dlo,FISHER_Z_KAPPA_ONLY=flo)
  right<-switch(method,PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT=high,DELTA1_WORKING=dhi,FISHER_Z_KAPPA_ONLY=fhi)
  v<-base;v$interval_method<-method;v$CI_low<-left;v$CI_high<-right
  v$CI_width<-right-left;v$covered<-cov_ci(left,right)
  v$has_valid_ci<-as.integer(!is.na(v$covered))
  z[[method]]<-v
 }
 do.call(rbind,z)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CI-02 VALIDITY AND COVERAGE BY DESIGN | original line 1258 | function fw69_boot_tables
# [FW102-ANNOT] توثّق صلاحية الفترات، coverage, width، وعدم اكتمال checkpoints.
# [FW102-ANNOT] المتابعة: تقييم معايرة CI على الشبكة، مع تجنب إخفاء الفشل.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_boot_tables <- function(jobs,cfg,refs) {
 template<-expand.grid(C=cfg$C,estimand=fw69_targets,method=fw69_methods,
    interval_method=c("PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT","DELTA1_WORKING","FISHER_Z_KAPPA_ONLY"),
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 K<-nrow(template)
 if(!length(jobs))return(list(per_dataset=data.frame(),coverage=data.frame()))
 # Pre-create ALL expected groups; missing jobs remain visible as INCOMPLETE.
 keys<-unique(vapply(jobs,function(j)as.character(j$design),character(1)))
 groups<-setNames(vector("list",length(keys)),keys)
 for(key in keys) {
   j<-jobs[[which(vapply(jobs,function(z)as.character(z$design)==key,logical(1)))[1]]]
   groups[[key]]<-list(meta=j,N=0L,attempted=0L,valid=integer(K),
                       covered=integer(K),sum_width=numeric(K))
 }
 for(j in jobs) {
  key<-as.character(j$design);a<-groups[[key]]
  f<-file.path(cfg$out,"BOOT_CHECKPOINTS",sprintf("%07d.rds",j$id))
  errfile<-paste0(f,".error.rds")
  pf<-file.path(cfg$out,"BOOT_JOB_PROGRESS",sprintf("%07d.csv",j$id))
  if(file.exists(f)||file.exists(errfile)||file.exists(pf))a$attempted<-a$attempted+1L
  v<-if(file.exists(f))tryCatch(readRDS(f),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
  if(is.null(v)||!identical(v$signature,cfg$signature)||
       !identical(v$B,cfg$B)||!identical(v$rep,j$rep)||
       !identical(v$design,j$design)||!is.matrix(v$samples)) {
    groups[[key]]<-a;next
  }
  rr<-refs[refs$DGM==j$DGM&abs(refs$P-j$P)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE]
  x<-fw69_ci(list(point=v$point,se1=v$se1),v$samples,
             fw69_ref_mat(rr,cfg$C),cfg$C,cfg)
  if(nrow(x)!=K)stop("Interval rows do not match design grid")
  yes<-is.finite(x$covered)
  a$N<-a$N+1L;a$valid<-a$valid+as.integer(yes)
  a$covered<-a$covered+as.integer(yes & x$covered==1)
  a$sum_width<-a$sum_width+ifelse(yes & is.finite(x$CI_width),x$CI_width,0)
  groups[[key]]<-a
  if(fw69_flag("FW69_EXPORT_PER_DATASET",FALSE)) {
   path<-file.path(cfg$out,"BOOT_PER_DATASET_CSV",sprintf("DATASET_%07d.csv",j$id))
   x$DGM<-j$DGM;x$n<-j$n;x$P<-j$P;x$rep<-j$rep;fw69_csv(x,path)
  }
 }
 rows<-vector("list",length(groups));pos<-0L
 for(key in names(groups)) {
  g<-groups[[key]];completed<-g$N;attempted<-max(g$attempted,completed)
  planned<-sum(vapply(jobs,function(j)as.character(j$design)==key,logical(1)))
  nv<-g$valid;k<-g$covered
  cp<-ifelse(nv>0,k/pmax(1,nv),NA_real_)
  a<-template
  a$DGM<-g$meta$DGM;a$n<-g$meta$n;a$P<-g$meta$P
  a$N_planned_datasets<-planned
  a$N_attempted_datasets<-attempted
  a$N_completed_jobs<-completed
  a$N_failed_or_interrupted_jobs<-attempted-completed
  a$N_unstarted_jobs<-planned-attempted
  a$N_valid_ci<-nv
  a$CI_success_pct_among_completed<-if(completed)100*nv/completed else NA_real_
  a$CI_success_pct_among_planned<-100*nv/planned
  a$coverage_conditional<-cp
  a$MCSE_coverage<-ifelse(nv>1,sqrt(cp*(1-cp)/nv),NA_real_)
  # Bounding missing intervals as 0 versus 1 is a reporting sensitivity, NOT a CI.
  a$coverage_lower_failure_bound_completed<-if(completed)k/completed else NA_real_
  a$coverage_upper_failure_bound_completed<-if(completed)(k+completed-nv)/completed else NA_real_
  a$coverage_lower_failure_bound_planned<-k/planned
  a$coverage_upper_failure_bound_planned<-(k+planned-nv)/planned
  a$mean_width<-ifelse(nv>0,g$sum_width/pmax(nv,1),NA_real_)
  a$analysis_status<-if(completed<planned)"INCOMPLETE_BOOTSTRAP_JOBS"
      else ifelse(nv<50,"EXPLORATORY_FEW_CI_DATASETS","COVERAGE_ESTIMATE_CHECK_MCSE")
  pos<-pos+1L;rows[[pos]]<-a
 }
 list(per_dataset=data.frame(),coverage=do.call(rbind,rows))
}
# --- PRE-REGISTERED REPORTING / MANUSCRIPT TABLES / FIGURES --------------------
fw69_export_xlsx <- function(tables,path) {
 if(!requireNamespace("openxlsx",quietly=TRUE)) {
  fw69_msg("Excel export skipped: install.packages('openxlsx'). ALL CSVs were saved.")
  return(FALSE)
 }
 wb<-openxlsx::createWorkbook()
 head_style<-openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill="#153451",fontColour="#FFFFFF",textDecoration="bold",
     halign="center",valign="center",border="Bottom",borderColour="#DDE6ED")
 for(nm in names(tables)) {
  x<-tables[[nm]];if(!is.data.frame(x)||!nrow(x))next
  nm<-substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]","_",nm),1,31)
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb,nm,gridLines=FALSE)
  # Excel limit is 1,048,576 rows; truncate NONE: send wide tables to CSV if huge.
  if(nrow(x)>1048000){fw69_msg("Skipped XLSX sheet ",nm," (>Excel row limit); CSV retains all rows");next}
  openxlsx::writeData(wb,nm,x,headerStyle=head_style,withFilter=TRUE)
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb,nm,firstRow=TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb,nm,cols=seq_len(ncol(x)),widths=pmin(38,pmax(12,nchar(names(x))+3)))
  openxlsx::setRowHeights(wb,nm,rows=1,heights=27)
 }
 tryCatch({openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb,path,overwrite=TRUE);TRUE},
    error=function(e){fw69_msg("Excel failed; CSV preserved: ",conditionMessage(e));FALSE})
}
fw69_plot <- function(mc,coverage,comp,cfg) {
 if(!nrow(mc))return(invisible(NULL))
 dir.create(file.path(cfg$out,"FIGURES"),showWarnings=FALSE,recursive=TRUE)
 palette<-c("#153451","#1A8893","#CF8032","#8B4D97","#498D50","#CA545D")
 savefig<-function(name,draw) {
  base<-file.path(cfg$out,"FIGURES",name)
  tryCatch({grDevices::pdf(paste0(base,".pdf"),width=9,height=6,useDingbats=FALSE)
    tryCatch(draw(),finally=grDevices::dev.off())},error=function(e)fw69_msg("PDF plot: ",conditionMessage(e)))
  tryCatch({grDevices::tiff(paste0(base,".tiff"),width=9,height=6,
        units="in",res=600,compression="lzw")
    tryCatch(draw(),finally=grDevices::dev.off())},error=function(e)fw69_msg("TIFF plot: ",conditionMessage(e)))
 }
 drawcurves<-function(tab,y,heading,ylab) {
  tab<-tab[is.finite(tab[[y]]),,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(tab)){plot.new();title("No valid data");return()}
  methods<-unique(tab$method);lim<-range(tab[[y]],finite=TRUE)
  if(diff(lim)==0)lim<-lim+c(-.05,.05)
  graphics::plot(range(cfg$C),lim,type="n",xlab="Weighting index C",ylab=ylab,main=heading)
  graphics::abline(h=if(y=="coverage_conditional") .95 else 0,
                   lty=3,col="grey65")
  for(j in seq_along(methods)) {
   a<-tab[tab$method==methods[j],,drop=FALSE];a<-a[order(a$C),,drop=FALSE]
   graphics::lines(a$C,a[[y]],type="b",lwd=1.7,pch=(j-1)%%6+15,
                    col=palette[(j-1)%%length(palette)+1])
  }
  graphics::legend("topright",legend=methods,lty=1,pch=15+(seq_along(methods)-1)%%6,
    col=palette[(seq_along(methods)-1)%%length(palette)+1],cex=.65,bty="n")
 }
 q<-mc[mc$DGM=="BASE"&mc$n==100&abs(mc$P-.5)<1e-8&mc$estimand=="DELTA"&
    mc$method%in%c("IPW_RAW","HAJEK","CF_RIDGE_RAW","RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED","FUSION_REGULARIZED"),]
 savefig("FIG_01_DELTA_RMSE_VS_C",function()drawcurves(q,"rmse",
    "Paired Delta: RMSE by C (BASE, n=100, P=0.5)","RMSE among valid fits"))
 savefig("FIG_02_DELTA_FAILURE_VS_C",function()drawcurves(q,"failure_pct",
    "Paired Delta: estimation failures by C","Failure percentage (%)"))
 if(nrow(coverage)) {
  u<-coverage[coverage$DGM=="BASE"&coverage$n==100&abs(coverage$P-.5)<1e-8&
    coverage$estimand=="DELTA"&coverage$interval_method=="PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT"&
    coverage$method%in%c("IPW_RAW","HAJEK","RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT","RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED","FUSION_REGULARIZED"),]
  savefig("FIG_03_COVERAGE_CONDITIONAL",function()drawcurves(u,"coverage_conditional",
    "Conditional CI coverage, failures reported separately","Coverage on valid CIs"))
 }
 fw69_csv(mc,file.path(cfg$out,"FIGURES","FIGURE_MC_SOURCE.csv"))
 if(nrow(coverage))fw69_csv(coverage,file.path(cfg$out,"FIGURES","FIGURE_COVERAGE_SOURCE.csv"))
 invisible(TRUE)
}
fw69_summary <- function(cfg,ref,mc,ci,fail,cmp,mc_ok,boot_ok) {
 fw69_csv(ref,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_00_REFERENCE_TRUTH.csv"))
 if(nrow(mc))fw69_csv(mc,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_01_BIAS_RMSE_MCSE.csv"))
 if(nrow(ci$coverage))fw69_csv(ci$coverage,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_02_COVERAGE_AND_FAILURE_BOUNDS.csv"))
 if(nrow(ci$per_dataset))fw69_csv(ci$per_dataset,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_02A_PER_DATASET_CI.csv"))
 if(nrow(fail))fw69_csv(fail,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_03_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS.csv"))
 if(nrow(cmp))fw69_csv(cmp,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_04_PAIRED_RISK_DIFFERENCE.csv"))
 if(nrow(mc)) {
  qc<-stats::aggregate(cbind(N_valid,attempts)~method+estimand,data=mc,FUN=sum)
  qc$success_pct<-100*qc$N_valid/qc$attempts
  fw69_csv(qc,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_05_METHOD_SUCCESS_SUMMARY.csv"))
  # Quantitative interpretation on shared C's, with failures never hidden.
  failure<-mc[mc$estimand=="DELTA"&mc$method%in%c("RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT","FUSION_SITE_STRICT","FUSION_REGULARIZED"),]
  if(nrow(failure))fw69_csv(failure[,c("DGM","n","P","C","method","N_valid","attempts","failure_pct")],
                     file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_06_CRITICAL_FAILURE_GRID.csv"))
 }else qc<-data.frame()
 # Every table remains separate: do not confuse MC failures with CI failures.
 mc05<-if(nrow(mc))mc[abs(mc$C-.5)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE] else data.frame()
 ci05<-if(nrow(ci$coverage))ci$coverage[abs(ci$coverage$C-.5)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE] else data.frame()
 fw69_export_xlsx(list(REFERENCE=ref,MC_C05=mc05,CI_C05=ci05,
      FAILURE_REASONS=fail,PAIRED_MSE=cmp,SUCCESS_SUMMARY=qc),
      file.path(cfg$out,"FWKC_v69_MANUSCRIPT_TABLES.xlsx"))
 # Export ALL nine C levels as separate small Excel workbooks, sequentially;
 # avoids loading the full ~95k-row manuscript grid into a single XLSX in RAM.
 if(nrow(mc)&&requireNamespace("openxlsx",quietly=TRUE)) {
  directory<-file.path(cfg$out,"EXCEL_BY_C");dir.create(directory,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  for(c in cfg$C) {
   from_mc<-if(nrow(mc))mc[abs(mc$C-c)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE] else data.frame()
   from_ci<-if(nrow(ci$coverage))ci$coverage[abs(ci$coverage$C-c)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE] else data.frame()
   from_cmp<-if(nrow(cmp))cmp[abs(cmp$C-c)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE] else data.frame()
   from_ref<-ref[abs(ref$C-c)<1e-8,,drop=FALSE]
   fw69_export_xlsx(list(REFERENCE=from_ref,MC_ALL_N_P=from_mc,
          COVERAGE_SUBSET=from_ci,PAIRED_MSE=from_cmp),
          file.path(directory,sprintf("FWKC_ALL_N_P_C_%02d.xlsx",round(c*10))))
  }
 }
 fw69_plot(mc,ci$coverage,cmp,cfg)
 note<-c(paste("FWKC:",fw69_version),paste("Mode:",cfg$mode),
   paste("MC fully complete:",mc_ok),paste("Bootstrap selected design complete:",boot_ok),
   paste("MC repetitions each n/P/DGM:",cfg$M),paste("Bootstrap independent data sets each selected design:",cfg$V),
   paste("Bootstrap refits per data set:",cfg$B),
   "STOP: Monte Carlo estimate is not automatically publication-ready.",
   "Failures are a scientific outcome; 0 valid CIs != 0% coverage.",
   "Projected and regularized methods change the statistical estimator.",
   "Fusion regularized is a fixed 50/50 exploratory estimator; NEVER uses RF_RAW SE for projection.",
   "Its only supported interval is a fully refitted bootstrap percentile interval when enough resamples succeed.",
   "Delta SE for learned nuisance is a working/sensitivity estimate; full-refit bootstrap preferred.",
   "Bootstrap is cluster-resampling of observed clusters, not two-stage design-based oracle bootstrap.",
   "The TUAH serial test is observational, not randomized selective retesting.",
   "Conditional coverage uses successful intervals only; failure bounds are provided.",
   "Bootstrap denominators distinguish PLANNED, ATTEMPTED, COMPLETED and VALID CIs.",
   "P and C use 0.1..0.9; B is the bootstrap repetition count, not disease prevalence.",
   "Scientific derivations and new estimators require independent peer review.")
 writeLines(note,file.path(cfg$out,"SCIENTIFIC_STATUS_AND_LIMITATIONS.txt"),useBytes=TRUE)
 fw69_msg("Report generated in ",cfg$out)
}
# --- REAL PAIRED DATA: NO FABRICATED RANDOMIZED RETEST -------------------------
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] REAL-01 DATA PROVENANCE | original line 1453 | function fw69_real_load
# [FW102-ANNOT] REAL_PAIRED_FULL يعالج ملاحظات زوجية كاملة؛ ليس تحققًا تجريبيًا
# [FW102-ANNOT] من اختيار إعادة الاختبار الانتقائي بعينات سريرية ذات propensity معلومة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_real_load <- function(book) {
 if(!requireNamespace("readxl",quietly=TRUE))stop("install.packages('readxl')")
 sheets<-readxl::excel_sheets(book)
 if(!"REAL_PAIRED_FULL"%in%sheets)stop("REAL_PAIRED_FULL worksheet is required for the serial paired analysis")
 raw<-as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(book,sheet="REAL_PAIRED_FULL"))
 names(raw)<-tolower(names(raw))
 if(!all(c("d","t1","t2")%in%names(raw)))stop("Required: D, T1, T2 in REAL_PAIRED_FULL")
 if(anyNA(raw[,c("d","t1","t2")]))stop("Missing serial T2; this analysis requires fully observed paired values")
 if(any(!as.numeric(unlist(raw[,c("d","t1","t2")]))%in%c(0,1)))stop("D,T1,T2 must be 0/1")
 if("patient_id"%in%names(raw)&&anyDuplicated(raw$patient_id))stop("Duplicate patient_id; resolve patient-level clustering first")
 n<-nrow(raw);if(n<10)stop("Not enough rows for paired analysis")
 d<-data.frame(d=as.integer(raw$d),t1=as.integer(raw$t1),t2=as.integer(raw$t2),
      r=as.integer(raw$t1==0),pi=ifelse(raw$t1==0,1,NA_real_),
      x=rep(0,n),site=if("site"%in%names(raw))as.character(raw$site) else seq_len(n))
 d
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] REAL-02 INTERPRETATION BOUNDARY | original line 1469 | function fw69_real
# [FW102-ANNOT] التحليل الواقعي يقدر K1,KA,DELTA ويستخدم cluster bootstrap؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] يحافظ على ترابط القراءتين/المريض؛ ولا ينبغي وصفه بأنه Randomized Retest.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_real <- function(book,cfg) {
 d<-fw69_real_load(book);fw69_check_data(d)
 out<-file.path(dirname(book),"FWKC_v69_REAL_RESULTS");dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
 y<-as.numeric(ifelse(d$t1==1,1,d$t2))
 dd<-fw69_paired_delta(d,y,cfg$C);m<-fw69_moments(d,y)
 rows<-expand.grid(C=cfg$C,estimand=fw69_targets,KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 rows$estimate<-as.vector(dd[, ,"estimate"])
 rows$paired_delta_SE<-as.vector(dd[, ,"se1"])
 rows$second_order_bias_approx<-as.vector(dd[, ,"bias2"])
 rows$second_order_SE_sensitivity<-as.vector(dd[, ,"se2"])
 df<-min(dd[, ,"df"],na.rm=TRUE);if(!is.finite(df))df<-nrow(d)-1
 q<-stats::qt(.975,df=max(1,df))
 rows$delta_low<-rows$estimate-q*rows$paired_delta_SE
 rows$delta_high<-rows$estimate+q*rows$paired_delta_SE
 B<-fw69_int("FW69_REAL_BOOT_B",999,49,10000)
 file<-file.path(out,"REAL_PAIRED_BOOTSTRAP_CHECKPOINT.rds")
 sig<-fw69_sig(list(md5=unname(tools::md5sum(book)),source=fw69_version,
       source_hash=fw69_source_hash(),
       B=B,seed=cfg$seed,method="PARTICIPANT_CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP"))
 old<-if(file.exists(file))tryCatch(readRDS(file),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
 zz<-if(is.list(old)&&identical(old$sig,sig)&&is.matrix(old$samples)
        &&ncol(old$samples)==nrow(rows))old$samples else matrix(NA_real_,B,nrow(rows))
 done<-if(is.list(old)&&identical(old$sig,sig))old$done else integer()
 for(i in seq_len(B)) {
  if(i%in%done)next
  bs<-fw69_bootsample(d,fw69_seed(cfg,1,1,300000L+i))
  yy<-as.numeric(ifelse(bs$t1==1,1,bs$t2));v<-fw69_paired_delta(bs,yy,cfg$C)
  zz[i,]<-as.vector(v[, ,"estimate"]);done<-c(done,i)
  if(i%%25==0||i==B) {
   fw69_atomic(list(sig=sig,done=done,samples=zz),file)
   fw69_msg("REAL paired bootstrap ",i,"/",B," (",round(100*i/B,1),"%)")
  }
 }
 rows$B_success<-colSums(is.finite(zz));rows$B_requested<-B
 rows$bootstrap_low<-rows$bootstrap_high<-NA_real_
 for(j in seq_len(ncol(zz))) {
  vals<-zz[is.finite(zz[,j]),j]
  if(length(vals)>=ceiling(cfg$min_boot_frac*B)) {
   quant<-as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE))
   rows$bootstrap_low[j]<-quant[1];rows$bootstrap_high[j]<-quant[2]
  }
 }
 rows$n<-nrow(d);rows$data_type<-"OBSERVED_SERIAL_PAIRED_NOT_RANDOMIZED"
 dx<-data.frame(D=d$d,T1=d$t1,TA=y)
 diag<-function(tst) {
  a<-sum(d$d==1&tst==1);b<-sum(d$d==0&tst==1)
  c<-sum(d$d==1&tst==0);d0<-sum(d$d==0&tst==0)
  data.frame(N=length(tst),TP=a,FP=b,FN=c,TN=d0,
   sensitivity=if(a+c>0)a/(a+c) else NA_real_,
   specificity=if(b+d0>0)d0/(b+d0) else NA_real_,
   PPV=if(a+b>0)a/(a+b) else NA_real_,
   NPV=if(c+d0>0)d0/(c+d0) else NA_real_)
 }
 metrics<-rbind(cbind(test="T1",diag(d$t1)),cbind(test="T_ALL_OR",diag(y)))
 fw69_csv(rows,file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_REAL_PAIRED_KAPPA_DELTA.csv"))
 fw69_csv(metrics,file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_REAL_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.csv"))
 fw69_export_xlsx(list(PAIRED_KAPPA=rows,DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS=metrics),
        file.path(out,"FWKC_v69_REAL_MANUSCRIPT.xlsx"))
 writeLines(c("The second reading is longitudinal/serial in REAL_PAIRED_FULL.",
  "No randomization or known selective retest propensity has been inferred.",
  "The patient-linked T1 and T2 rows remain together in bootstrap sampling.",
  "If site identifies genuine independent centers, cluster resampling uses those centers.",
  "The meaning of reference D at each measurement time needs clinical verification."),
  file.path(out,"REAL_INTERPRETATION_WARNING.txt"))
 fw69_msg("REAL finished: ",out);invisible(out)
}
# --- QUALITY ASSURANCE ----------------------------------------------------------
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] QA-01 NUMERICAL AND DESIGN ASSERTIONS | original line 1536 | function fw69_qa
# [FW102-ANNOT] اختبارات التحليل والاشتقاقات ومساواة Hájek/AIPW_strata واستخدام RF الفعلي
# [FW102-ANNOT] وتطابق الإصدارات/الجداول. PASS ليس برهان asymptotic nor journal accept.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_qa <- function(cfg) {
 # Prefer user-configured directory, then current folder, then writable tempdir.
 # A Windows redirect/OneDrive Documents folder may no longer be writable.
 requested<-Sys.getenv("FW69_QA_OUTPUT_DIR",unset="")
 choices<-unique(c(if(nzchar(requested))requested else character(),
                   file.path(tryCatch(getwd(),error=function(e)tempdir()),"FWKC_v69_1_QA_RESULTS"),
                   file.path(tempdir(),"FWKC_v69_1_QA_RESULTS")))
 out<-NULL
 for(candidate in choices) {
   usable<-tryCatch({
     dir.create(candidate,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
     probe<-tempfile(".fw69_qa_",tmpdir=candidate)
     success<-file.create(probe)
     if(success)unlink(probe)
     success
   },error=function(e)FALSE,warning=function(w)FALSE)
   if(isTRUE(usable)){out<-candidate;break}
 }
 if(is.null(out))stop("No writable QA output directory; set FW69_QA_OUTPUT_DIR")
 fw69_msg("QA output directory: ",out)
 cfg$rf_trees<-min(max(cfg$rf_trees,40L),60L)
 cfg$bayes_draws<-64L
 if(!cfg$skip_rf && !requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE)) {
   fw69_csv(data.frame(check="RANGER_INSTALLED",status="FAIL",detail="Install ranger"),
      file.path(out,"QA_GATE.csv"))
   stop("QA requires ranger to test ACTUAL RF. Install it or set FW69_SKIP_RF=1 for NO-RF diagnostic QA")
 }
 ref<-fw69_kappa(554/620,495/620,473/620,.5)
 stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(ref,.37343014128728486,tolerance=1e-13)))
 z<-c(.5,.6,.4);diffs<-numeric()
 for(cc in c(.1,.5,.9)) {
  base<-fw69_gradient_hessian(z,cc);h<-1e-5
  f<-function(x)fw69_kappa(x[1],x[2],x[3],cc)
  ng<-numeric(3);nh<-matrix(0,3,3)
  for(i in 1:3) {
   e<-rep(0,3);e[i]<-h;ng[i]<-(f(z+e)-f(z-e))/(2*h)
   for(j in 1:3) {
    e2<-rep(0,3);e2[j]<-h
    nh[i,j]<-(f(z+e+e2)-f(z+e-e2)-f(z-e+e2)+f(z-e-e2))/(4*h*h)
   }
  }
  diffs<-c(diffs,max(abs(ng-base$gradient)),max(abs(nh-base$hessian)))
 }
 if(max(diffs)>1e-4)stop("Analytic gradient/Hessian QA failed")
 d<-fw69_dgm(400L,.5,"BASE",fw69_alpha(.5,.35),12345L)
 a<-fw69_estimate(d,cfg,5001L)
 ha<-a$point[, ,"HAJEK"];st<-a$point[, ,"AIPW_STRATA_RAW"]
 if(!isTRUE(all.equal(ha,st,tolerance=1e-12,check.attributes=FALSE)))
     stop("HAJEK/AIPW_STRATA algebra failed")
 # All methods that DEFINE DELTA as KA-K1 must satisfy that identity.
 # Historical v67 FUSION is the single documented exception: it combines
 # the THREE targets separately with target-specific inverse-SE weights.
 # Rejecting that definition with a blanket paired-identity assertion is an
 # incorrect QA test, not evidence that the paired observations were lost.
 coherent_methods<-setdiff(fw69_methods,"FUSION_SITE_STRICT")
 for(m in coherent_methods) {
   zz<-a$point[,,m]
   base_ok<-is.finite(zz[,1])&is.finite(zz[,2])
   if(any(base_ok&!is.finite(zz[,3])))
       stop("Paired DELTA missing despite finite K1/KA: ",m)
   if(any(base_ok)) {
     residual<-zz[base_ok,3]-(zz[base_ok,2]-zz[base_ok,1])
     if(max(abs(residual))>1e-11)
         stop("Paired DELTA identity failed: ",m)
   }
 }
 # Exact v67-style target-specific strict Fusion formula, checked separately.
 expected_fusion<-matrix(NA_real_,nrow=length(cfg$C),ncol=length(fw69_targets))
 for(i in seq_along(cfg$C))for(j in seq_along(fw69_targets)) {
   bay<-a$point[i,j,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]
   rf<-a$point[i,j,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]
   sbay<-a$se1[i,j,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]
   srf<-a$se1[i,j,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"]
   if(all(is.finite(c(bay,rf,sbay,srf)))&&sbay>0&&srf>0) {
     weight_bay<-srf/(sbay+srf)
     expected_fusion[i,j]<-weight_bay*bay+(1-weight_bay)*rf
   }
 }
 observed_fusion<-a$point[, ,"FUSION_SITE_STRICT"]
 if(any(xor(is.finite(expected_fusion),is.finite(observed_fusion))))
     stop("Strict Fusion availability does not match target-specific v67 formula")
 fusion_finite<-is.finite(expected_fusion)
 if(!any(fusion_finite) && !cfg$skip_rf)
     stop("Seeded QA produced no testable strict Fusion cells: inspect Bayes/RF fit and SE")
 fusion_formula_maxdiff<-if(any(fusion_finite))
     max(abs(expected_fusion[fusion_finite]-observed_fusion[fusion_finite]))
   else NA_real_
 if(is.finite(fusion_formula_maxdiff)&&fusion_formula_maxdiff>1e-11)
     stop("Strict Fusion target-specific weighted formula failed")
 fusion_gap<-observed_fusion[,3]-(observed_fusion[,2]-observed_fusion[,1])
 fw69_csv(data.frame(C=cfg$C,strict_K1=observed_fusion[,1],
       strict_KA=observed_fusion[,2],strict_DELTA_direct=observed_fusion[,3],
       difference_of_strict_KA_K1=observed_fusion[,2]-observed_fusion[,1],
       target_specific_weighting_gap=fusion_gap,
       historical_definition="THREE_SEPARATE_TARGET_WEIGHTINGS",stringsAsFactors=FALSE),
       file.path(out,"QA_FUSION_TARGET_SPECIFIC_AUDIT.csv"))
 if(!cfg$skip_rf) {
   if(!any(is.finite(a$point[,,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"])))
      stop("Real ranger fitted but strict RF did not yield any finite result")
 }
 # Unobserved eligible group must remain unidentifiable; never invent T2.
 bad<-d;ix<-which(bad$t1==0);bad$r[ix]<-0L;bad$t2[ix]<-NA_real_
 b<-fw69_estimate(bad,cfg,6500L)
 if(any(is.finite(b$point[, ,"RF_AIPW_SITE_STRICT"])))
       stop("No-retest identifiability gate failed")
 # Verify the projection feasibility and that Fusion has no borrowed analytic SE.
 proj<-fw69_project_moments(c(.5,1.1,.8))
 if(!all(is.finite(proj))||proj[3]>min(proj[1],proj[2])+1e-12||
       proj[2]-proj[3]>1-proj[1]+1e-12)stop("Simplex projection failed")
 if(any(is.finite(a$se1[, ,"FUSION_REGULARIZED"])))
      stop("Exploratory Fusion SE was not disabled")
 workers<-min(4L,cfg$cores)
 # Prevent oversubscription: 4 PSOCK processes x 1 BLAS/RF thread each.
 Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
            BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1",RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS="1")
 cl<-parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers,outfile="")
 on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl),add=TRUE)
 fn<-ls(envir=.GlobalEnv,pattern="^fw69_")
 fn<-fn[vapply(fn,function(x)is.function(get(x,envir=.GlobalEnv)),logical(1))]
 parallel::clusterExport(cl,c(fn,"fw69_methods","fw69_targets"),envir=.GlobalEnv)
 parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl,{Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
              MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1");NULL})
 t1<-system.time(lapply(1:workers,function(i)fw69_estimate(d,cfg,5001L)))["elapsed"]
 t2<-system.time(pp<-parallel::parLapply(cl,as.list(1:workers),
                         function(i)fw69_estimate(d,cfg,5001L)))["elapsed"]
 cmp<-function(x,y) {
   x<-as.vector(x);y<-as.vector(y)
   if(any(xor(is.finite(x),is.finite(y))))return(Inf)
   if(!any(is.finite(x)))return(NA_real_)
   max(abs(x[is.finite(x)]-y[is.finite(y)]))
 }
 differences<-vapply(pp,function(x)cmp(x$point,a$point),numeric(1))
 if(any(!is.finite(differences))||max(differences)>1e-10)
      stop("Serial versus PSOCK numerical parity failed")
 # Original v67 submethod parity on the same dataset and identical draws.
 legacy_diff<-NA_real_
 if(fw69_flag("FW69_QA_LEGACY",TRUE)) {
   fw69_restore_v67()
   assess<-function(x,y){
     x<-as.vector(x);y<-as.vector(y)
     if(length(x)!=length(y)||any(xor(is.finite(x),is.finite(y))))return(Inf)
     good<-is.finite(x)&is.finite(y)
     if(!any(good))return(NA_real_)
     max(abs(x[good]-y[good]))
   }
   old_ipw<-fw67_infer(d,fw69_y_ipw(d),cfg$C)
   old_hajek<-fw67_infer(d,fw67_hajek(d),cfg$C)
   old_bayes<-fw67_pseudo_bayes(d,list(C=cfg$C,draws=cfg$bayes_draws),5401L)
   compare<-data.frame(method=c("IPW_RAW","HAJEK","BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"),
       max_absolute_difference=c(assess(old_ipw,a$point[, ,"IPW_RAW"]),
           assess(old_hajek,a$point[, ,"HAJEK"]),
           if(!is.null(old_bayes))assess(old_bayes[, ,1],
               a$point[, ,"BAYES_PSEUDO_FORMULA_V67"]) else NA_real_))
   fw69_csv(compare,file.path(out,"QA_MATCHED_V67_FORMULAS.csv"))
   if(any(!is.finite(compare$max_absolute_difference)))
       stop("Unverified legacy comparison: all three compared methods must have finite discrepancies")
   if(any(compare$max_absolute_difference>1e-10))
       stop("Matched v67 submethod parity failed; review QA_MATCHED_V67_FORMULAS.csv")
   legacy_diff<-max(compare$max_absolute_difference)
 }
 # QA CI denominators under missing jobs, using synthetic checkpoint-free jobs.
 qa_checks<-data.frame(check=c("CASS_620","ANALYTIC_DERIVATIVES",
   "HAJEK_EQUALS_STRATA_AIPW","PAIRED_DELTA","NO_RETEST_NOT_IDENTIFIED",
   "SIMPLEX_PROJECTION","FUSION_NO_PROXY_SE","PSOCK_NUMERIC_PARITY",
   "ACTUAL_RF_EXECUTED","MATCHED_V67_SUBMETHODS",
   "FUSION_V67_TARGET_SPECIFIC_FORMULA"),
   status=c(rep("PASS",8),if(cfg$skip_rf)"SKIPPED_BY_USER" else "PASS",
           if(fw69_flag("FW69_QA_LEGACY",TRUE) && is.finite(legacy_diff))"PASS" else "FAIL",
           if(is.finite(fusion_formula_maxdiff))"PASS" else "NOT_TESTABLE_NO_VALID_STRICT_FUSION"),
   metric=c(ref,max(diffs),0,0,0,0,0,max(differences),
            if(cfg$skip_rf)0 else 1,legacy_diff,fusion_formula_maxdiff),
   stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 fw69_csv(qa_checks,file.path(out,"QA_GATE.csv"))
 fw69_csv(data.frame(workers=workers,rf_disabled=cfg$skip_rf,
     max_abs_difference=max(differences),serial_seconds=unname(t1),
     parallel_seconds=unname(t2),speedup_observed=as.numeric(t1)/max(1e-9,as.numeric(t2))),
     file.path(out,"QA_SERIAL_VS_PSOCK.csv"))
 fw69_msg("QA finished; actual RF=",!cfg$skip_rf,"; outputs: ",out)
 invisible(out)
}
# --- SCIENTIFIC GATES, SIGNATURES, AND AUTORUN ----------------------------------
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] REPRODUCIBILITY-02 INPUT AND RUN SIGNATURE | original line 1717 | function fw69_prepare
# [FW102-ANNOT] output directory بجوار XLSX: FWKC_v69_RESULTS/RUN_<signature>؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] signature يتضمن code hash وworkbook hash والإعدادات/نسخ الحزم.
# [FW102-ANNOT] التعليق الجديد يغيّر code hash بلا تغيير تنفيذ المقدّرات؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] تشغيل النسخة المشروحة سيحتاج QA/signatures جديدة وليس استئنافًا آمنًا.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_prepare <- function(book,cfg) {
 dir.create(dirname(book),showWarnings=FALSE,recursive=TRUE)
 payload<-list(version=fw69_version,source_hash=fw69_source_hash(),
    book_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(book)),
    R_version=R.version.string,
    ranger_version=if(requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE))
      as.character(utils::packageVersion("ranger")) else "ABSENT",
    mode=cfg$mode,settings=cfg[names(cfg)!="out"])
 cfg$signature<-substr(fw69_sig(payload),1,16)
 cfg$out<-file.path(dirname(book),"FWKC_v69_RESULTS",paste0("RUN_",cfg$signature))
 dir.create(cfg$out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
 writeLines(c(paste("Version",fw69_version),paste("Workbook",normalizePath(book,winslash="/")),
   paste("Workbook md5",unname(tools::md5sum(book))),paste("Signature",cfg$signature),
   paste("DGM",paste(cfg$dgms,collapse=",")),paste("n",paste(cfg$n,collapse=",")),
   paste("P",paste(cfg$P,collapse=",")),paste("C",paste(cfg$C,collapse=",")),
   paste("PSOCK cores",cfg$cores),paste("R version",R.version.string),
   paste("ranger",if(requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE))as.character(packageVersion("ranger")) else "NOT_INSTALLED"),
   paste("readxl",if(requireNamespace("readxl",quietly=TRUE))as.character(packageVersion("readxl")) else "NOT_INSTALLED")),
   file.path(cfg$out,"RUN_MANIFEST.txt"))
 cfg
}
fw69_run <- function(book=NULL,mode=NULL) {
 mode<-toupper(if(is.null(mode))fw69_env("FW69_MODE","QA") else mode)
 cfg<-fw69_cfg(mode)
 if(mode=="QA")return(fw69_qa(cfg))
 if(mode%in%c("LEGACY_POINT","LEGACY_FULL","LEGACY_QA")) {
  fw69_restore_v67()
  if(is.null(book))book<-if(interactive())file.choose() else fw69_env("FW69_INPUT","")
  return(fw67_run(book,if(mode=="LEGACY_POINT")"ORIGINAL_POINT" else
        if(mode=="LEGACY_FULL")"ORIGINAL_FULL" else "QA"))
 }
 if(is.null(book)) {
  fw69_msg("Choose Excel input: historical RUN_CONFIG for simulation or REAL_PAIRED_FULL for real data")
  book<-if(interactive())file.choose() else fw69_env("FW69_INPUT","")
 }
 if(!file.exists(book))stop("Excel file not found. Set FW69_INPUT or select an Excel workbook")
 book<-normalizePath(book,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE)
 if(!requireNamespace("readxl",quietly=TRUE))stop("Install required package: readxl")
 sheets<-readxl::excel_sheets(book)
 if(mode=="AUTO")mode<-if("RUN_CONFIG"%in%sheets)"PILOT" else "REAL"
 cfg<-fw69_cfg(mode);fw69_validate_cfg(cfg)
 if(mode=="REAL")return(fw69_real(book,cfg))
 if(!mode%in%c("SMOKE","PILOT","FULL","SIMULATION"))stop("Invalid run mode: ",mode)
 if(!"RUN_CONFIG"%in%sheets)stop("RUN_CONFIG historical worksheet missing")
 cfg<-fw69_prepare(book,cfg)
 design<-fw69_design(cfg);jobs<-fw69_mc_jobs(design,cfg);bjobs<-fw69_boot_jobs(design,cfg)
 plan<-data.frame(DGM=length(cfg$dgms),n=length(cfg$n),P=length(cfg$P),C=length(cfg$C),
    independent_MC_datasets=nrow(design)*cfg$M,
    design_cells=nrow(design)*length(cfg$C),
    bootstrap_datasets=length(bjobs),planned_bootstrap_refits=length(bjobs)*cfg$B,
    planned_MC_jobs=length(jobs),cores=cfg$cores)
 fw69_csv(plan,file.path(cfg$out,"RUN_COST_PLAN.csv"))
 fw69_csv(design,file.path(cfg$out,"FULL_DESIGN_GRID.csv"))
 stage<-function(name,details="")fw69_atomic(list(phase=name,time=as.character(Sys.time()),
       details=details,signature=cfg$signature),file.path(cfg$out,"RUN_STATE.rds"))
 if(mode=="FULL" && !fw69_flag("FW69_HEAVY_ACK",FALSE)) {
  stage("NOT_STARTED_FULL_REQUIRES_ACK","Review RUN_COST_PLAN.csv; set FW69_HEAVY_ACK=1")
  fw69_msg("FULL blocked before costly work. See RUN_COST_PLAN.csv")
  return(invisible(cfg$out))
 }
 if(!cfg$skip_rf&&!requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE)) {
  stage("NOT_STARTED_MISSING_RANGER","Install ranger; strict RF cannot be replaced silently")
  stop("Install ranger for the RF comparison; use FW69_SKIP_RF=1 only for labelled diagnostics")
 }
 if(fw69_flag("FW69_PREFLIGHT",TRUE)) {
   stage("RUNNING_PREFLIGHT_QA")
   tryCatch(fw69_qa(cfg),error=function(e){
     stage("FAILED_PREFLIGHT_QA",conditionMessage(e));stop(e)
   })
 }
 fw69_msg("START ",mode," | designs=",nrow(design)," | MC=",plan$independent_MC_datasets,
        " | bootstrap refits=",plan$planned_bootstrap_refits," | PSOCK=",cfg$cores)
 ref_file<-file.path(cfg$out,"REFERENCE_TRUTH.rds")
 if(file.exists(ref_file))refs<-readRDS(ref_file) else {
  sets<-unique(design[,c("DGM","P")]);all<-vector("list",nrow(sets))
  for(k in seq_len(nrow(sets))) {
   all[[k]]<-fw69_truth(sets$DGM[k],sets$P[k],cfg,paste0(sets$DGM[k],"_",sets$P[k]))
   if(k%%5==0||k==nrow(sets))fw69_msg("Reference ",k,"/",nrow(sets))
  }
  refs<-do.call(rbind,all);fw69_atomic(refs,ref_file)
 }
 fw69_csv(refs,file.path(cfg$out,"MANUSCRIPT_00_REFERENCE_TRUTH.csv"))
 assign("FW69_CFG",cfg,envir=.GlobalEnv);assign("FW69_REFS",refs,envir=.GlobalEnv)
 stage("RUNNING_MC")
 mc_ok<-tryCatch(fw69_pool(jobs,fw69_mc_task,cfg,"MC","MC_CHECKPOINTS"),
    error=function(e){stage("FAILED_MC_ENGINE",conditionMessage(e));stop(e)})
 mt<-fw69_mc_tables(design,cfg)
 empty<-list(per_dataset=data.frame(),coverage=data.frame())
 fw69_summary(cfg,refs,mt$mc,empty,mt$failures,mt$compare,mc_ok,FALSE)
 if(!mc_ok) {
  stage("INCOMPLETE_MC","Resume with identical code, workbook and environment settings")
  fw69_msg("INCOMPLETE_MC, NOT DONE. Results are exploratory until resumed")
  return(invisible(cfg$out))
 }
 if(!length(bjobs)) {
  stage("COMPLETE_MC_NO_BOOTSTRAP","No interval coverage was scheduled")
  fw69_msg("COMPLETE_MC_NO_BOOTSTRAP (NOT INFERENCE COMPLETE)")
  return(invisible(cfg$out))
 }
 stage("RUNNING_BOOTSTRAP")
 boot_ok<-tryCatch(fw69_pool(bjobs,fw69_boot_task,cfg,"BOOT","BOOT_CHECKPOINTS"),
    error=function(e){stage("FAILED_BOOT_ENGINE",conditionMessage(e));stop(e)})
 ci<-fw69_boot_tables(bjobs,cfg,refs)
 fw69_summary(cfg,refs,mt$mc,ci,mt$failures,mt$compare,mc_ok,boot_ok)
 if(boot_ok) {
  stage("COMPLETE","All scheduled MC and bootstrap jobs have checkpoints")
  fw69_msg("COMPLETE. Scientific calibration and method selection still require assessment")
 } else {
  stage("INCOMPLETE_BOOTSTRAP","Reports contain incomplete coverage denominators")
  fw69_msg("INCOMPLETE_BOOTSTRAP, NOT DONE. Resume after reviewing job failures")
 }
 invisible(cfg$out)
}
# Legacy source is stored byte-for-byte as compressed hex below; can be extracted
# when user deliberately selects LEGACY_QA/LEGACY_POINT/LEGACY_FULL.
fw69_restore_v67 <- function(path=NULL) {
 if(!exists("fw69_v67_hex",envir=.GlobalEnv))stop("Legacy archive not embedded")
 rawhex<-paste(fw69_v67_hex,collapse="")
 bytes<-as.raw(strtoi(substring(rawhex,seq(1,nchar(rawhex),2),seq(2,nchar(rawhex),2)),16L))
 contents<-memDecompress(bytes,type="xz")
 target<-if(is.null(path))tempfile("FWKC_v67_original_",fileext=".txt") else path
 con<-file(target,"wb");writeBin(contents,con);close(con)
 expected<-"5e2c5cb2b4ed027b5bd8bf2383205457"
 if(!identical(unname(tools::md5sum(target)),expected))stop("Legacy archive checksum FAILED")
 old<-Sys.getenv("FWKC_V67_SKIP_AUTORUN",unset="")
 on.exit(Sys.setenv(FWKC_V67_SKIP_AUTORUN=old),add=TRUE)
 Sys.setenv(FWKC_V67_SKIP_AUTORUN="1")
 source(target,encoding="UTF-8",local=.GlobalEnv)
 if(is.null(path))unlink(target)
 fw69_msg("Restored exact v67 archive and verified checksum")
 invisible(TRUE)
}

# Retain source-file provenance even if the user later calls fw69_run() manually.
fw69_capture_codefile <- function() {
  fr<-sys.frames();paths<-character()
  for(f in fr)if(exists("ofile",f,inherits=FALSE)) {
    q<-get("ofile",f,inherits=FALSE)
    if(is.character(q)&&length(q)==1L&&file.exists(q))paths<-c(paths,q)
  }
  if(length(paths))assign("FW69_CODEFILE",normalizePath(tail(paths,1),winslash="/"),envir=.GlobalEnv)
  invisible(NULL)
}
fw69_capture_codefile()

fw69_run_one_click <- function(...) fw69_run(...)
fwkc_run <- function(...) fw69_run(...)
fw_run <- fwkc_run

# Nonthrowing error logger: first try the working directory, then tempdir().
# The first error must NEVER be obscured by a secondary write-permission error.
fw69_log_fatal <- function(e) {
 notes<-c(paste("Time:",format(Sys.time(),"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
          paste("FWKC version:",fw69_version),
          paste("Error:",conditionMessage(e)),
          paste("Call:",paste(deparse(conditionCall(e)),collapse=" ")))
 dirs<-unique(c(tryCatch(getwd(),error=function(x)""),tempdir()))
 for(d in dirs) {
   if(!nzchar(d))next
   p<-file.path(d,"FWKC_v69_1_FATAL_ERROR.txt")
   written<-tryCatch({writeLines(notes,p,useBytes=TRUE);TRUE},
        error=function(x)FALSE,warning=function(x)FALSE)
   if(written) {
      fw69_msg("Fatal error details saved: ",p)
      return(invisible(p))
   }
 }
 fw69_msg("Could not write fatal log to workdir or tempdir; original error remains above")
 invisible(NULL)
}

# ONE-CLICK in interactive RStudio; workers do not source this file.
if((interactive()||identical(Sys.getenv("FW69_FORCE_RUN","0"),"1")) &&
   Sys.getenv("FW69_SKIP_AUTORUN","0")!="1") {
 tryCatch(fw69_run(),error=function(e) {
  fw69_msg("RUN FAILED: ",conditionMessage(e))
  fw69_msg("Check ERROR_LOG.csv / checkpoints; never assume completion.")
  try(fw69_log_fatal(e),silent=TRUE)
  stop(conditionMessage(e),call.=FALSE)
 })
}
