# ==============================================================================
# FWKC MANUSCRIPT EXECUTION CONTROLLER (embedded in standalone TXT)
# The source engine above has been included verbatim; no estimator edits.
# SINGLE FILE, NO SECOND R FILE REQUIRED.
# RStudio: source(file.choose(), encoding="UTF-8") -> choose THIS TXT, then Excel.
# Default: SMOKE. For the costly study explicitly set FWKC_PUB_STAGE="FULL"
# and FWKC_PUB_APPROVE="YES" after SMOKE passes.
# ==============================================================================

fw_pub_env <- function(name, default) {
  value <- Sys.getenv(name, unset = "")
  if (nzchar(value)) value else as.character(default)
}
fw_pub_path <- function() {
  frames <- sys.frames()
  found <- character()
  for (fr in frames) {
    if (exists("ofile", envir = fr, inherits = FALSE)) {
      p <- get("ofile", envir = fr, inherits = FALSE)
      if (is.character(p) && length(p) == 1L && file.exists(p)) found <- c(found, p)
    }
  }
  if (!length(found) && exists("FW69_CODEFILE", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
    p <- get("FW69_CODEFILE", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
    if (is.character(p) && length(p) == 1L && file.exists(p)) found <- c(found, p)
  }
  if (!length(found)) stop("Cannot locate standalone TXT. Run source(file.choose()) from RStudio.")
  normalizePath(tail(found, 1L), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}
fw_pub_safe_lines <- function(lines, path) {
  tryCatch({
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    writeLines(enc2utf8(as.character(lines)), path, useBytes = TRUE)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) { message("Cannot write ", path, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); FALSE })
}
fw_pub_checksum <- function(file) unname(tools::md5sum(file))
fw_pub_read_state <- function(output) {
  path <- file.path(output, "RUN_STATE.rds")
  if (!file.exists(path)) return("NO_RUN_STATE")
  x <- tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.list(x) || is.null(x$phase)) "STATE_UNREADABLE" else as.character(x$phase)
}
fw_pub_report <- function(output, cfg, stage, script_hash, input_hash) {
  # This checks computational completion, not assumptions/validity of the DGM.
  dir.create(output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  checks <- list()
  add <- function(name, result, detail) {
    checks[[length(checks) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
      check = name, status = result, detail = as.character(detail),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  phase <- fw_pub_read_state(output)
  add("RUN_STATE_COMPLETE", if (phase == "COMPLETE") "PASS" else "STOP",
      paste("Actual phase:", phase))
  mc_file <- file.path(output, "MANUSCRIPT_01_BIAS_RMSE_MCSE.csv")
  ref_file <- file.path(output, "MANUSCRIPT_00_REFERENCE_TRUTH.csv")
  ci_file <- file.path(output, "MANUSCRIPT_02_COVERAGE_AND_FAILURE_BOUNDS.csv")
  expected_mc <- length(cfg$dgms) * length(cfg$n) * length(cfg$P) *
    length(cfg$C) * length(fw69_targets) * length(fw69_methods)
  expected_ref <- length(cfg$dgms) * length(cfg$P) *
    length(cfg$C) * length(fw69_targets)
  mc <- if (file.exists(mc_file)) tryCatch(utils::read.csv(mc_file), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  ref <- if (file.exists(ref_file)) tryCatch(utils::read.csv(ref_file), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  ci <- if (file.exists(ci_file)) tryCatch(utils::read.csv(ci_file), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  add("REFERENCE_ROWS", if (!is.null(ref) && nrow(ref) == expected_ref) "PASS" else "STOP",
      sprintf("Found %s; expected %s", if (is.null(ref)) "missing" else nrow(ref), expected_ref))
  if (!is.null(ref) && all(c("truth", "reference_mcse") %in% names(ref))) {
    ok <- all(is.finite(ref$truth)) && all(is.finite(ref$reference_mcse))
    add("REFERENCE_FINITE", if (ok) "PASS" else "REVIEW", "Reference truth and MCSE must be finite")
  } else add("REFERENCE_FINITE", "STOP", "Reference truth or MCSE field absent")
  add("MONTE_CARLO_GRID", if (!is.null(mc) && nrow(mc) == expected_mc) "PASS" else "STOP",
      sprintf("Found %s; expected %s", if (is.null(mc)) "missing" else nrow(mc), expected_mc))
  if (!is.null(mc) && all(c("attempts", "N_valid", "analysis_status", "failure_pct") %in% names(mc))) {
    adequate <- all(!is.na(mc$attempts) & mc$attempts == cfg$M)
    add("MONTE_CARLO_ATTEMPTS", if (adequate) "PASS" else "STOP",
        paste("Every cell must contain", cfg$M, "independent datasets"))
    anomalies <- any(mc$N_valid < 0 | mc$N_valid > mc$attempts | !is.finite(mc$failure_pct))
    add("VALID_FIT_COUNTS", if (!anomalies) "PASS" else "STOP",
        "A failed fit is allowed but must not be counted as successful")
    high <- mc[mc$estimand == "DELTA" & mc$failure_pct >= 20, , drop = FALSE]
    add("HIGH_ESTIMATION_FAILURE", if (nrow(high)) "REVIEW" else "PASS",
        sprintf("%d DELTA cells with estimation failure >= 20%%; DO NOT hide", nrow(high)))
    if (nrow(high)) utils::write.csv(high, file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_REVIEW_HIGH_FAILURE.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
    summary <- stats::aggregate(cbind(N_valid, attempts) ~ method + estimand, data = mc, FUN = sum)
    summary$valid_pct <- 100 * summary$N_valid / pmax(1, summary$attempts)
    utils::write.csv(summary, file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_METHOD_SUCCESS_SUMMARY.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    summary <- data.frame()
    add("MONTE_CARLO_ATTEMPTS", "STOP", "MC summary absent or missing expected columns")
  }
  if (cfg$V > 0L) {
    if (is.null(ci)) {
      add("COVERAGE_TABLE_EXISTS", "STOP", "Bootstrap CI table missing")
    } else {
      design <- fw69_design(cfg)
      planned <- fw69_boot_jobs(design, cfg)
      design_keys <- unique(vapply(planned, function(x) as.character(x$design), character(1)))
      expected_ci <- length(design_keys) * length(cfg$C) * length(fw69_targets) *
        length(fw69_methods) * 3L
      add("COVERAGE_GRID", if (nrow(ci) == expected_ci) "PASS" else "STOP",
          sprintf("Found %d, expected %d. Only prespecified bootstrap n/P are covered", nrow(ci), expected_ci))
      fields <- c("N_planned_datasets", "N_completed_jobs", "N_valid_ci",
                  "coverage_conditional", "MCSE_coverage", "interval_method", "estimand")
      if (all(fields %in% names(ci))) {
        complete <- all(ci$N_planned_datasets == cfg$V & ci$N_completed_jobs == cfg$V)
        add("BOOTSTRAP_DATASETS", if (complete) "PASS" else "STOP",
            paste("Every SELECTED bootstrap design must complete", cfg$V, "datasets"))
        bad_ci <- ci$N_valid_ci < 0 | ci$N_valid_ci > ci$N_completed_jobs
        add("BOOTSTRAP_CI_DENOMINATORS", if (!any(bad_ci, na.rm = TRUE)) "PASS" else "STOP",
            "Conditional coverage uses VALID CIs only; missing CIs remain explicit")
        u <- ci[ci$interval_method == "PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT" & ci$estimand == "DELTA", , drop = FALSE]
        risk <- u[!is.finite(u$coverage_conditional) |
                  u$N_valid_ci < 100 |
                  (is.finite(u$MCSE_coverage) & u$MCSE_coverage > 0.02) |
                  (is.finite(u$coverage_conditional) & u$coverage_conditional < 0.90), , drop = FALSE]
        add("DELTA_COVERAGE_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW", if (nrow(risk)) "REVIEW" else "PASS",
            sprintf("%d percentile CI cells need review: low valid N / high MCSE / coverage below 0.90", nrow(risk)))
        if (nrow(risk)) utils::write.csv(risk, file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_REVIEW_CI_CALIBRATION.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
      } else add("BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED_FIELDS", "STOP", "A required bootstrap coverage field is missing")
    }
  } else add("BOOTSTRAP_NOT_REQUESTED", "REVIEW", "No interval coverage studied in this run")
  gate <- do.call(rbind, checks)
  utils::write.csv(gate, file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_QC_GATE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  overall <- if (any(gate$status == "STOP")) "INCOMPLETE_DO_NOT_USE_AS_FINAL" else
    "COMPUTATION_COMPLETE_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
  status_text <- c(
    paste("RUN QUALITY STATUS:", overall),
    paste("Analysis stage:", stage),
    paste("Engine code MD5:", script_hash),
    paste("Input workbook MD5:", input_hash),
    paste("Saved computation state:", phase),
    paste("All nine C levels:", paste(cfg$C, collapse = ",")),
    paste("All nine P levels:", paste(cfg$P, collapse = ",")),
    paste("Requested independent Monte Carlo replicates M:", cfg$M),
    paste("Bootstrap datasets PER SELECTED design:", cfg$V),
    paste("Bootstrap refits B:", cfg$B),
    "CRITICAL: A computationally complete run does NOT certify unbiasedness, coverage, novelty or publication acceptance.",
    "AIPW/projected/regularized estimators are DIFFERENT from historical v67 strict methods.",
    "Strict Fusion combines DELTA separately and may differ from its KA minus K1.",
    "Invalid estimators/intervals MUST be reported; conditional coverage is not unconditional coverage.",
    "Bootstrap covers ONLY BOOT_N x BOOT_P x DGMs, not the whole n/P grid, unless BOOT_ALL=1.",
    "Use method-specific MCSE and failure rates; report paired differences only on common successful replicates.",
    "Study the DGM assumptions and confirm reviewer requirements before calling tables manuscript-final."
  )
  fw_pub_safe_lines(status_text, file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_INTERPRETATION_STATUS.txt"))
  if (requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
    tryCatch({
      wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "QC_GATE")
      openxlsx::writeData(wb, "QC_GATE", gate, withFilter = TRUE)
      openxlsx::freezePane(wb, "QC_GATE", firstRow = TRUE)
      if (nrow(summary)) {
        openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "METHOD_SUCCESS")
        openxlsx::writeData(wb, "METHOD_SUCCESS", summary, withFilter = TRUE)
        openxlsx::freezePane(wb, "METHOD_SUCCESS", firstRow = TRUE)
      }
      openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_QC_SUMMARY.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) message("QC Excel skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)))
  }
  message("\nPUBLICATION QUALITY GATE: ", overall,
          "\nReport: ", file.path(output, "PUBLICATION_QC_GATE.csv"))
  invisible(overall)
}
fw_pub_main <- function() {
  stage <- toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_STAGE", "SMOKE"))
  scope <- toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_SCOPE", "SELECTED"))
  if (!scope %in% c("SELECTED", "ALL")) stop("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_SCOPE must be SELECTED or ALL")
  if (scope == "ALL" && stage != "FULL") stop("ALL bootstrap coverage is available in FULL only")
  if (!stage %in% c("QA", "SMOKE", "PILOT", "FULL", "REAL"))
    stop("FWKC_PUB_STAGE must be QA, SMOKE, PILOT, FULL or REAL")
  script <- fw_pub_path()
  code_hash <- fw_pub_checksum(script)
  if (!exists("fw69_run", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE))
    stop("Embedded FWKC engine is missing or failed to load")
  # Checkpoint signatures deliberately bind to THIS complete self-contained TXT.
  assign("FW69_CODEFILE", script, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  fw69_source_hash <- function() {
    file <- get("FW69_CODEFILE", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
    if (!file.exists(file)) stop("FWKC standalone source disappeared during run")
    unname(tools::md5sum(file))
  }
  assign("fw69_source_hash", fw69_source_hash, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  book <- fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_INPUT", "")
  if (!nzchar(book)) {
    message("Select the HISTORICAL simulation Excel workbook with RUN_CONFIG (or REAL TUAH for REAL)")
    if (!interactive()) stop("Set FWKC_PUB_INPUT to the Excel file path")
    book <- file.choose()
  }
  if (!file.exists(book) || !grepl("\\.xlsx$", book, ignore.case = TRUE))
    stop("Existing .xlsx workbook required")
  book <- normalizePath(book, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  assign("FW70_SELECTED_BOOK",book,envir=.GlobalEnv)
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Install package readxl")
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(book)
  if (stage != "REAL" && !"RUN_CONFIG" %in% sheets) stop("Choose the HISTORICAL workbook containing RUN_CONFIG")
  if (stage == "REAL" && !"REAL_PAIRED_FULL" %in% sheets) stop("Choose the TUAH paired workbook containing REAL_PAIRED_FULL")
  root <- file.path(dirname(book), "FWKC_MANUSCRIPT_CONTROL")
  dir.create(root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  input_hash <- fw_pub_checksum(book)
  smoke_stamp <- file.path(root, "SMOKE_PASS.rds")
  if (stage == "FULL") {
    if (toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_APPROVE", "NO")) != "YES")
      stop("FULL is extremely expensive: set FWKC_PUB_APPROVE=YES explicitly")
    stamp <- if (file.exists(smoke_stamp)) tryCatch(readRDS(smoke_stamp), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
    if (!is.list(stamp) || !identical(stamp$engine_md5, code_hash) ||
        !identical(stamp$workbook_md5, input_hash) || !isTRUE(stamp$completed))
      stop("Run a COMPLETE SMOKE test with this same engine/workbook before FULL")
  }
  # A fixed, explicit analytical protocol. Existing FW69_* values from earlier
  # RStudio sessions are deliberately overwritten to prevent accidental mixing.
  settings <- c(
    FW69_CORES = fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_CORES", "4"), FW69_SKIP_RF = "0", FW69_SEED = "20261106",
    FW69_RIDGE_LAMBDA = "1", FW69_MIN_BOOT_SUCCESS = "0.8",
    FW69_BOOT_N = "30,100,500", FW69_BOOT_P = "0.1,0.5,0.9",
    FW69_BOOT_ALL = if (stage == "FULL" && scope == "ALL") "1" else "0", FW69_MC_BATCH = fw_pub_env("FWKC_V74_MC_BATCH", "25"), FW69_BOOT_BATCH = fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_BATCH", "60"),
    FW69_GC_EVERY = "5", FW69_QA_LEGACY = "1",
    FW69_EXPORT_PER_DATASET = fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_SAVE_PER_DATASET", "0"),
    FW69_MC_REPS = if (stage == "FULL") fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_MC_REPS", "1000") else if (stage == "PILOT") "30" else "2",
    FW69_BOOT_DATASETS = if (stage == "FULL") fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_CI_DATASETS", "200") else if (stage == "PILOT") "4" else "1",
    FW69_BOOT_B = if (stage == "REAL") "399" else if (stage == "FULL") fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_B", "199") else if (stage == "PILOT") "49" else "19",
    FW69_RF_TREES = if (stage == "FULL") "300" else "100",
    FW69_BAYES_DRAWS = if (stage == "FULL") "400" else "128",
    FW69_REFERENCE_N = if (stage == "FULL") "300000" else "100000",
    FW69_MAX_HOURS = if (stage == "FULL") fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_MAX_HOURS", "120") else "12",
    FW69_HEAVY_ACK = if (stage == "FULL") "1" else "0",
    FW69_PREFLIGHT = "0"
  )
  do.call(Sys.setenv, as.list(settings))
  cfg <- fw69_cfg(if (stage == "QA") "PILOT" else stage)
  fw69_validate_cfg(cfg)
  message("FWKC research stage: ", stage, " | M=", cfg$M,
          " | B=", cfg$B, " | V=", cfg$V, " | PSOCK workers=", cfg$cores)
  if (stage == "FULL") {
    d <- fw69_design(cfg)
    b <- fw69_boot_jobs(d, cfg)
    refits <- length(b) * as.double(cfg$B)
    max_refits <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_SOFT_REFIT_LIMIT", "2000000")))
    if (!is.finite(max_refits) || max_refits < 1) stop("Invalid FWKC_PUB_SOFT_REFIT_LIMIT")
    if (refits > max_refits && toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_ACK_EXTREME", "NO")) != "YES")
      stop("FULL exceeds computational soft refit limit: planned ", format(refits,big.mark=","),
           ". Explicitly set FWKC_PUB_ACK_EXTREME=YES after reviewing cost")
    message("FULL planned independent datasets: ", nrow(d)*cfg$M,
            " | planned bootstrap refits: ", format(refits, big.mark = ","))
    fw_pub_safe_lines(c(paste("Stage:", stage), paste("Independent datasets:", nrow(d)*cfg$M),
                        paste("Bootstrap refits:", refits),
                        "Execution may take much longer than the soft time cap; resume using IDENTICAL settings."),
                      file.path(root, "FULL_COST_NOTICE.txt"))
  }
  # QA genuinely exercises ranger, not a fake substitute.
  if (stage != "REAL") {
    qa_dir <- file.path(root, paste0("QA_", substr(code_hash, 1L, 10L)))
    Sys.setenv(FW69_QA_OUTPUT_DIR = qa_dir)
    qa_out <- fw69_qa(fw69_cfg("QA"))
    gate_file <- file.path(qa_out, "QA_GATE.csv")
    if (!file.exists(gate_file)) stop("QA did not produce QA_GATE.csv")
    gate <- utils::read.csv(gate_file)
    blocked <- !nrow(gate) || any(is.na(gate$status)) || any(gate$status != "PASS")
    if (!nrow(gate) || !all(c("check", "status") %in% names(gate)))
      stop("QA_GATE.csv has missing required columns or rows")
    if (blocked) stop("QA has skipped/failed tests. Inspect: ", gate_file)
    message("Preflight QA passed; saved at: ", qa_out)
  }
  if (stage == "QA") return(invisible(qa_dir))
  if (stage == "REAL") {
    res <- fw69_run(book = book, mode = "REAL")
    message("REAL serial paired output: ", res, " (not randomized selective retest evidence)")
    return(invisible(res))
  }
  run_dir <- fw69_run(book = book, mode = stage)
  if (is.null(run_dir) || !nzchar(run_dir)) stop("FWKC returned no output path")
  state <- fw_pub_read_state(run_dir)
  report <- fw_pub_report(run_dir, cfg, stage, code_hash, input_hash)
  if (stage == "SMOKE" && state == "COMPLETE") {
    saveRDS(list(completed = TRUE, engine_md5 = code_hash, workbook_md5 = input_hash,
                 completed_at = as.character(Sys.time()), output = run_dir), smoke_stamp)
    message("SMOKE COMPLETE: you may now run PILOT or explicitly approve FULL.")
  } else if (state != "COMPLETE") {
    message("WARNING: run state is ", state, ". Not manuscript-ready; re-run SAME source and settings to resume.")
  }
  message("Results folder: ", run_dir)
  invisible(list(output = run_dir, state = state, qc = report))
}

# FWKC v70 extended publication QA and reporting appears below.


# ==============================================================================
# FWKC v70 PUBLICATION AUDIT LAYER
# Scientific estimators and DGMs above remain the v69.1 implementations.
# Adds: true full-CI optional scope, strict QA, analytic paired-covariance test,
# Monte Carlo uncertainty audit, Wilson limits, method dictionary, reproducibility
# manifest, and manuscript readiness limitations. NO new estimator is silently
# substituted and NO output is called publication-validated automatically.
# ==============================================================================
fw70_version <- "FWKC_v70_PUBLICATION_AUDIT_2026_11_09"

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] QA-02 UNCERTAINTY FOR SUCCESS PROPORTIONS | original line 2428 | function fw70_wilson
# [FW102-ANNOT] Wilson interval لحجم عينة متناهٍ يستخدم لتقدير عدم يقين نسبة نجاح
# [FW102-ANNOT] المقدّرات أو نجاح CI؛ تقنيات عامة معروفة لا ابتكار حصري.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw70_wilson <- function(successes, total, z=stats::qnorm(0.975)) {
  n <- pmax(1, as.numeric(total)); k <- pmin(pmax(0,as.numeric(successes)),n)
  p <- k/n; de <- 1+z*z/n
  centre <- (p+z*z/(2*n))/de
  spread <- z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/de
  data.frame(low=ifelse(total>0,pmax(0,centre-spread),NA_real_),
             high=ifelse(total>0,pmin(1,centre+spread),NA_real_))
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] REPORTING-01 METHOD LABELS AND INTERPRETATION | original line 2437 | function fw70_method_dictionary
# [FW102-ANNOT] تعاريف الطريقة والفروق بين strict/raw/guarded/projected مهمة أمام المحكم.
# [FW102-ANNOT] لا تساوِ بين performance of RF_GUARDED وبين نجاح RF خالص.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw70_method_dictionary <- function() {
  x <- data.frame(
    method=fw69_methods,
    family=c("DESIGN_IPW","CALIBRATED_HAJEK","STRATIFIED_AIPW",
      "CROSSFIT_RIDGE_RAW","CROSSFIT_RIDGE_PROJECTED","NONCROSSFIT_RIDGE_PROJECTED",
      "CROSSFIT_RF_STRICT","RF_WITH_FALLBACK_RAW","RF_WITH_FALLBACK_PROJECTED",
      "BETA_PSEUDO_POSTERIOR","REGULARIZED_BETA_POSTERIOR",
      "TARGET_SPECIFIC_INVERSE_SE_FUSION","COHERENT_FIXED_HALF_FUSION"),
    estimator_changed_from_strict=c(FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,TRUE,TRUE,TRUE,
      FALSE,TRUE,TRUE,FALSE,TRUE,FALSE,TRUE),
    caution=c(
      "Raw moment feasibility and unknown selection probability conditions",
      "Calibration and empty disease strata must be reported",
      "Can coincide algebraically with Hajek within D strata",
      "Training-site disjoint folds; learning uncertainty not in working delta SE",
      "Projection changes estimand estimator; full refit bootstrap preferred",
      "Non-crossfitted nuisance model dependence",
      "Requires RF class support, positivity and valid joint moments",
      "Explicit ridge/constant fallback; NOT pure RF",
      "Projection and fallback alter estimator; full refit bootstrap",
      "Design-weighted beta pseudo posterior; NOT historical Gibbs model",
      "Prior-only strata are not accepted as identified results",
      "DELTA fused separately; may NOT equal fused KA minus fused K1",
      "Fixed 50/50 exploratory; projected RF or ridge fallback; full refit CI"),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  x
}

  )
  fw_pub_safe_lines(c(info,"",capture.output(utils::sessionInfo())),file.path(out,"FWKC_v70_REPRODUCIBILITY_MANIFEST.txt"))

    "The simulation is synthetic; it MUST NOT be described as real patient data.",

  ),file.path(out,"FWKC_v70_INPUT_USAGE_PROVENANCE.txt"))
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE AUDIT/REPORT / fw70_extra_qa | original line 2495 | function fw70_extra_qa
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw70_extra_qa <- function(directory) {
  dir.create(directory,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  checks<-list()
  add<-function(name,passed,value,detail) {
    checks[[length(checks)+1L]] <<- data.frame(check=name,
      status=if(isTRUE(passed))"PASS" else "FAIL",metric=as.numeric(value),
      detail=as.character(detail),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }
  # The sampling law, not only the final kappa, must satisfy identity for paired delta.
  d<-fw69_dgm(600L,.5,"BASE",fw69_alpha(.5,.35),928321L)
  y<-ifelse(d$t1==1L,1L,d$t2_full)
  Z<-cbind(d$d,d$t1,d$d*d$t1,y,d$d*y)
  V<-fw69_gram(Z,d$site)$V
  theta<-colMeans(Z);C0<-0.5
  obj1<-fw69_gradient_hessian(theta[c(1,2,3)],C0)
  obja<-fw69_gradient_hessian(theta[c(1,4,5)],C0)
  g1<-c(obj1$gradient,0,0)
  ga<-c(obja$gradient[1],0,0,obja$gradient[2:3])
  v1<-as.numeric(crossprod(g1,V%*%g1))
  va<-as.numeric(crossprod(ga,V%*%ga))
  cov1a<-as.numeric(crossprod(g1,V%*%ga))
  vd<-as.numeric(crossprod(ga-g1,V%*%(ga-g1)))
  delta_method<-fw69_paired_delta(d,y,C0)
  se2<-delta_method[1,3,"se1"]^2
  error<-max(abs(vd-(v1+va-2*cov1a)),abs(vd-se2))
  add("PAIRED_COVARIANCE_IN_DELTA",is.finite(error)&&error<=1e-10,error,
      "Full paired covariance must match direct gradient variance")
  # Check all 81 P-C combinations per DGM independent of n.
  cfg<-fw69_cfg("PILOT");des<-fw69_design(cfg)
  cells<-nrow(des)*length(cfg$C)
  add("GRID_2430_CELLS",cells==2430,cells,"5 DGMs x 6 n x 9 P x 9 C")
  # Repeated per-task seeds must reproduce all sample outcomes.
  a<-fw69_dgm(100L,.4,"STRONG_PAIR",fw69_alpha(.4,.35),20261012L)
  b<-fw69_dgm(100L,.4,"STRONG_PAIR",fw69_alpha(.4,.35),20261012L)
  add("DGM_REPEATABILITY",identical(a,b),as.numeric(identical(a,b)),
      "Same seed and DGM must reproduce all patient-linked observations")
  # Preserve original truth functional.
  pt<-fw69_kappa(554/620,495/620,473/620,.5)
  add("CASS_620_KAPPA",abs(pt-.37343014128728486)<1e-12,
      abs(pt-.37343014128728486),"Published numerical benchmark")
  q<-do.call(rbind,checks)
  fw69_csv(q,file.path(directory,"QA_V70_ADDITIONAL.csv"))
  if(any(q$status!="PASS"))stop("V70 additional QA failed; see QA_V70_ADDITIONAL.csv")
  invisible(q)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE AUDIT/REPORT / fw70_report_addendum | original line 2541 | function fw70_report_addendum
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw70_report_addendum <- function(out, stage) {
  mcp<-file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_01_BIAS_RMSE_MCSE.csv")
  cip<-file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_02_COVERAGE_AND_FAILURE_BOUNDS.csv")
  refp<-file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_00_REFERENCE_TRUTH.csv")
  if(!file.exists(mcp))return(invisible(NULL))
  mc<-tryCatch(utils::read.csv(mcp,stringsAsFactors=FALSE),error=function(e)NULL)
  if(is.null(mc)||!nrow(mc))return(invisible(NULL))
  if(all(c("DGM","P","C","estimand","reference_mcse")%in%names(mc))) {
    # Already contains uncertainty if upstream report changes. Do not duplicate.
  } else if(file.exists(refp)) {
    ref<-tryCatch(utils::read.csv(refp,stringsAsFactors=FALSE),error=function(e)NULL)
    key<-c("DGM","P","C","estimand")
    if(!is.null(ref)&&all(c(key,"reference_mcse")%in%names(ref))) {
      ref<-ref[c(key,"reference_mcse")]
      mc<-merge(mc,ref,by=key,all.x=TRUE,sort=FALSE)
    }
  }
  if(all(c("N_valid","attempts","failure_pct","MCSE_bias")%in%names(mc))) {
    mc$N_failed<-pmax(0,mc$attempts-mc$N_valid)
    w<-fw70_wilson(mc$N_valid,mc$attempts)
    mc$estimation_success_95_lo<-w$low
    mc$estimation_success_95_hi<-w$high
    mc$MCSE_failure_fraction<-sqrt((mc$failure_pct/100)*pmax(0,1-mc$failure_pct/100)/pmax(1,mc$attempts))
    if("reference_mcse" %in% names(mc))
      mc$bias_mcse_including_reference_sensitivity<-sqrt(mc$MCSE_bias^2+mc$reference_mcse^2)
    mc$interpretation_scope<-"CONDITIONAL_ON_VALID_ESTIMATES; failure rate separately reported"
    fw69_csv(mc,file.path(out,"FWKC_v70_ESTIMATION_PRECISION_AUDIT.csv"))
    k<-mc[mc$estimand=="DELTA" & (mc$failure_pct>=20 | mc$N_valid<100),,drop=FALSE]
    if(nrow(k))fw69_csv(k,file.path(out,"FWKC_v70_METHODS_NEEDING_REVIEW.csv"))
  }
  if(file.exists(cip)) {
    ci<-tryCatch(utils::read.csv(cip,stringsAsFactors=FALSE),error=function(e)NULL)
    needed<-c("N_planned_datasets","N_completed_jobs","N_valid_ci",
               "coverage_conditional","coverage_lower_failure_bound_planned",
               "coverage_upper_failure_bound_planned")
    if(!is.null(ci)&&nrow(ci)&&all(needed%in%names(ci))) {
      k<-ifelse(is.finite(ci$coverage_conditional),
                round(ci$coverage_conditional*ci$N_valid_ci),0)
      ci$covered_count_approx<-k
      band<-fw70_wilson(k,ci$N_valid_ci)
      ci$coverage_conditional_95_lo<-band$low
      ci$coverage_conditional_95_hi<-band$high
      w<-fw70_wilson(ci$N_valid_ci,ci$N_completed_jobs)
      ci$CI_success_95_lo<-w$low
      ci$CI_success_95_hi<-w$high
      ci$CI_valid_rate_planned<-ci$N_valid_ci/pmax(1,ci$N_planned_datasets)
      ci$MCSE_target_point01_flag<-ifelse(!is.finite(ci$MCSE_coverage),
             "NOT_ESTIMABLE",ifelse(ci$MCSE_coverage>.01,"PRECISION_REVIEW","MCSE_BELOW_0.01"))
      ci$coverage_scope<-"SELECTED_BOOTSTRAP_DESIGNS_OR_EXPLICIT_ALL_OPTION"
      ci$failure_bound_interpretation<-"Sensitivity limits, not confidence intervals"
      fw69_csv(ci,file.path(out,"FWKC_v70_CI_CALIBRATION_AUDIT.csv"))
    }
  }
  # Data dictionary is explicitly linked to manuscript outputs.
  dictionary<-data.frame(variable=c("DGM","n","P","C","estimand","method","attempts",
    "N_valid","failure_pct","bias","rmse","MCSE_bias","MCSE_RMSE","coverage_conditional",
    "N_valid_ci","MCSE_coverage","reference_mcse"),
    meaning=c("Data generating mechanism","Patients per simulated data set",
    "Population prevalence parameter","Asymmetric false-negative loss weight",
    "K1, KA, or DELTA","Estimator implementation label",
    "Independent data sets attempted","Finite point estimators",
    "Percent invalid point estimators","Mean error among valid fits",
    "RMSE among valid fits","Monte Carlo SE of bias among valid fits",
    "Monte Carlo SE of RMSE among valid fits",
    "Coverage conditional on a valid interval","Number of valid confidence intervals",
    "Binomial Monte Carlo SE of conditional coverage","Numerical integration reference uncertainty"),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  fw69_csv(dictionary,file.path(out,"FWKC_v70_DATA_DICTIONARY.csv"))
  invisible(out)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE AUDIT/REPORT / fw70_main | original line 2612 | function fw70_main
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw70_main <- function() {
  # Parsing here finds syntax defects before significant computational work.
  script<-fw_pub_path()
  invisible(parse(file=script,encoding="UTF-8"))
  stage<-toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_STAGE","SMOKE"))
  # Additional DGM and paired-covariance gates before any execution.
  qa_out<-file.path(tempdir(),paste0("FWKC_v70_PRE_EXECUTION_QA_",substr(unname(tools::md5sum(script)),1,10)))
  fw70_extra_qa(qa_out)
  result<-fw_pub_main()
  out<-if(is.list(result)&&!is.null(result$output)) result$output else
       if(is.character(result)&&length(result)==1) result else NULL
  if(!is.null(out)&&dir.exists(out)) {
    book<-fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_INPUT","")
    if(!nzchar(book)) book<-fw_pub_env("FW70_SELECTED_BOOK","")
    if(!nzchar(book)||!file.exists(book))book<-script
    fw70_write_manifest(out,script,book,stage)
    fw70_report_addendum(out,stage)
    qa_copy<-file.path(out,"QA_V70_ADDITIONAL.csv")
    file.copy(file.path(qa_out,"QA_V70_ADDITIONAL.csv"),qa_copy,overwrite=TRUE)
    message("V70 supplementary research audits: ",out)
  }
  invisible(result)
}

# FWKC v71: PUBLICATION AUDIT + COMPUTATIONAL ENGINEERING, 2026-11-09
# All 13 statistical point estimators, DGM, joint delta and CI definitions above
# preserved from v70. This layer includes a faster equivalent cluster resampler,
# automated pre-run equivalence tests, user-selectable partial-save frequency,
# a full-workload manifest, full-grid working-delta coverage at zero extra refits,
# a real workload benchmark, and research QC flags.
# IMPORTANT: it CANNOT guarantee faster execution, coverage or journal acceptance.
# ============================================================================== 
fw71_version <- "FWKC_v71_VERIFIED_DESIGN_2026_11_09"

# Exact reference procedure preserved for pairwise equivalence testing.
fw71_bootsample_reference <- fw69_bootsample
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] BOOT-01B EXACT-RNG OPTIMIZED RESAMPLER [LATE OVERRIDE] | original line 2650 | function fw69_bootsample
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه التعريفات اللاحقة تحل مكان fw69_bootsample الأول عند تنفيذ المصدر كله.
# [FW102-ANNOT] تستخدم indices للمجموعات بدلاً من scanning متكرر؛ الهدف التكافؤ العددي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] لاحظ أن باحث التدقيق يجب أن يتتبع LAST FUNCTION BINDING لا التعريف الأول فقط.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw69_bootsample <- function(d,seed) {
  # Preserves the SAME sample(s,...,replace=TRUE) call and thus RNG stream.
  # Avoids scanning all patient rows separately for every selected cluster.
  set.seed(seed)
  s <- unique(as.character(d$site))
  if(length(s)==nrow(d)) {
    ix <- sample.int(nrow(d),nrow(d),TRUE)
    b <- d[ix,,drop=FALSE]; b$site <- seq_len(nrow(b)); return(b)
  }
  picks <- sample(s,length(s),replace=TRUE)
  gr <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)),as.character(d$site),drop=TRUE)
  chosen <- gr[as.character(picks)]
  idx <- unlist(chosen,use.names=FALSE)
  b <- d[idx,,drop=FALSE]
  b$site <- rep.int(seq_along(picks),lengths(chosen))
  b
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/QA / fw71_bsample_qa | original line 2668 | function fw71_bsample_qa
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw71_bsample_qa <- function(out=tempdir()) {
  dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  result <- list()
  for(n in c(30L,100L,500L,1000L)) {
    g <- fw69_dgm(n,.5,"STRONG_PAIR",fw69_alpha(.5,.35),300021L+n)
    for(z in seq_len(12L)) {
      seed <- as.integer(91300L+1001L*n+z)
      a <- fw71_bootsample_reference(g,seed)
      b <- fw69_bootsample(g,seed)
      # Row names are not observations; scientific row contents must agree EXACTLY.
      equal <- identical(names(a),names(b)) && nrow(a)==nrow(b) &&
         all(vapply(names(a),function(k)
           identical(unname(a[[k]]),unname(b[[k]])),logical(1)))
      result[[length(result)+1L]] <- data.frame(
        n=n,seed=seed,identical_columns=equal,
        n_original=nrow(a),n_fast=nrow(b),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    }
  }
  z <- do.call(rbind,result)
  fw69_csv(z,file.path(out,"QA_V71_SAMPLING_EXACT_PARITY.csv"))
  if(!all(z$identical_columns))
    stop("Optimized bootstrap sample disagrees with ORIGINAL; see QA_V71_SAMPLING_EXACT_PARITY.csv")
  # Exact online coverage-counter test: zero error must be covered when SE is positive.
  cfg<-fw69_cfg("PILOT")
  arr<-fw69_init_array(cfg$C);arr[]<-0.5
  se<-arr;se[]<-0.1
  fake<-list(point=arr,se1=se,se2=se,bias2=arr*0)
  tr<-matrix(0.5,length(cfg$C),3)
  cnt<-fw69_accumulate(fw69_new_acc(cfg),fake,tr)
  ok_count<-cnt$nsim==1L &&
      all(cnt$workingCI_valid==1) && all(cnt$workingCI_covered==1) &&
      all(cnt$fisherCI_valid[,1:2,]==1) &&
      all(cnt$fisherCI_covered[,1:2,]==1) &&
      all(cnt$fisherCI_valid[,3,]==0)
  fw69_csv(data.frame(check="ONLINE_WORKING_CI_COUNTS",status=if(ok_count)"PASS" else "FAIL"),
      file.path(out,"QA_V71_WORKING_CI_COUNTS.csv"))
  if(!ok_count)stop("Online full-grid working CI accumulator failed")
  invisible(z)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/QA / fw71_plan | original line 2708 | function fw71_plan
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw71_plan <- function(out=file.path(getwd(),"FWKC_v71_PLAN")) {
  dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  cfg <- fw69_cfg("FULL"); des <- fw69_design(cfg)
  vv <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_CI_DATASETS","200")))
  bb <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_B","199")))
  mm <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_MC_REPS","1000")))
  if(any(!is.finite(c(vv,bb,mm))) || any(c(vv,bb,mm)<1))
    stop("M, V, B must be positive integers")
  original <- cfg$all_boot
  report <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("SELECTED","ALL"),function(scope){
    cfg$all_boot <- identical(scope,"ALL");cfg$V <- vv;cfg$B <- bb;cfg$M <- mm
    boot <- fw69_boot_jobs(des,cfg)
    data.frame(scope=scope,DGM=length(cfg$dgms),n=length(cfg$n),
      prevalence_levels=length(cfg$P),weighting_levels=length(cfg$C),
      point_design_cells=nrow(des)*length(cfg$C),
      independent_MC_datasets=nrow(des)*mm,
      bootstrap_unique_n_P_DGM=length(boot)/vv,
      independent_bootstrap_datasets=length(boot),
      FULL_REFIT_BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES=as.double(length(boot))*bb,
      TARGETS=length(fw69_targets),METHODS=length(fw69_methods),
      note="C values reuse patient datasets and fitted methods; Bootstrap refits are expensive",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))
  cfg$all_boot <- original
  fw69_csv(report,file.path(out,"FWKC_v71_EXACT_RUN_COST.csv"))
  message("RUN PLAN: ",out)
  invisible(out)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.

fw71_bench_one <- function(job,cfg) {
  n<-job$n;seed<-as.integer(880102L+10001L*n+job$repl)
  a<-fw69_alpha(.5,.35)
  d<-fw69_dgm(n,.5,"BASE",a,seed)
  fit<-fw69_estimate(d,cfg,seed+12345L)
  as.vector(fit$point)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] ENGINEERING-02 RUNTIME BENCHMARK | original line 2744 | function fw71_benchmark
# [FW102-ANNOT] benchmark يقيس تكلفة التنفيذ ولا يثبت صحة التغطية ولا يضمن حدًا زمنيًا.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw71_benchmark <- function(out=file.path(getwd(),"FWKC_v71_BENCHMARK")) {
  dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  if(!requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE))stop("BENCH requires ranger")
  cfg<-fw69_cfg("PILOT");cfg$skip_rf<-FALSE
  cfg$rf_trees<-fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_BENCH_TREES",100L,30L,2000L)
  cfg$bayes_draws<-fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_BENCH_DRAWS",128L,40L,3000L)
  workers<-min(cfg$cores,4L)
  jobs<-lapply(seq_len(8L),function(i)list(n=if(i<=4L)100L else 500L,
                                           repl=as.integer((i-1L)%%4L+1L)))
  oldthreads<-Sys.getenv(c("OMP_NUM_THREADS","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS","MKL_NUM_THREADS","BLIS_NUM_THREADS"))
  Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1")
  on.exit(do.call(Sys.setenv,as.list(oldthreads)),add=TRUE)
  t0<-proc.time()[3]
  cl<-parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers,outfile="")
  startup<-proc.time()[3]-t0
  on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl),add=TRUE)
  fn<-ls(envir=.GlobalEnv,pattern="^fw69_")
  fn<-fn[vapply(fn,function(x)is.function(get(x,envir=.GlobalEnv)),logical(1))]
  parallel::clusterExport(cl,c(fn,"fw71_bench_one","fw69_methods","fw69_targets"),envir=.GlobalEnv)
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl,{Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1");NULL})
  # Warm-up both runtimes before timing. No full simulation or reference truth.
  invisible(fw71_bench_one(jobs[[1]],cfg))
  invisible(parallel::parLapply(cl,jobs[1],fw71_bench_one,cfg=cfg))
  t1<-proc.time()[3];serial<-lapply(jobs,fw71_bench_one,cfg=cfg);st<-proc.time()[3]-t1
  t2<-proc.time()[3];parallel_res<-parallel::parLapplyLB(cl,jobs,fw71_bench_one,cfg=cfg)
  pt<-proc.time()[3]-t2
  err<-max(vapply(seq_along(jobs),function(i){
    x<-serial[[i]];y<-parallel_res[[i]]
    if(any(xor(is.finite(x),is.finite(y))))return(Inf)
    if(!any(is.finite(x)))return(0)
    max(abs(x[is.finite(x)]-y[is.finite(y)]))
  },numeric(1)))
  x<-data.frame(cores=workers,per_worker_RF_threads=1,
    datasets=length(jobs),n_levels="100,500",methods=length(fw69_methods),C_levels=length(cfg$C),
    rf_trees=cfg$rf_trees,psock_startup_seconds=startup,
    sequential_seconds=st,parallel_warm_seconds=pt,
    speedup_warm=st/max(1e-12,pt),
    numerical_max_absolute_difference=err,
    scientific_conclusion="Benchmark is not evidence of coverage or journal acceptance",
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  fw69_csv(x,file.path(out,"FWKC_v71_ACTUAL_WORKLOAD_BENCHMARK.csv"))
  if(!is.finite(err)||err>1e-10)stop("Serial versus 4 PSOCK RF benchmark does not match")
  message("Actual 4-core performance benchmark: ",out)
  invisible(out)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/QA / fw71_audit_output | original line 2790 | function fw71_audit_output
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw71_audit_output <- function(out,stage) {
  if(!dir.exists(out))return(invisible(NULL))
  scope<-toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_SCOPE","SELECTED"))
  csvpath<-function(n)file.path(out,n)
  mc<-tryCatch(utils::read.csv(csvpath("MANUSCRIPT_01_BIAS_RMSE_MCSE.csv")),error=function(e)NULL)
  ci<-tryCatch(utils::read.csv(csvpath("MANUSCRIPT_02_COVERAGE_AND_FAILURE_BOUNDS.csv")),error=function(e)NULL)
  st<-fw_pub_read_state(out)
  checks<-list();add<-function(a,b,why)checks[[length(checks)+1L]]<<-data.frame(
    check=a,status=if(isTRUE(b))"PASS" else "REVIEW_OR_INCOMPLETE",detail=why,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  add("COMPUTATIONAL_COMPLETION",st=="COMPLETE",paste("RUN_STATE=",st))
  cfg_stage<-fw69_cfg(stage)
  exp_mc<-length(cfg_stage$dgms)*length(cfg_stage$n)*length(cfg_stage$P)*
      length(cfg_stage$C)*3*length(fw69_methods)
  add("ALL_POINT_CELLS_PRESENT",!is.null(mc)&&nrow(mc)==exp_mc,
      paste("Expected",exp_mc,"method x target x C point cells for",stage))
  if(!is.null(mc)&&nrow(mc)) {
    add("ALL_MC_ATTEMPTS",all(mc$attempts>=as.integer(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_MC_REPS",if(stage=="PILOT")"30" else "2"))),
        "Numbers of attempts must meet prespecified M; high failures remain reportable")
    add("FAILURES_ANNOTATED",all(is.finite(mc$failure_pct)),"Missing estimates may NOT be silently imputed")
  }
  expected_design<-if(stage=="SMOKE")length(cfg_stage$dgms)*length(cfg_stage$n)*length(cfg_stage$P)
     else if(scope=="ALL")270 else 45
  exp_ci<-expected_design*length(cfg_stage$C)*3*length(fw69_methods)*3
  add("EXPLICIT_CI_SCOPE",!is.null(ci)&&nrow(ci)==exp_ci,
      paste(scope,"expects",expected_design,"DGM/n/P bootstrap designs and",exp_ci,"method/CI/target/C rows"))
  if(!is.null(ci)&&nrow(ci)) {
    good<-ci[ci$estimand=="DELTA" & ci$interval_method=="PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT",,drop=FALSE]
    alert<-good[!is.finite(good$coverage_conditional)|good$N_valid_ci<100|
         (is.finite(good$MCSE_coverage)&good$MCSE_coverage>.01)|
         (!is.na(good$CI_success_pct_among_completed)&good$CI_success_pct_among_completed<95),,drop=FALSE]
    add("CI_DELTA_SCIENTIFIC_PRECISION",nrow(alert)==0,
        paste(nrow(alert),"CI cells have low precision, few valid samples, or CI failures"))
    if(nrow(alert))fw69_csv(alert,csvpath("FWKC_v71_CI_SCIENTIFIC_CONCERNS.csv"))
  }
  res<-do.call(rbind,checks)
  fw69_csv(res,csvpath("FWKC_v71_PUBLICATION_READINESS_AUDIT.csv"))
  message("FWKC v71 manuscript audit: ",if(all(res$status=="PASS"))
    "COMPUTATION_CHECKS_PASS_NOT_A_JOURNAL_ACCEPTANCE" else "REVIEW_REQUIRED")
  invisible(res)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/QA / fw71_main | original line 2831 | function fw71_main
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw71_main <- function() {
  stage<-toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_STAGE","SMOKE"))
  if(stage=="PLAN")return(fw71_plan())
  if(stage=="BENCH")return(fw71_benchmark())
  script<-fw_pub_path()
  # Fail-fast checks: source and clinical methods are not edited to force passes.
  qa_dir<-file.path(tempdir(),paste0("FWKC_v71_QA_",substr(unname(tools::md5sum(script)),1,10)))
  fw71_bsample_qa(qa_dir)
  result<-fw70_main()
  out<-if(is.list(result)&&!is.null(result$output))result$output else
       if(is.character(result)&&length(result)==1L)result else NULL
  if(!is.null(out)&&dir.exists(out)) {
    for(nm in c("QA_V71_SAMPLING_EXACT_PARITY.csv","QA_V71_WORKING_CI_COUNTS.csv"))
      file.copy(file.path(qa_dir,nm),file.path(out,nm),overwrite=TRUE)
    if(stage%in%c("SMOKE","PILOT","FULL"))fw71_audit_output(out,stage)
    writeLines(c(paste("Engine:",fw71_version),
      paste("Parent engine:",fw70_version),
      paste("Source MD5:",unname(tools::md5sum(script))),
      paste("Bootstrap checkpoint frequency:",fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_BATCH","60")),
      "EXACT parity of optimized bootstrap sampling tested across n=30,100,500,1000 and 12 seeds each.",
      "Working DELTA and Fisher-z CI coverage now calculated across the full MC grid when a finite SE exists; these are not bootstrap coverage.",
      "Neither full Bayesian Gibbs/HMC nor historic v27/v28 legacy estimators are automatically run.",
      "Computational speedup and nominal 95% CI coverage remain to be measured on research workloads."),
      file.path(out,"FWKC_v71_AUDIT_SUMMARY.txt"))
  }
  invisible(result)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/QA / fw72_selftest_summary | original line 2870 | function fw72_selftest_summary
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw72_selftest_summary <- function(out=tempdir()) {
  # This calls the actual manuscript aggregation path, not a mock checker.
  dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  cfg<-fw69_cfg("SMOKE")
  cfg$n<-30L;cfg$P<-0.5;cfg$dgms<-"BASE"
  cfg$M<-1L;cfg$MC_chunk<-1L;cfg$V<-0L
  cfg$signature<-"FW72_TEST_ONLY";cfg$out<-file.path(out,"FW72_SUMMARY_TEST")
  dir.create(file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS"),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  des<-fw69_design(cfg)
  tr<-matrix(.5,nrow=length(cfg$C),ncol=3)
  ar<-fw69_init_array(cfg$C);ar[]<-.5
  se<-ar;se[]<-.1
  fit<-list(point=ar,se1=se,se2=se,bias2=ar*0)
  acc<-fw69_accumulate(fw69_new_acc(cfg),fit,tr)
  status<-data.frame(method=fw69_methods,reason="TEST_ONLY",
    raw_feasibility_reason="TEST_ONLY",fallback_reason="NONE",
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  a<-list(signature=cfg$signature,from=1L,N=1L,design=1L,
      DGM="BASE",n=30L,P=.5,acc=acc,status=status,pairederr=list(),
      boot_point_cache=list())
  test_file<-file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS","0000001.rds")
  fw69_atomic(a,test_file)
  tab<-fw69_mc_tables(des,cfg)
  expected<-length(cfg$C)*3L*length(fw69_methods)
  passed<-nrow(tab$mc)==expected && nrow(tab$failures)==length(fw69_methods) &&
    all(tab$mc$attempts==1L) && all(tab$mc$N_valid==1L) &&
    all(is.finite(tab$mc$fisher_z_CI_coverage_conditional[tab$mc$estimand!="DELTA"]))
  summary<-data.frame(test="COMPLETE_MONTE_CARLO_SUMMARY_COUNTER_COLLISION",
    passed=passed,expected_mc_rows=expected,actual_mc_rows=nrow(tab$mc),
    expected_failure_rows=length(fw69_methods),actual_failure_rows=nrow(tab$failures))
  fw69_csv(summary,file.path(out,"QA_FW72_MC_SUMMARY.csv"))
  if(!passed)stop("FW72 manuscript summary self-test FAILED; see QA_FW72_MC_SUMMARY.csv")
  invisible(summary)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/QA / fw72_selftest_cache | original line 2905 | function fw72_selftest_cache
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw72_selftest_cache <- function(out=tempdir(),require_ranger=FALSE) {
  # Two executions of the actual estimator on identical observations and seed,
  # followed by retrieval from the persisted MC checkpoint. This is intended
  # to catch seed/task mismatches, not to certify all estimator inferential claims.
  if(require_ranger&&!requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE))
    stop("FW72 cache numerical self-test requires ranger")
  cfg<-fw69_cfg("SMOKE")
  cfg$M<-2L;cfg$MC_chunk<-2L;cfg$V<-1L
  cfg$n<-100L;cfg$P<-.5;cfg$dgms<-"BASE"
  cfg$out<-file.path(out,"FW72_POINT_CACHE_TEST")
  cfg$signature<-"FW72_CACHE_TEST_ONLY"
  dir.create(file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS"),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  job<-list(id=1L,design=1L,rep=1L,DGM="BASE",n=100L,P=.5)
  seed<-fw69_seed(cfg,job$design,job$rep)
  d<-fw69_dgm(job$n,job$P,job$DGM,fw69_alpha(.5,.35),seed)
  cfg$skip_rf<-FALSE
  first<-fw69_estimate(d,cfg,seed+12345L)
  fw69_atomic(list(signature=cfg$signature,design=1L,from=1L,N=2L,
    boot_point_cache=list("1"=list(point=first$point,se1=first$se1,
      bias2=first$bias2,status=first$status,diagnostics=first$diagnostics))),
    file.path(cfg$out,"MC_CHECKPOINTS","0000001.rds"))
  retrieved<-fw69_cached_fit(cfg,job)
  stopifnot(!is.null(retrieved))
  second<-fw69_estimate(d,cfg,seed+12345L)
  same_na<-identical(is.na(first$point),is.na(second$point)) &&
    identical(is.na(retrieved$point),is.na(second$point))
  good<-is.finite(first$point)&is.finite(second$point)&is.finite(retrieved$point)
  err<-if(any(good))max(abs(first$point[good]-second$point[good]),
                        abs(retrieved$point[good]-second$point[good])) else 0
  ok<-same_na && is.finite(err)&&err<=1e-10 &&
    identical(retrieved$status,second$status)
  audit<-data.frame(test="CACHED_VS_RECOMPUTED_ORIGINAL_ESTIMATOR",
    passed=ok,max_abs_difference=err,finite_values=sum(good),
    identical_missingness=same_na,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  fw69_csv(audit,file.path(out,"QA_FW72_CACHE_EXACT_REUSE.csv"))
  if(!ok)stop("FW72 point-cache parity FAILED. No full study should run.")
  invisible(audit)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.

fw72_main <- function() {
  stage<-toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_STAGE","SMOKE"))
  if(!stage%in%c("PLAN","BENCH","QA","SMOKE","PILOT","FULL","REAL"))
    stop("Unrecognized FWKC_PUB_STAGE: ",stage)
  # Skip cache self-test for pure cost planning and performance benchmarking.
  if(!stage%in%c("PLAN","BENCH")) fw72_preflight(stage)
  result<-fw71_main()
  out<-if(is.list(result)&&!is.null(result$output))result$output else
        if(is.character(result)&&length(result)==1L)result else NULL
  if(!is.null(out)&&dir.exists(out)) {
    qa_dir<-file.path(tempdir(),"FWKC_v72_PREFLIGHT")
    for(name in c("QA_FW72_MC_SUMMARY.csv","QA_FW72_CACHE_EXACT_REUSE.csv")) {
      file<-file.path(qa_dir,name)
      if(file.exists(file))file.copy(file,file.path(out,name),overwrite=TRUE)
    }
    text<-c("FWKC v72 research code audit",
      paste("FW72 version",fw72_version),
      paste("Current code MD5",unname(tools::md5sum(fw_pub_path()))),
      "Independent MC summary counter corrected: fail_i distinct from fisher_covered.",
      "Original bootstrap-point fit reused ONLY when MC checkpoint matches source, design and replicate.",
      "Each inner bootstrap resample still refits all statistical estimators. NO B/M/n/P/C reduction.",
      "Fast cache and original recomputation are tested with actual ranger fitting in preflight.",
      "Full Bayesian Gibbs/HMC and full v27/v28 historical methods are NOT run automatically.",
      "Source parse, QA, SMOKE, FULL and speedup on the user's RStudio must still be observed.",
      "Scientific novelty/coverage/journal acceptance are NOT guaranteed by execution.")
    fw_pub_safe_lines(text,file.path(out,"FWKC_v72_SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE_AND_ENGINEERING_AUDIT.txt"))
  }
  invisible(result)
}

# =============================================================================
# FWKC v73 | SAFE ACCELERATION + EXECUTABLE NUMERICAL PARITY + RESEARCH AUDIT
# All 13 estimand definitions, DGM, delta and interval definitions remain intact.
# ONLY: reuse a mathematically identical Bayesian draw; cache cluster row index
# within each bootstrap job. No replication, RF tree, B, n, P, or C reduction.
# Source: exact v72 engine; v72 estimator retained as executable numeric oracle.
# The v73 accelerations are blocked if exact finite/NA/status/RNG parity fails.
# =============================================================================
fw73_version <- "FWKC_v73_VERIFIED_SAFE_ACCELERATION_2026_11_09"

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] ENGINEERING-03 EXACT-RNG BOOTSTRAP SAMPLER | original line 2993 | function fw73_make_sampler
# [FW102-ANNOT] تحسين تجميع مواقع bootstrap مع هدف الحفاظ على سلاسل RNG والمعادلات؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] يتطلب اختبار parity مستقل مع sampler المرجعي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_make_sampler <- function(d) {
  # Keep the exact sampling implementation of v71, with index calculation
  # factored outside the loop of B inner bootstrap samples.
  s <- unique(as.character(d$site))
  if (length(s) == nrow(d)) {
    return(function(seed) {
      set.seed(seed)
      ix <- sample.int(nrow(d), nrow(d), TRUE)
      b <- d[ix, , drop = FALSE]
      b$site <- seq_len(nrow(b))
      b
    })
  }
  gr <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), as.character(d$site), drop = TRUE)
  function(seed) {
    set.seed(seed)
    picks <- sample(s, length(s), replace = TRUE)
    chosen <- gr[as.character(picks)]
    idx <- unlist(chosen, use.names = FALSE)
    b <- d[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    b$site <- rep.int(seq_along(picks), lengths(chosen))
    b
  }
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.

# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_strict_equal <- function(a, b) {
  # NA positions, values, attributes, diagnostics and status are all significant.
  isTRUE(identical(a, b))
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] QA-03 PARITY OF OPTIMIZATIONS | original line 3023 | function fw73_optimizations_qa
# [FW102-ANNOT] يقارن تحسنيات الأداء بالخوارزمية السابقة على أمثلة اختبار؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] اختبارات QA ضرورية لكنها غير كافية لتعميم المطابقة لكل الحالات.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_optimizations_qa <- function(out = file.path(tempdir(),"FWKC_v73_QA")) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!requireNamespace("ranger", quietly=TRUE))
    stop("Install ranger before V73 exact estimator parity tests")
  cfg <- fw69_cfg("SMOKE")
  cfg$skip_rf <- FALSE
  n_values <- c(30L, 100L, 500L, 1000L)
  p_values <- c(.1, .5)
  records <- vector("list", length(n_values)*length(p_values))
  k <- 0L
  for(n in n_values) for(p in p_values) {
    k <- k + 1L
    dgm <- c("BASE","STRONG_PAIR","LOW_RETEST","HIGH_CLUSTER")[(k-1L)%%4L+1L]
    g <- fw69_dgm(n,p,dgm,fw69_alpha(p,fw69_dgm_par(dgm)[1]),
                  as.integer(700123L + 97L*k))
    sampler <- fw73_make_sampler(g)
    sample_ok <- TRUE
    for(z in 1:3) {
      seed <- as.integer(811001L+1019L*k+z)
      ref <- fw69_bootsample(g, seed)
      fast <- sampler(seed)
      sample_ok <- sample_ok && identical(names(ref), names(fast)) &&
        nrow(ref)==nrow(fast) &&
        all(vapply(names(ref), function(name)
          identical(unname(ref[[name]]), unname(fast[[name]])), logical(1)))
    }
    estimate_seed <- as.integer(910001L+1009L*k)
    old <- fw73_estimate_reference(g, cfg, estimate_seed)
    rng_old <- get(".Random.seed", envir=.GlobalEnv)
    new <- fw69_estimate(g, cfg, estimate_seed)
    rng_new <- get(".Random.seed", envir=.GlobalEnv)
    ok_fit <- identical(old, new)
    # Explicit comparison for nonfinite values, to avoid an NA == NA error.
    mask <- identical(is.finite(old$point), is.finite(new$point))
    good <- is.finite(old$point)&is.finite(new$point)
    maxerr <- if(any(good))max(abs(old$point[good]-new$point[good])) else 0
    records[[k]] <- data.frame(n=n,P=p,DGM=dgm,
      cluster_sample_identical=sample_ok,
      all_estimator_outputs_identical=ok_fit,
      RNG_state_identical=identical(rng_old,rng_new),
      finite_pattern_identical=mask,
      max_abs_point_difference=maxerr,
      values_compared=sum(good),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }
  audit <- do.call(rbind,records)
  fw69_csv(audit,file.path(out,"QA_V73_EXACT_PARITY_ALL_13.csv"))
  okay <- all(audit$cluster_sample_identical & audit$all_estimator_outputs_identical &
              audit$RNG_state_identical & audit$finite_pattern_identical &
              audit$max_abs_point_difference==0)
  if(!okay)stop("V73 exact numerical parity FAILED; optimizations must not be used. See QA_V73_EXACT_PARITY_ALL_13.csv")
  message("V73 strict optimization parity PASS for ", nrow(audit), " design samples")
  invisible(audit)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/PARITY / fw73_bench_task | original line 3077 | function fw73_bench_task
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_bench_task <- function(j,cfg) {
  # Benchmark the expensive, full-refit method (not just the fast kappa formula).
  seed <- as.integer(918123L+1001L*j$n+10007L*j$id)
  dgm <- c("BASE","STRONG_PAIR")[(j$id-1L)%%2L+1L]
  a <- fw69_alpha(.5,fw69_dgm_par(dgm)[1])
  d <- fw69_dgm(j$n,.5,dgm,a,seed)
  boot <- fw73_make_sampler(d)(seed + 500L)
  as.vector(fw69_estimate(boot,cfg,seed + 10000L)$point)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/PARITY / fw73_benchmark | original line 3087 | function fw73_benchmark
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_benchmark <- function(out=file.path(getwd(),"FWKC_v73_BENCHMARK")) {
  dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  if(!requireNamespace("ranger",quietly=TRUE))stop("Install ranger for full-refit BENCH")
  cfg <- fw69_cfg("FULL")
  cfg$cores <- fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_CORES",4L,1L,4L)
  cfg$skip_rf <- FALSE
  cfg$rf_trees <- fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_BENCH_TREES",300L,30L,2000L)
  cfg$bayes_draws <- fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_BENCH_DRAWS",400L,40L,3000L)
  old_env <- Sys.getenv(c("OMP_NUM_THREADS","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS","MKL_NUM_THREADS","BLIS_NUM_THREADS","R_RANGER_NUM_THREADS"))
  on.exit(do.call(Sys.setenv,as.list(old_env)),add=TRUE)
  Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
             BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1",R_RANGER_NUM_THREADS="1")
  jobs <- lapply(seq_len(8L),function(i)list(n=c(30L,100L,500L,1000L)[(i-1L)%%4L+1L],id=i))
  workers <- min(cfg$cores,length(jobs))
  t0 <- proc.time()[3]
  cl <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers,outfile="")
  startup <- proc.time()[3]-t0
  on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl),add=TRUE)
  fn <- ls(envir=.GlobalEnv,pattern="^fw69_")
  fn <- fn[vapply(fn,function(x)is.function(get(x,envir=.GlobalEnv)),logical(1))]
  parallel::clusterExport(cl,c(fn,"fw73_make_sampler","fw73_bench_task",
                               "fw69_methods","fw69_targets"),envir=.GlobalEnv)
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl,{Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
     MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",BLIS_NUM_THREADS="1",R_RANGER_NUM_THREADS="1");NULL})
  invisible(fw73_bench_task(jobs[[1]],cfg))
  invisible(parallel::parLapplyLB(cl,jobs[1],fw73_bench_task,cfg=cfg))
  t1 <- proc.time()[3]; sequential <- lapply(jobs,fw73_bench_task,cfg=cfg);st <- proc.time()[3]-t1
  t2 <- proc.time()[3]; parallel_results <- parallel::parLapplyLB(cl,jobs,fw73_bench_task,cfg=cfg)
  pt <- proc.time()[3]-t2
  maxdiff <- max(vapply(seq_along(jobs),function(i){
     a<-sequential[[i]];b<-parallel_results[[i]]
     if(any(xor(is.finite(a),is.finite(b))))return(Inf)
     if(!any(is.finite(a)))return(0)
     max(abs(a[is.finite(a)]-b[is.finite(b)]))
  },numeric(1)))
  if(!is.finite(maxdiff)||maxdiff>1e-10)stop("V73 serial-vs-PSOCK numerical mismatch")
  # Extrapolation is descriptive only. Different n/P/DGM and selection fractions
  # may give vastly different per-fit costs: this is NOT a completion promise.
  des<-fw69_design(cfg)
  vv<-fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_CI_DATASETS",200L,1L,10000L)
  bb<-fw69_int("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_B",199L,19L,2000L)
  stats<-lapply(c("SELECTED","ALL"),function(scope){
    cfg$V<-vv;cfg$B<-bb;cfg$all_boot<-scope=="ALL"
    bj<-fw69_boot_jobs(des,cfg)
    total<-length(bj)*as.double(bb)
    data.frame(scope=scope,bootstrap_full_refits=total,
      extrapolated_compute_hours=total*(st/length(jobs))/3600/max(1,workers),
      assumption="VERY ROUGH; mean 8 fitted samples, no overhead/stragglers",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  })
  summary<-data.frame(cores=workers,RF_trees=cfg$rf_trees,bayes_draws=cfg$bayes_draws,
    benchmark_fits=length(jobs),PSOCK_start_seconds=startup,
    serial_seconds=st,PSOCK_seconds=pt,
    speedup_excluding_start=st/pmax(pt,1e-9),
    max_absolute_numeric_difference=maxdiff)
  fw69_csv(summary,file.path(out,"FWKC_V73_FULL_REFIT_BENCH.csv"))
  fw69_csv(do.call(rbind,stats),file.path(out,"FWKC_V73_EXTRAPOLATION_NOT_GUARANTEE.csv"))
  message("Full-refit benchmark saved: ",out)
  invisible(out)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/PARITY / fw73_scientific_release_gate | original line 3147 | function fw73_scientific_release_gate
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_scientific_release_gate <- function(out) {
  # PASS means numerical/workflow checks, NOT statistical validity or acceptance.
  p <- file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_01_BIAS_RMSE_MCSE.csv")
  q <- file.path(out,"MANUSCRIPT_02_COVERAGE_AND_FAILURE_BOUNDS.csv")
  mc <- if(file.exists(p))tryCatch(utils::read.csv(p),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
  ci <- if(file.exists(q))tryCatch(utils::read.csv(q),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
  rows <- list()
  add <- function(check,grade,value,explanation) {
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <<- data.frame(check=check,grade=grade,
       value=as.character(value),explanation=explanation,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }
  state<-fw_pub_read_state(out)
  add("COMPUTATION_STATE",if(state=="COMPLETE")"COMPLETE" else "INCOMPLETE",state,
      "Computational completion does NOT certify coverage or validity")
  if(is.null(mc)) add("POINT_GRID","NO_RESULTS","NA","Point results unavailable")
  else {
    expected <- 2430L*3L*length(fw69_methods)
    npoint <- nrow(mc)
    add("POINT_GRID",if(npoint==expected)"COMPLETE" else "REVIEW",npoint,
        paste("Expected",expected,"rows only in FULL/PILOT, not SMOKE"))
    bad <- sum(mc$N_valid < mc$attempts*0.95,na.rm=TRUE)
    add("ESTIMATOR_FAILURES",if(bad)"REVIEW" else "NO_HIGH_FAILURE_CELL",bad,
        "Count of method/estimand cells with >5% failures; never hide them")
  }
  if(is.null(ci))add("COVERAGE","NO_RESULTS","NA","Bootstrap coverage missing")
  else {
    z<-ci[ci$interval_method=="PERCENTILE_FULL_REFIT" & ci$estimand=="DELTA",,drop=FALSE]
    flagged<-z[!is.finite(z$coverage_conditional) |
       z$N_valid_ci<100 |
       (is.finite(z$MCSE_coverage)&z$MCSE_coverage>.01) |
       z$CI_success_pct_among_completed<95,,drop=FALSE]
    add("DELTA_BOOTSTRAP_PRECISION",if(nrow(flagged)==0)"REVIEW_COVERAGE_BIAS" else "REVIEW",nrow(flagged),
      "Absence of flags alone does not establish calibrated 95% coverage")
    if(nrow(flagged))fw69_csv(flagged,file.path(out,"FWKC_V73_CI_FLAGS_FOR_REVIEW.csv"))
  }
  gate<-do.call(rbind,rows)
  fw69_csv(gate,file.path(out,"FWKC_V73_RESEARCH_RELEASE_GATE.csv"))
  writeLines(c(paste("Code:",fw73_version),paste("Run state:",state),
    "ABOVE IS A SCIENTIFIC DIAGNOSTIC, NOT JOURNAL ACCEPTANCE OR PROOF.",
    "All 13 estimator algorithms are evaluated only in current engine.",
    "Historical v27/v28 Gibbs/HMC/GLMM are NOT automatically evaluated.",
    "All C coverage is via working approximate SE unless full bootstrap ALL is selected.",
    "Validity of selective retest identification requires design/positivity assumptions.",
    "Report failed estimation and failed intervals, not only conditional bias/RMSE/coverage.",
    "Publication requires independent theory, external replication, and editorial review."),
    file.path(out,"FWKC_V73_SCIENTIFIC_LIMITATIONS.txt"),useBytes=TRUE)
  invisible(gate)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE ENGINEERING/PARITY / fw73_main | original line 3196 | function fw73_main
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw73_main <- function() {
  stage <- toupper(fw_pub_env("FWKC_PUB_STAGE","SMOKE"))
  if(stage=="BOOT_BENCH")return(fw73_benchmark())
  if(!stage%in%c("PLAN","BENCH","QA","SMOKE","PILOT","FULL","REAL"))
    stop("Unknown FWKC_PUB_STAGE; use PLAN, BOOT_BENCH, QA, SMOKE, PILOT, FULL, REAL")
  if(!stage%in%c("PLAN","BENCH")) {
    # Mandatory fast exact-parity gate, run before launching expensive tasks.
    fw73_optimizations_qa()
  }
  result <- fw72_main()
  if(stage%in%c("QA","SMOKE","PILOT","FULL")) {
    out <- if(is.list(result)&&!is.null(result$output)) result$output else
           if(is.character(result)&&length(result)==1L)result else NULL
    if(!is.null(out)&&dir.exists(out)) {
      qa<-file.path(tempdir(),"FWKC_v73_QA","QA_V73_EXACT_PARITY_ALL_13.csv")
      if(file.exists(qa))file.copy(qa,file.path(out,"QA_V73_EXACT_PARITY_ALL_13.csv"),overwrite=TRUE)
      if(stage!="QA")fw73_scientific_release_gate(out)
    }
  }
  invisible(result)
}
