# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE PREFLIGHT/EXECUTION / fw95_parse | original line 8083 | function fw95_parse
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw95_parse <- function(){
  fw95_gate("PARSE","SOURCE_FILE_IS_TXT",fw95_is_code(.fw95_code),.fw95_code)
  e<-parse(file=.fw95_code,encoding="UTF-8",keep.source=FALSE)
  fw95_gate("PARSE","R_SYNTAX_OK",length(e)>100L,
    paste("top-level R expressions",length(e)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-04 DATA QA | original line 8090 | function fw95_data_qa
# [FW102-ANNOT] يفحص بيانات وتجهيزات workbook قبل المحاكاة؛ لا يغير معادلة كابا.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw95_data_qa <- function(p){
  fw95_gate("DATA_QA","EXCEL_VALID",fw95_xlsx(p),p)
  fw95_gate("DATA_QA","READXL_AVAILABLE",requireNamespace("readxl",quietly=TRUE),
    "Install once: install.packages('readxl')")
  sheets<-readxl::excel_sheets(p)
  fw95_gate("DATA_QA","REQUIRED_SHEETS",
    all(c("RUN_CONFIG","REAL_PAIRED_FULL","PC_GRID_81")%in%sheets),paste(sheets,collapse=","))
  cfg<-readxl::read_excel(p,sheet="RUN_CONFIG")
  fw95_gate("DATA_QA","RUN_CONFIG_KEYS",all(c("key","value")%in%names(cfg))&&nrow(cfg)>0L)
  d<-readxl::read_excel(p,sheet="REAL_PAIRED_FULL")
  fw95_gate("DATA_QA","BINARY_COLUMNS",all(c("D","T1","T2")%in%names(d)))
  for(nm in c("D","T1","T2")) fw95_gate("DATA_QA",paste0("VALID_",nm),
    !anyNA(d[[nm]])&&all(d[[nm]]%in%c(0,1)))
  if("patient_id"%in%names(d))fw95_gate("DATA_QA","UNIQUE_PATIENTS",
    !anyNA(d$patient_id)&&!anyDuplicated(d$patient_id))
  g<-readxl::read_excel(p,sheet="PC_GRID_81")
  vals<-round(seq(.1,.9,.1),8)
  ok<-all(c("Prevalence_P","Weighting_Index_C")%in%names(g))
  if(ok)ok<-nrow(g)==81L && !anyDuplicated(g[c("Prevalence_P","Weighting_Index_C")]) &&
    identical(sort(unique(round(g$Prevalence_P,8))),vals) &&
    identical(sort(unique(round(g$Weighting_Index_C,8))),vals)
  fw95_gate("DATA_QA","ALL_81_PC_PAIRS",ok)
  fw95_log("DATA_QA","PAIRED_RECORDS","INFO",paste("n",nrow(d),
    "D positives",sum(d$D),"observed P",round(mean(d$D),5)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE PREFLIGHT/EXECUTION / fw95_preflight | original line 8116 | function fw95_preflight
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw95_preflight <- function(){
  fw95_parse()
  cfg<-fw69_cfg("FULL")
  vals<-round(seq(.1,.9,.1),8)
  fw95_gate("GRID_QA","NINE_P",identical(round(cfg$P,8),vals))
  fw95_gate("GRID_QA","NINE_C",identical(round(cfg$C,8),vals))
  fw95_gate("GRID_QA","FIVE_DGM",length(cfg$dgms)==5L)
  fw95_gate("GRID_QA","SIX_SAMPLE_SIZES",length(cfg$n)==6L)
  fw95_gate("GRID_QA","270_DESIGNS",nrow(fw69_design(cfg))==270L)
  fw95_gate("GRID_QA","13_METHODS_AND_3_TARGETS",
    length(fw69_methods)==13L&&identical(fw69_targets,c("K1","KA","DELTA")))
  workbook<-fw95_register_excel()
  fw95_data_qa(workbook)
  fw95_log("PREFLIGHT","COMPLETE","PASS","Code + Excel + full P,C grid; no simulation run")
  invisible(TRUE)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE PREFLIGHT/EXECUTION / fw95_run | original line 8132 | function fw95_run
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw95_run <- function(stage="PREFLIGHT",scope="ALL"){
  stage<-toupper(trimws(as.character(stage)[1L]));scope<-toupper(trimws(as.character(scope)[1L]))
  modes<-c("PREFLIGHT","PARSE","GRID_QA","DATA_QA","EXCEL","MF_VALIDATE","QA",
    "CORES_BENCH","MF_MC_BENCH","SMOKE","PILOT","MF_PROFILE",
    "MF_PROFILE_TIME","MF_TIME","MF_RUNTIME","MF_FULL","MF_REPORT",
    "MF_FIGURES","REAL","DIAG")
  fw95_gate("CONTROL","KNOWN_STAGE",stage%in%modes,stage)
  fw95_gate("CONTROL","VALID_SCOPE",scope%in%c("ALL","SELECTED"),scope)
  previous<-getOption("error"); options(error=NULL)
  on.exit(options(error=previous),add=TRUE)
  tryCatch({
    if(stage=="PARSE")return(fw95_parse())
    if(stage=="GRID_QA")return(fw94_grid_qa())
    if(stage=="EXCEL")return(invisible(fw95_register_excel(explicit=if(interactive())file.choose() else NULL)))
    if(stage=="PREFLIGHT")return(fw95_preflight())
    p<-fw95_register_excel()
    if(stage=="DATA_QA")return(fw95_data_qa(p))
    # Re-check the correct code path; do not re-open TXT chooser.
    fw95_gate(stage,"CODE_PATH_STABLE",fw95_is_code(.fw95_code),.fw95_code)
    if(stage=="MF_FULL"){
      fw95_gate(stage,"EXPLICIT_APPROVAL",identical(Sys.getenv("FWKC_PUB_APPROVE"),"YES"),
        "Set FWKC_PUB_APPROVE=YES only after QA, SMOKE and performance benchmarks")
      fw95_log(stage,"METHODOLOGY","INFO",
        "Multi-Fidelity estimates full-refit CI performance; not the complete HF census")
    }
    start<-proc.time()[[3L]]
    ans<-fw94_run(stage=stage,scope=scope,excel=p)
    fw95_log(stage,"FINISHED","PASS",paste("seconds",round(proc.time()[[3L]]-start,2)))
    invisible(ans)
  },error=function(e){
    target<-file.path(fw95_logdir(),"FW98_FATAL_ERROR.txt")
    details<-c(paste("date",Sys.time()),paste("stage",stage),
      paste("code",.fw95_code),paste("excel",Sys.getenv("FW95_INPUT")),
      paste("error",conditionMessage(e)),
      paste("call",paste(deparse(conditionCall(e)),collapse=" ")),
      capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()))
    try(writeLines(details,target,useBytes=TRUE),silent=TRUE)
    fw95_log(stage,"FATAL","FAIL",conditionMessage(e))
    message("Full diagnostic: ",target)
    stop(conditionMessage(e),call.=FALSE)
  })
}

# ========================== FWKC v100 PILOT SCOPE REPAIR ==========================
# No statistical estimator or Multi-Fidelity implementation is altered here.
# PILOT is an exploratory conventional bootstrap over SELECTED=45 designs.
# ALL=270 designs remains available only for MF_FULL and is NEVER silently
# reduced when MF_FULL is requested.  The inherited FULL authorization gates
# are preserved, including exact source/workbook QA signatures.
# Prefer the ONE companion Excel shipped with v100, even if Windows/RStudio
# still retains the older FW95_INPUT variable from a previous session.
.fw100_inherited_register_excel <- fw95_register_excel
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-INPUT PRE-V101 WRAPPER | original line 8210 | function fw95_register_excel
# [FW102-ANNOT] تعيد طبقات الإصدارات توريث fw95_register_excel، لذا لا تعد دوال
# [FW102-ANNOT] register_excel المتعددة معاملات إحصائية مستقلة.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw95_register_excel <- function(explicit=NULL) {
  current <- file.path(dirname(.fw95_code),"FWKC_v100_INPUT.xlsx")
  if(is.null(explicit)&&fw95_xlsx(current))explicit<-current
  .fw100_inherited_register_excel(explicit=explicit)
}
.fw100_inherited_fw95_run <- fw95_run
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-05 PILOT VS FULL SCOPE | original line 8216 | function fw100_effective_scope
# [FW102-ANNOT] PILOT اختباري SELECTED؛ أما FULL/MF_FULL فيتطلب ALL=270 designs.
# [FW102-ANNOT] نتائج PILOT لا تُقدَّم باعتبارها أداء coverage النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw100_effective_scope <- function(stage,scope) {
  if(!is.character(stage)||length(stage)!=1L||is.na(stage)||
     !is.character(scope)||length(scope)!=1L||is.na(scope))
    stop("FW100: stage and scope must be single character values",call.=FALSE)
  stage <- toupper(trimws(stage));scope <- toupper(trimws(scope))
  if(!scope %in% c("ALL","SELECTED"))stop("FW100: invalid bootstrap scope",call.=FALSE)
  if(identical(stage,"PILOT"))"SELECTED" else scope
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE SCOPE-ROUTER / fw100_scope_selftest | original line 8224 | function fw100_scope_selftest
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw100_scope_selftest <- function(){
  stopifnot(identical(fw100_effective_scope("PILOT","ALL"),"SELECTED"),
    identical(fw100_effective_scope("PILOT","SELECTED"),"SELECTED"),
    identical(fw100_effective_scope("MF_FULL","ALL"),"ALL"),
    identical(fw100_effective_scope("MF_FULL","SELECTED"),"SELECTED"),
    identical(fw100_effective_scope("SMOKE","ALL"),"ALL"),
    length(fw69_methods)==13L,length(fw69_targets)==3L,
    identical(round(fw69_cfg("FULL")$P,8),round(seq(.1,.9,.1),8)),
    identical(round(fw69_cfg("FULL")$C,8),round(seq(.1,.9,.1),8)))
  TRUE
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE PREFLIGHT/EXECUTION / fw95_run | original line 8235 | function fw95_run
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw95_run <- function(stage="PREFLIGHT",scope="ALL") {
  stage <- toupper(trimws(as.character(stage)[1L]))
  requested <- toupper(trimws(as.character(scope)[1L]))
  effective <- fw100_effective_scope(stage,requested)
  if(identical(stage,"PILOT")) {
    message("[FW100/PILOT/SCOPE] ",requested," -> SELECTED: 45 conventional bootstrap designs; all 270 point designs preserved.")
    message("[FW100/PILOT/NOTE] This is a pilot, NOT MF_FULL or ALL-CI coverage.")
    old_scope <- Sys.getenv("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_SCOPE",unset=NA_character_)
    on.exit({
      if(is.na(old_scope))Sys.unsetenv("FWKC_PUB_BOOT_SCOPE")
      else Sys.setenv(FWKC_PUB_BOOT_SCOPE=old_scope)
    },add=TRUE)
  }
  .fw100_inherited_fw95_run(stage=stage,scope=effective)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-06 EXPLICIT APPROVAL | original line 8268 | function fw101_run
# [FW102-ANNOT] FULL لا يبدأ دون approve_full=TRUE وscope=ALL؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه حماية تشغيلية لا ابتكار إحصائي، وينبغي الحفاظ عليها.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw101_run <- function(stage="PREFLIGHT", scope="ALL", approve_full=FALSE) {
  stage<-toupper(trimws(as.character(stage)[1L]))
  scope<-toupper(trimws(as.character(scope)[1L]))
  if(identical(stage,"MF_FULL")) {
    if(!identical(approve_full,TRUE))
      stop("FW101: FULL requires approve_full=TRUE typed explicitly in the command.",call.=FALSE)
    if(!identical(scope,"ALL"))
      stop("FW101: FULL research census of DGM/n/P designs requires scope='ALL'.",call.=FALSE)
    old<-Sys.getenv("FWKC_PUB_APPROVE",unset=NA_character_)
    on.exit({
      if(is.na(old))Sys.unsetenv("FWKC_PUB_APPROVE")
      else Sys.setenv(FWKC_PUB_APPROVE=old)
    },add=TRUE)
    Sys.setenv(FWKC_PUB_APPROVE="YES")
    message("[FW101/FULL/AUTHORIZED] Explicit approve_full=TRUE; ALL=270 designs; no interactive prompt")
  }
  fw100_run(stage=stage,scope=scope)
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE APPROVAL / fw101_signed | original line 8286 | function fw101_signed
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw101_signed <- function(stage) {
  if(stage%in%c("QA","SMOKE","CORES_BENCH"))
    return(isTRUE(tryCatch(fw82_stamped(stage),error=function(e)FALSE)))
  if(identical(stage,"MF_PROFILE")) {
    return(isTRUE(tryCatch({
      f<-fw88_profile_file()
      if(!file.exists(f))return(FALSE)
      o<-readRDS(f)
      is.list(o)&&identical(o$fingerprint,fw86_fingerprint())&&
        is.data.frame(o$samples)&&nrow(o$samples)==90L&&
        all(o$samples$HF_draws>=3L)
    },error=function(e)FALSE)))
  }
  FALSE
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-07 SIGNED STAGED PIPELINE | original line 8301 | function fw101_pipeline
# [FW102-ANNOT] مسار PREFLIGHT -> MF_VALIDATE -> QA -> CORES_BENCH -> SMOKE ->
# [FW102-ANNOT] MF_MC_BENCH -> MF_TIME -> MF_PROFILE -> MF_RUNTIME -> MF_FULL -> REPORT/FIGURES.
# [FW102-ANNOT] التوقيعات حساسة للبصمة، لذلك تعليقات هذا الملف تمنع reuse مباشراً.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw101_pipeline <- function(approve_full=FALSE) {
  if(!identical(approve_full,TRUE)) {
    message("[FW101/PLAN] Full run NOT started. To authorize the entire verified workflow:")
    message('fw101_pipeline(approve_full=TRUE)')
    message("This may take many days; no finish-time guarantee.")
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }
  # All checks correspond to this code version, XLSX and R package environment.
  message("[FW102/PIPELINE] PREFLIGHT -> MF_VALIDATE -> QA -> CORES_BENCH -> SMOKE -> MF_MC_BENCH -> MF_TIME -> MF_PROFILE -> MF_PROFILE_TIME -> MF_RUNTIME -> MF_FULL")
  fw101_run("PREFLIGHT")
  for(s in c("MF_VALIDATE","QA","CORES_BENCH","SMOKE","MF_MC_BENCH",
             "MF_TIME","MF_PROFILE","MF_PROFILE_TIME","MF_RUNTIME")) {
    if(s%in%c("QA","CORES_BENCH","SMOKE","MF_PROFILE")&&fw101_signed(s)) {
      message("[FW101/PIPELINE/SKIP_SIGNED] ",s," already passed with this source, workbook and R packages")
      next
    }
    message("[FW101/PIPELINE/START] ",s)
    result<-fw101_run(s)
    if(identical(result,FALSE))stop("FW101/PIPELINE: stage failed: ",s,call.=FALSE)
    message("[FW101/PIPELINE/DONE] ",s)
  }
  full<-fw101_run("MF_FULL",scope="ALL",approve_full=TRUE)
  if(identical(full,FALSE))stop("FW101: MF_FULL did not complete. No report or figures generated.",call.=FALSE)
  message("[FW101/PIPELINE] Full MF computation returned; auditing results and creating figures")
  fw101_run("MF_REPORT")
  fw101_run("MF_FIGURES")
  message("[FW101/PIPELINE/COMPLETE] Results, manuscript audit and figures requested")
  invisible(full)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE APPROVAL / fw101_menu | original line 8330 | function fw101_menu
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw101_menu <- function() {
  items<-c("PREFLIGHT","MF_VALIDATE","QA","CORES_BENCH","SMOKE",
    "MF_MC_BENCH","MF_PROFILE","MF_PROFILE_TIME","MF_RUNTIME",
    "PILOT","REAL","MF_REPORT","MF_FIGURES","DIAG",
    "FULL: prepare + run, requires explicit separate command")
  selected<-utils::menu(items,title="FWKC v101 | choose one stage (0 exits)")
  if(selected<=0L)return(invisible(NULL))
  if(selected==length(items)) {
    message("To authorize FULL, type at the > prompt: fw101_pipeline(approve_full=TRUE)")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  fw101_run(items[selected])
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE TIME-GATE / fw102_forecast_files | original line 8359 | function fw102_forecast_files
# [FW102-ANNOT] طبقة تشغيل/تدقيق مرتبطة بالمحرك الإحصائي؛ تسهل سلامة المصدر أو التدقيق أو إعادة الإنتاج.
# [FW102-ANNOT] ليست وحدها اشتقاقًا رياضيًا جديدًا أو دليلًا على أفضلية المقدّر.
# [FW102-ANNOT] [VALIDATE] عند تكرار تعريف الدالة، يكون آخر ربط لها هو الذي يحدد السلوك النهائي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw102_forecast_files <- function() {
  c(forecast=file.path(fw86_root(),"FW86_TWO_PHASE_TIME_BY_1_2_4_CORES.csv"),
    mc=file.path(fw86_root(),"FW86_MC_BENCH_SIGNED.rds"),
    hf=file.path(fw82_dir(),"FW82_BOOT_BENCH_CACHE.rds"))
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-08 MEASURED TIME SIGNATURE | original line 8364 | function fw102_forecast_valid
# [FW102-ANNOT] يتحقق من ملفات forecast والفingerprint وعدم تقادم benchmarks لـ1/2/4 cores.
# [FW102-ANNOT] لا تخلط توقع الوقت مع guarantee أو with scientific uncertainty.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw102_forecast_valid <- function() {
  paths<-fw102_forecast_files()
  if(!all(file.exists(paths)))return(FALSE)
  meta<-tryCatch(readRDS(paths[["mc"]]),error=function(e)NULL)
  boot<-tryCatch(readRDS(paths[["hf"]]),error=function(e)NULL)
  fp<-tryCatch(fw86_fingerprint(),error=function(e)NULL)
  sig<-tryCatch(fw82_signature(),error=function(e)NULL)
  if(!is.list(meta)||is.null(fp)||is.null(sig)||!identical(meta$fingerprint,fp)||
     !is.data.frame(meta$samples)||nrow(meta$samples)!=18L||
     !is.list(boot)||!identical(boot$metadata$signature,sig)||
     !identical(as.integer(boot$metadata$trees),300L)||
     !isTRUE(fw82_stamped("CORES_BENCH")))return(FALSE)
  stamps<-file.info(paths)$mtime
  stamp_seconds<-as.numeric(stamps);names(stamp_seconds)<-names(paths)
  if(anyNA(stamp_seconds)||stamp_seconds[["forecast"]]<
     max(stamp_seconds[c("mc","hf")]))return(FALSE)
  z<-tryCatch(utils::read.csv(paths[["forecast"]],stringsAsFactors=FALSE),
              error=function(e)NULL)
  fields<-c("path","cores","MC_hours_estimate",
            "HF_hours_benchmark_extrapolation","recommended")
  if(!is.data.frame(z)||!all(fields%in%names(z))||nrow(z)<6L||
     !all(c("MF_min","MF_max")%in%z$path)||
     !all(c(1L,2L,4L)%in%z$cores)||
     any(!is.finite(z$MC_hours_estimate))||
     any(!is.finite(z$HF_hours_benchmark_extrapolation))||
     any(z$MC_hours_estimate<0)||
     any(z$HF_hours_benchmark_extrapolation<0))return(FALSE)
  TRUE
}
# [FW102-ANNOT] =============================================================================
# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-09 SIGNED TWO-PHASE GATE | original line 8393 | function fw102_require_two_phase
# [FW102-ANNOT] يجدد MF_TIME إذا كانت قياسات الوقت مفقودة/قديمة؛
# [FW102-ANNOT] يحافظ على البوابات البحثية؛ لا يغيّر الدوال الإحصائية الأساسية.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw102_require_two_phase <- function() {
  if(!isTRUE(fw82_stamped("QA"))||!isTRUE(fw82_stamped("SMOKE"))||
     !isTRUE(fw82_stamped("CORES_BENCH")))
    stop("FW102: Revalidate QA, CORES_BENCH, and SMOKE with this exact TXT, Excel and R packages.",call.=FALSE)
  if(!fw102_forecast_valid()) {
    message("[FW102/MF_FULL/TWO_PHASE] Measured forecast missing/stale: running MF_TIME with signed benchmarks.")
    ans<-.fw102_inherited_fw101_run("MF_TIME")
    if(identical(ans,FALSE)||!fw102_forecast_valid())
      stop("FW102: MF_TIME did not produce a current verified two-phase forecast. Inspect FW86 outputs and rerun MF_MC_BENCH/CORES_BENCH as needed.",call.=FALSE)
  }
  p<-fw102_forecast_files()
  hashes<-as.character(tools::md5sum(p))
  audit<-data.frame(time=as.character(Sys.time()),
       code=normalizePath(.fw95_code,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE),
       code_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(.fw95_code)),
       file=basename(p),md5=unname(hashes),
       status="SIGNED_MEASURED_TWO_PHASE_FORECAST_PRESENT",
       stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  utils::write.csv(audit,file.path(fw86_root(),"FW102_FORECAST_INPUT_AUDIT.csv"),
                   row.names=FALSE)
  message("[FW102/MF_FULL/TWO_PHASE] PASS: signed, matching 1/2/4-core forecast exists; ALL original FW87 gates remain active.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}
.fw102_inherited_fw101_run<-fw101_run

# [FW102-ANNOT] CONTROLLER-09B FINAL FULL APPROVAL OVERRIDE | original line 8417 | function fw101_run
# [FW102-ANNOT] هذه النسخة الأخيرة من fw101_run تضيف التحقق الزمني ذي المرحلتين
# [FW102-ANNOT] قبل أن تمرر التنفيذ للمحرك السابق. لا تغير M/B أو الاستدلال الرياضي.
# [FW102-ANNOT] -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fw101_run<-function(stage="PREFLIGHT",scope="ALL",approve_full=FALSE) {
  stage<-toupper(trimws(as.character(stage)[1L]))
  if(identical(stage,"MF_FULL")&&identical(approve_full,TRUE))
    fw102_require_two_phase()
  .fw102_inherited_fw101_run(stage=stage,scope=scope,approve_full=approve_full)
}

# [FW102-ANNOT] MODULE TIME-GATE / fw102_controller_selftest | original line 8440 | function fw102_controller_selftest

fw102_controller_selftest<-function() {
  stages<-c("MF_VALIDATE","QA","CORES_BENCH","SMOKE","MF_MC_BENCH",
            "MF_TIME","MF_PROFILE","MF_PROFILE_TIME","MF_RUNTIME","MF_FULL")
  stopifnot(match("CORES_BENCH",stages)<match("MF_TIME",stages),
            match("MF_MC_BENCH",stages)<match("MF_TIME",stages),
            match("MF_TIME",stages)<match("MF_FULL",stages),
            length(fw69_methods)==13L,length(fw69_targets)==3L,
            nrow(fw69_design(fw69_cfg("FULL")))==270L,
            identical(round(fw69_cfg("FULL")$P,9),round(seq(.1,.9,.1),9)),
            identical(round(fw69_cfg("FULL")$C,9),round(seq(.1,.9,.1),9)))
  message("[FW102/STAGE_DEPENDENCY_AND_FULL_P_C_GRID] PASS")
  invisible(TRUE)
}
fw102_controller_selftest()
